sql_infos.sql: SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 42187) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 48 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezenca FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 133506 ) OR n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.povrsina < 3567 ) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 19 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS osebe_count FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 877054) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 61 EXCEPT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), COUNT(o.id_nesreca) FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.povrsina < 996798) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(o.id_nesreca) < 404 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 823345 AND o.starost > 57 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 644 EXCEPT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.y < 245482 AND o.starost < 21 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) < 366 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 534910 EXCEPT SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.povrsina < 7830 ) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 39 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 868999) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 89 EXCEPT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.povrsina < 340849) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) < 50 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 121516 AND o.starost > 34 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 301 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.y < 1606 AND o.alkotest > 2.21 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) < 751;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, MAX(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS max_vozniski_staz, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesreca FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 335302 AND n.y < 27888 AND o.starost BETWEEN 46 AND 112 AND o.alkotest > 2.92 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 781 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 0.65 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, MAX(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS max_vozniski_staz, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesreca FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '-180' AND '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '-90' AND '-90' AND o.vozniski_staz_ll > 83 AND o.spol = 'M' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 315 AND SUM(o.starost) > 80015 ORDER BY rank_nesreca;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 15 AND o.starost BETWEEN 20 AND 87 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 27 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_injured, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heavily_injured_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS drunk_drivers_count, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / u.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_million_inhabitants, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca AND o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 78 AND 37 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 4062) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, u.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 128 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 342 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 85 AND o.starost >= 2 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 511 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '1') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '2') AS avg_age_female, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY MIN(CAST(SUBSTRING(n.cas_nesreca FROM 1 FOR 4) AS INTEGER))) AS prev_year_accidents, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS population_per_accident FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.alkotest >= 0.21 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 95 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 44 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, MAX(o.alkotest) AS max_alcohol_level, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_participants, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_residents_per_unit FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN n2.x_wgs84 - 0.01 AND n2.x_wgs84 + 0.01 WHERE n.x > 631882 AND n.y > 947361 AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN (SELECT vzrok_nesreca FROM nesreca WHERE upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota GROUP BY vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 99) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > (SELECT AVG(accident_count) FROM (SELECT upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS accident_count FROM nesreca GROUP BY upravna_enota) sub) AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 2 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS accidents_with_culprit FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' AND o.starost >= 89 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 48 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_test, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_unit, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca) AS unit_accident_type_total FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost >= 13 AND o.alkotest >= 0.75 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 635 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 46 ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hude_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm/12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_leta, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s_pasom_ali_celado, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS moski, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zenske, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS prebivalci_enote, MAX(u.povrsina) AS povrsina_enote, (MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(MAX(u.povrsina),0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 456629 AND ue.povrsina < 551) AND o.starost > 68 AND o.alkotest > 0.04 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 77 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 164 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 17 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 44 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0.0' AND o.alkotest >= 1.54 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 84 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 7 UNION SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hude_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza_meseci, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 207569 AND n.y < 761094 AND o.strokovni_pregled <= 8.08 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 89 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(SUM(u.povrsina), 0) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 91 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 669 AND AVG(o.starost) < 102 UNION SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(SUM(u.povrsina), 0) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 < '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '-90.0' AND o.starost <= 45 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 140 AND AVG(o.starost) > 101 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_level, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS accidents_with_culprit, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0) * 100000, 2) AS accidents_per_100k FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2020-01-01' AND o.starost BETWEEN 57 AND 29 AND ue.povrsina > 1853 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 394 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, SUM(o.alkotest) / NULLIF(COUNT(o.alkotest), 0) AS avg_alkotest, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('1', '2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) DESC) AS severity_percentile, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY MIN(SUBSTRING(n.cas_nesreca FROM 1 FOR 4)::integer)) AS prev_year_accidents FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.id_nesreca <> n2.id_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND SUBSTRING(n.cas_nesreca FROM 1 FOR 4)::integer BETWEEN 2012 AND 2011 AND o.starost BETWEEN 67 AND 54 AND o.alkotest BETWEEN 1.65 AND 1.28 AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 80875 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, SUBSTRING(n.cas_nesreca FROM 1 FOR 4)::integer HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 941 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('1', '2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 465 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, severity_percentile ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS caused_by_driver, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS participant_only, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 1.26) AS accidents_with_high_alcohol, MAX(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS population, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / MAX(ue.st_prebivalcev)) AS accidents_per_100k, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (ORDER BY ue.id_upravna_enota) AS prev_admin_unit_accidents FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 22 AND 98 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 4937) AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN (SELECT vzrok_nesreca FROM nesreca WHERE upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota GROUP BY vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 65) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.poskodba = 'S') AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' AND ue.povrsina > 5904 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 487 AND AVG(o.starost) < 53 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 235513) AND o.starost > 24 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 100 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 476056 AND o.starost > 56 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 102 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%glavna%' AND o.spol = 'M' GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 20 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 0.37) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 34 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT u2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota u2 WHERE u2.st_prebivalcev > 658614) AND o.starost > 86 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 35 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 152158 ) AND o.starost > 27 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 7 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, o.spol, o.vrsta_udelezenca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(o.alkotest) AS skupni_alkotest, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(u.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost >= 72 AND o.alkotest >= 1.94 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 7972 GROUP BY CUBE (u.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, o.spol, o.vrsta_udelezenca) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 864 AND SUM(o.alkotest) > 317.51 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(*) as stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) as povprecna_starost, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as smrtne_zrtve FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 71 AND o.starost >= 51 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca), (u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca), (u.ime_upravna_enota), () ) ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;
