SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS oseba_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS prebivalci_per_nesreca FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '14.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 67 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 1 AND AVG(o.starost) < 76.25 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 530 AND o.starost > 34 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 590 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 61 AND o.starost >= 24 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 1 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 97 AND o.starost >= 76 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 11 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%glavna%' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.spol = 'M' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 30 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 20 AND 36 AND upravna_enota IN ( SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 66207 ) ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 9 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 74 AND 56 AND upravna_enota IN ( SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 16657 ) ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 65 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE ue.id_upravna_enota IN ( SELECT DISTINCT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND y_wgs84 < '45.0' ) AND o.starost > 56 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 33 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT (n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje)) AS distinct_road_name_combos, COUNT(DISTINCT (o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca)) AS distinct_person_combos, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_causers, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population, SUM(u.povrsina) AS total_area FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' AND o.starost >= 33 AND o.alkotest >= 0.34 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 797 AND AVG(o.starost) < 98 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC, avg_age ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS distinct_genders_involved, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost >= 88 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 925 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 52307 AND o.starost > 33 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 294 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_starost_zenske FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost >= 96 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 37 UNION SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_starost_zenske FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost >= 40 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 42 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.tip_nesreca, ', ' ORDER BY n.tip_nesreca) AS tipi_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_poskodbe FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 396 AND o.starost >= 99 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 35 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 52 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 69 AND 38 AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN ('1', '1') GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 446 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND o2.alkotest > 2.52) AS count_high_alc_culprits FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.klas_nesreca = 'A' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 479970 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 95 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_alc) FROM (SELECT upravna_enota, MAX(alkotest) AS max_alc FROM oseba WHERE alkotest > 0.89 GROUP BY upravna_enota) sub WHERE sub.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota) AS max_alcohol_in_unit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2023 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 686 AND AVG(o.starost) < 62 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_involved ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 4.89 AND o2.starost BETWEEN 51 AND 85 ORDER BY o2.alkotest DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 75 ) AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 957 AND AVG(o.starost) BETWEEN 16 AND 46 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_involved;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 93 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2012 AND 2018 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 44 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_persons, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS causer_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, MAX(o.alkotest) AS max_alcohol_level, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injury_count, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / ue.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_million_inhabitants, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (ORDER BY ue.id_upravna_enota) AS prev_unit_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.klas_nesreca = 'A' LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca AND o.starost >= 51 AND o.alkotest >= 0.14 WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 265378 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 631 AND AVG(o.starost) < 24 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_male_age ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '{{p3}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_injury_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 443938) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.21 AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '{{p4}}') AND n.x BETWEEN 505073 AND 457907 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 144 AND AVG(o.starost) BETWEEN 31 AND 33 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_causers, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE (n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' OR n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0') AND o.starost >= 26 AND (o.alkotest > 0.92 OR o.strokovni_pregled < 0.33) AND NOT (n.vzrok_nesreca = '{{p8}}' AND n.tip_nesreca = '{{p9}}') GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 23 AND AVG(o.starost) < 30 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responsible_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota BETWEEN 251 AND 816 AND o.starost >= 19 AND o.alkotest >= 2.65 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 280121 AND n.x BETWEEN 595982 AND 727215 AND n.y BETWEEN 717228 AND 972731 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 12 AND AVG(o.starost) < 72 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 473 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_female_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca LIKE '%' AND n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 12 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS p75_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost > 21 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 276 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_level, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age_involved, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND n.klas_nesreca = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' AND o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 0.99 AND o2.starost BETWEEN 42 AND 59 AND o2.spol = 'M' ) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 632 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) < 1.29 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, fatal_injuries DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_age_causer, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost >= 10 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 2192 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 698 EXCEPT SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_age_causer, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'P' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) < 100 ORDER BY accident_rank;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, (SELECT AVG(o2.starost) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.spol = 'Z' AND o2.alkotest > 0.51) AS avg_age_female_high_alc, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V') AS driver_accidents, MAX(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) AS population_density FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) BETWEEN 2023 AND 2017 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 168 AND AVG(o.starost) < 45 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, population_density ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, MAX(n.x_wgs84) - MIN(n.x_wgs84) AS longitude_range, MAX(n.y_wgs84) - MIN(n.y_wgs84) AS latitude_range, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.3 LIMIT 1)) AS accidents_with_high_alc, SUM(CASE WHEN n.tip_nesreca = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pedestrian_accidents, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '14.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '46.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2020-01-01' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 81070 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nesreca n2 WHERE n2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND n2.klas_nesreca = 'B' AND n2.vzrok_nesreca IN ('01','02') LIMIT 62 OFFSET 207) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 381 AND AVG(o.starost) < 55 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, severe_injuries DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(o.starost) AS total_age_involved, (SELECT AVG(o2.starost) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND o.starost > 76 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 823 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3year FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI') >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost >= 36 AND o.alkotest >= 2.53 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 34 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS monthly_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, AVG(ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS population_density, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_accidents_4months FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') <= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 55) AND o.starost >= 33 AND o.starost <= 92 AND (o.alkotest > 1.41 OR o.strokovni_pregled > 2.55) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 47 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 7 ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, monthly_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS cetrtletje_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hude_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2015-01-01' AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN ('1', '1', '1') AND o.starost >= 98 AND o.alkotest >= 0.35 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 846174 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 46 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4 ORDER BY leto_nesreca DESC, cetrtletje_nesreca DESC, stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost >= 100 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 8 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' AND o.starost >= 82 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 161 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, SUM(o.alkotest) / NULLIF(COUNT(o.alkotest), 0) AS avg_blood_alcohol, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_equipment_used, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 335527) AND o.starost BETWEEN 18 AND 68 AND o.alkotest >= 0.28 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 49 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2 ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 1.36 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vozniski_staz_ll > 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS experienced_drivers, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS population_per_accident, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS accidents_last_12_months FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca IN ('1', '1') AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 295 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 15 ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, accidents_last_12_months DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(o.alkotest) / NULLIF(COUNT(o.alkotest), 0) AS avg_alcohol_level, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS accidents_with_culprit, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ue.id_upravna_enota), 0) AS avg_population_per_unit, SUM(ue.povrsina) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ue.id_upravna_enota), 0) AS avg_area_per_unit, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_12_month_accidents, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 73 AND 91 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 334777 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 930 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 23 ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_female_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (43, 96, 22) AND o.starost BETWEEN 77 AND 84 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year, quarter HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 48.99 ORDER BY year DESC, quarter DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.tip_nesreca, ', ' ORDER BY n.tip_nesreca) AS tipi_nesrec, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT o.poskodba, ', ' ORDER BY o.poskodba) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba IS NOT NULL) AS vrste_poskodb, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS prebivalci_na_nesreco FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 82 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 35 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 40 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_meseci, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.drzavljanstvo = 'SLO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_slovencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%' AND n.tekst_odsek_ali_ulica LIKE '%' AND n.stacionazna_ali_hisna_st LIKE '%' AND n.cas_nesreca LIKE '%' AND o.starost >= 19 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 59 AND o.alkotest >= 2.58 AND o.strokovni_pregled >= 0.44 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 315317 AND ue.povrsina >= 5060 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 80 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 210 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 50 AND AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) > 34 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS povprecno_prebivalstvo_na_enoto, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_cesti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 41 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 725668 AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN ('A', 'A') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, u.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 332 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) > 1.65 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hujse_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS povprecno_prebivalstvo_na_enoto, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta) AS skupno_nesrece_po_kategoriji_ceste FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '45.0' AND o.starost >= 83 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 452 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 37 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecno_prebivalstvo_na_enoto ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_level, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_accidents_3yr FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN 15.93 AND 16.91 AND o.starost >= 94 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 452940 AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 5 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) > 0.08 ORDER BY year DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.naselje_ali_izven ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS rang_smrti_v_naselju FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost >= 66 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 201401 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 189 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 46 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS drunk_drivers, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_in_unit FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 643483) AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN (SELECT vzrok_nesreca FROM nesreca GROUP BY vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 218) AND o.starost BETWEEN 74 AND 72 AND (o.alkotest > 2.97 OR o.strokovni_pregled > 2.72) AND n.kategorija_cesta = 'A' AND n.naselje_ali_izven = '1' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 78 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 11 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_zrtvi, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2', '3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hujse_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec, (ue.st_prebivalcev * 1.0 / ue.povrsina) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE ( (n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0')) AND (n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' OR n.tip_nesreca = '1') AND NOT (n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND n.stanje_promet = '1') AND n.kategorija_cesta NOT IN ('1', '1') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o2.alkotest > 0.77) ) AND o.starost BETWEEN 69 AND 89 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll > 37 AND (o.alkotest > 0.77 OR o.strokovni_pregled > 2.39) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 449 AND AVG(o.starost) < 23 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, gostota_prebivalstva;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lazje_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS z_varnostnim_pasom, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_udelezcih_po_tipu FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%avtocesta%' AND n.klas_nesreca = 'A' AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN ('1', '1', '1') AND o.starost >= 47 AND o.alkotest >= 2.45 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 903319 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o2.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 50 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 45 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 75 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 84 AND o.starost BETWEEN 23 AND 73 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 5310 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(*) > 6 ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.upravna_enota ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_accidents FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 56 AND o.starost > 35 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 8 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 57 AND o.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 22 AND n.x BETWEEN 89428 AND 32343 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, accident_rank;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 80 AND o.starost >= 75 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 16 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 757675) AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost >= 84 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 6 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_perpetrator_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca)) AS person_percentile FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 54 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 468333 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 84 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') < 38 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accident_rank;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS accident_month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0) AS avg_positive_alcohol, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '205' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_accident_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 19 AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 7 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0) < 0.71 ORDER BY rolling_accident_count DESC, ue.ime_upravna_enota, accident_month;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_population_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.alkotest > 1.59 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 402 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 UNION ALL SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, 'ALL_TYPES' AS tip_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V') AS avg_driver_experience, MAX(u.povrsina) AS max_area, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS overall_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 281217 AND n.y > 735245 AND o.starost BETWEEN 49 AND 34 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) > 48 AND COUNT(*) >= 1622 ORDER BY ime_upravna_enota, year DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahkotne_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_z_udelezenci, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o2.id_nesreca) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.alkotest > 2.55 AND o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota) AS nesrece_z_alkotestom, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, ROUND(ue.st_prebivalcev::numeric / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0), 2) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND n.cas_nesreca <= '00:00' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 387530 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 11 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 0 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, smrtni_zrtve DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s_pasom_ali_celado, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prekoračitve_alkotesta, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_staz_ll, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 16 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 48 AND 59 AND o.alkotest >= 1.95 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 518 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 4221 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 50 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 462574 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 39 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 68 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE (n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' OR n.tip_nesreca = '1') AND NOT (n.naselje_ali_izven = '1') AND o.starost > 26 AND o.alkotest < 1.6 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 14 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 989 AND o.starost >= 16 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 31 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 95 AND o.starost BETWEEN 26 AND 64 AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN ('1', '1') AND o.alkotest >= 0.09 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 36 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 2.4 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 29 AND o.starost BETWEEN 23 AND 48 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 363698 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 44 AND AVG(o.starost) < 58 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC, avg_starost ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_starost, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.spol = 'M' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 197912 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 42 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 1.45 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS povprecno_prebivalstvo_na_enoto, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_vzroku FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 3.12) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o3 WHERE o3.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o3.starost > 67)) AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT u2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota u2 WHERE u2.st_prebivalcev > 864456) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 986 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') < 81 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_moskih ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS prebivalci_na_nesreco, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_vzroku FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 88 AND o.starost BETWEEN 26 AND 96 AND n.klas_nesreca IN ('A', 'D') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 28 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 6 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_moskih;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) as stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) as stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) as povprecna_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 84 AND o.starost >= 59 AND n.upravna_enota <= 135 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota), () ) ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, COUNT(*) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.alkotest) AS skupni_alkotest, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(ue.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.alkotest >= 1.61 AND o.starost BETWEEN 85 AND 24 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 9705191 GROUP BY CUBE (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba) HAVING COUNT(*) > 283 AND SUM(o.alkotest) > 26.45 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupni_alkotest DESC;

ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 287371 AND ue.povrsina <= 349 AND o.starost >= 33 AND o.alkotest >= 0.37 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, stevilo_tujcev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, (ue.st_prebivalcev * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS percent_rank_nesrece, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_udelezencev_po_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 585208 AND
