avg_driving_experience_months, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_test, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS avg_professional_exam, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_safety_equipment_used, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_safety_equipment_not_used, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_male, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.drzavljanstvo = 'SLO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_slovenian, SUM(CASE WHEN o.drzavljanstvo != 'SLO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_foreign, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_fatal_injury, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_serious_injury, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_light_injury, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_uninjured, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_drivers, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_passengers, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'K' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_pedestrians, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, (ue.st_prebivalcev::numeric / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS population_density, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)::numeric / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS accidents_per_100k_inhabitants, (COUNT(o.id_nesreca)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0)) AS avg_persons_per_accident FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost > 73 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 445742 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 77 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 94 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, total_persons_involved DESC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS accident_count FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN nesreca n1 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n1.upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n1.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND ue1.st_prebivalcev > 832926 GROUP BY ue1.id_upravna_enota, ue1.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 71 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

WITH accident_stats AS ( SELECT n.upravna_enota, n.id_nesreca, COUNT(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'SMRT') AS fatal_count, COUNT(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'TEZKA') AS severe_count, COUNT(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'LAHKA') AS minor_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alcohol_related FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '14.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '46.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 69 AND 54 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, n.id_nesreca ), enota_density AS ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, CAST(ue.st_prebivalcev AS numeric) / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) AS population_density, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(as1.fatal_count) AS total_fatalities, SUM(as1.severe_count) AS total_severe_injuries, SUM(as1.minor_count) AS total_minor_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN accident_stats as1 ON n.id_nesreca = as1.id_nesreca WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 60597 AND ue.povrsina > 652 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina ), ranked_enotas AS ( SELECT ed.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ed.population_density ORDER BY ed.total_accidents DESC) AS density_accident_rank, LAG(ed.total_accidents, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ed.population_density) AS prev_density_accidents, LEAD(ed.total_fatalities, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ed.population_density DESC) AS next_fatalities, AVG(ed.total_accidents) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN ed.population_density < 100 THEN 'LOW' WHEN ed.population_density < 500 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'HIGH' END) AS density_category_avg, SUM(ed.total_severe_injuries) OVER (ORDER BY ed.population_density ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_severe_injuries FROM enota_density ed WHERE ed.total_accidents > 70 ) SELECT re.ime_upravna_enota, re.st_prebivalcev, re.povrsina, re.population_density, re.total_accidents, re.total_fatalities, re.total_severe_injuries, re.total_minor_injuries, re.density_accident_rank, re.prev_density_accidents, re.next_fatalities, re.density_category_avg, re.cumulative_severe_injuries, (re.total_fatalities * 10 + re.total_severe_injuries * 3 + re.total_minor_injuries) / NULLIF(re.total_accidents, 0) AS severity_index, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY re.total_accidents DESC) AS accident_percentile, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY re.population_density DESC) AS density_rank FROM ranked_enotas re WHERE re.density_accident_rank <= 8 AND re.cumulative_severe_injuries > 782 ORDER BY re.population_density DESC, re.total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.id_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.alkotest) AS distinct_alkotest_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_age, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS avg_license_years, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS max_population, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.poskodba = 'S' AND o2.starost > (SELECT AVG(o3.starost) FROM oseba o3 WHERE o3.upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota AND o3.spol = 'M')) AS severe_injury_count_above_avg_male_age FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.alkotest >= 3.3 AND o.starost BETWEEN 74 AND 82 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 711931 GROUP BY n.id_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.alkotest) > 6 AND SUM(o.starost) < 4678 ORDER BY severe_injury_count_above_avg_male_age DESC, total_age ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 300108) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 692 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 300085 LIMIT 26 OFFSET 6 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 0.46 LIMIT 1 ) AND n.x > 504650 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 82 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x > 308860) OR n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE y < 173988) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 775 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 42 AND o.starost > 59 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 15 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota < 136 AND o.starost < 56 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) < 22 ORDER BY upravna_enota;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, MAX(o.starost) AS najvecja_starost, MIN(o.starost) AS najmanjsa_starost, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 742647 AND ue.povrsina < 4985840) AND o.starost > 52 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 520 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 0.79 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 77 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND o.starost >= 89 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 1 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 84 AND o.starost > 43 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 9 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS caused_by_driver, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(u2.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / SUM(u2.st_prebivalcev)) AS accidents_per_100k, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON n.upravna_enota = u2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost >= 94 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 836 AND (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / SUM(u2.st_prebivalcev)) > '0' ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS perpetrator_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS max_population, MIN(u.povrsina) AS min_area, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS perpetrator_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 238493 AND ue.povrsina < 8206 ) OR n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT n2.upravna_enota FROM nesreca n2 JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE o2.starost > 99 AND o2.alkotest > 2.68 GROUP BY n2.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) > 67 ) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 147 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 67 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, perpetrator_count ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '14.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.alkotest > 1.6 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 37 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 469631 AND n.y < 119565 AND n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND o.strokovni_pregled > 1.0 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 23 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <= 2 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahzje_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(u.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 400516 AND n.y > 808040 AND n.x_wgs84 > '0.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0.0' AND o.starost > 28 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll > 61 AND o.alkotest > 3.19 AND o.strokovni_pregled > 1.65 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 303904 AND u.povrsina > 6581 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 962 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 1947 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 488 AND AVG(o.starost) > 7 AND AVG(o.alkotest) > 3.97 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS caused_by_driver, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_equipment_used, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alcohol_level, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(u.st_prebivalcev), 0)) AS accidents_per_100k FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 44 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 138 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 0.43 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '{{p3}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_injury_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota BETWEEN 5 AND 80 AND (o.starost > 43 OR o.alkotest > 0.71) AND NOT (n.tip_nesreca = '{{p6}}' AND n.vzrok_nesreca = '{{p7}}') GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 45 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '{{p3}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_injury_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota BETWEEN 60 AND 153 AND o.starost > 57 AND n.x BETWEEN 167156 AND 239065 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 22 AND AVG(o.starost) < 63 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 16637) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 45.49 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 109407 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 0.68) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 895 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 399018 AND o.starost > 9 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 210 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 401828 AND o.starost >= 117 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 620 UNION SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 178137 AND o.starost <= 114 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING SUM(o.starost) < 28754 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 182240 AND o.starost >= 66 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 914 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 95472 AND o.starost >= 85 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 686 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 5 INTERSECT SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE o.starost > 45 AND o.alkotest < 0.28 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 14;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(u2.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo_enote FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON n.upravna_enota = u2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.alkotest > 2.19 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, u2.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 69 AND AVG(o.starost) < 59 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT (n.x, n.y)) AS distinct_locations, COUNT(DISTINCT (n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje)) AS distinct_roads, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_causers, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 563565 AND n.y > 833935 AND o.starost >= 43 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 760 AND AVG(o.starost) < 90 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC, population_per_accident ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS distinct_genders_involved, SUM(o.alkotest) AS total_alkotest, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 57321 AND n.y > 558034 AND o.alkotest > 2.94 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 3 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS distinct_genders_involved, SUM(o.starost) AS total_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 18 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 251 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 7355 AND o.starost > 100 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > (SELECT AVG(st_prebivalcev) / 1000 FROM upravna_enota) ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost > 7 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 443 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS osebe_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_starost_m, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_starost_z FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 414752 AND n.y < 296958 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 43 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 365897 ) OR n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue3.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue3 WHERE ue3.povrsina < 7016 ) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 77 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost >= 49 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 554 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '{{p3}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_injury_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 981159 AND ue2.povrsina BETWEEN 4600 AND 12397) AND o.starost > 29 AND n.x BETWEEN 214880 AND 1165726 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 109 AND AVG(o.starost) < 57 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '{{p3}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_injury_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 287923) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.31 AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '{{p4}}') AND n.x BETWEEN 499070 AND 566603 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 608 AND AVG(o.starost) BETWEEN 34 AND 23 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost >= 68 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 217 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, (SELECT AVG(o2.starost) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost >= 95 AND n.kategorija_cesta = '1' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 534 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' AND o.starost >= 45 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 277 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, MAX(sub.max_alcohol) AS max_alcohol_found, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > (SELECT AVG(alkotest) FROM oseba WHERE alkotest IS NOT NULL)) AS high_alcohol_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca LEFT JOIN ( SELECT upravna_enota, MAX(alkotest) AS max_alcohol FROM oseba WHERE alkotest IS NOT NULL AND alkotest > 2.25 GROUP BY upravna_enota ) sub ON ue.id_upravna_enota = sub.upravna_enota WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.klas_nesreca = 'A' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 802606 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 638 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, fatal_injuries DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS accident_month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '299' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2015-01-01' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 42 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, accident_month;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS accident_month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS population_per_accident, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS accidents_last_3_months FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 97 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 459660 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 88 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, accident_month DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS cetrtletje_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca || o.spol || o.drzavljanstvo || o.vrsta_udelezenca) AS stevilo_razlicnih_udelezencev, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(ue.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_vzroku, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.alkotest >= 1.21 AND o.starost >= 52 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 224637 AND ue.povrsina >= 8168 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 192 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 224 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 0.89 ORDER BY leto_nesreca DESC, cetrtletje_nesreca DESC, stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_smrti DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_female_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (22) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 93 ORDER BY year, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatalities, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_year FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE alkotest > 0.7 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 941) AND (n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' OR n.tip_nesreca = '1') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o2.starost BETWEEN 25 AND 22) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 40 AND AVG(o.starost) < 50.34 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year, month;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_female_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.poskodba = 'B' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year, quarter HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 71 ORDER BY year DESC, quarter DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injury_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (46) AND o.alkotest >= 0.92 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year, quarter HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 22 ORDER BY year DESC, quarter DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza_ll, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS prebivalci_na_nesreco, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_cesti, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI'))) AS nesrece_prejšnje_leto FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN 13.13 AND 13.61 AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN 45.67 AND 45.65 AND o.starost BETWEEN 53 AND 67 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 586755 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 446 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) < 0.58 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, leto_nesreca;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS povprecno_prebivalstvo_na_enoto, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_cesti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 56 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 388871 AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN ('A', 'A') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, u.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 989 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) > 1.88 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_zrtvi, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezko_poškodovani, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lažje_poškodovani, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_meseci, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecna_vrednost_alkotesta, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest_d = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pozitivni_alkotesti, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) AS povprecna_vrednost_strokovnega_pregleda, SUM(CASE WHEN o.strokovni_pregled_d = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pozitivni_strokovni_pregledi, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uporaba_varnostnega_pasu_ali_celade, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%' AND n.tekst_odsek_ali_ulica LIKE '%' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND n.cas_nesreca <= '00:00' AND o.starost >= 35 AND o.starost <= 36 AND o.alkotest >= 2.52 AND o.alkotest <= 1.44 AND o.strokovni_pregled >= 0.4 AND o.strokovni_pregled <= 2.43 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 351901 AND ue.st_prebivalcev <= 169911 AND ue.povrsina >= 8507 AND ue.povrsina <= 7019 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 16 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 479 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 32 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lazje_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zensk, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_vozniskega_staza, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 1.97 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_visjih_alkotestov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE ( (n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 194755 AND povrsina < 3760)) AND (n.tip_nesreca = '1' OR n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' OR n.vzrok_nesreca = '2') AND (n.vreme_nesreca NOT IN ('1', '2') OR n.stanje_promet = '3') AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')) BETWEEN 2018 AND 2022) AND (o.starost >= 67 OR o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 32) AND (o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca IN ('1', '2', '3')) ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 78 AND AVG(o.starost) < 26 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(o.id_nesreca)) OVER ( PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota = 62 AND o.starost >= 69 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 47 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD'));

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(DISTINCT o.alkotest) AS stevilo_alkotestov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_pozitivnih_alkotestov, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecna_vrednost_alkotesta, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_meseci, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.strokovni_pregled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_strokovnih_pregledov, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(u.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(o.alkotest) DESC) AS gostota_alkotesta, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 152910 AND n.y > 604099 AND o.starost > 16 AND o.alkotest > 2.43 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 137199 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 523 AND AVG(o.alkotest) > 2.21 AND SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) > 979831 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_vrednost_alkotesta DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 85 AND o.starost >= 30 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 7 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE (n.tip_nesreca = '1' OR n.vreme_nesreca = '1') AND NOT (n.klas_nesreca = '1') AND o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o.starost >= 116 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 71 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS st_nesrec, COUNT(DISTINCT o.starost) AS st_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povp_starost, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS st_z_varnostnim_pasom, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 49 AND o.alkotest >= 1.56 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 28 AND AVG(o.starost) > 41 ORDER BY st_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_oseb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS prebivalci_na_nesreco, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 24 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 810006 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 28 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 491 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 72 AND o.starost > 98 GROUP BY CUBE (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 29 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 114 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, n.id_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 501 AND AVG(o.alkotest) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_perpetrator_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca)) AS person_percentile FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 54 AND n.x BETWEEN 34564 AND 83011 AND o.starost >= 42 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 129138 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 36 AND AVG(o.starost) < 52 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accident_rank;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zenskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti, STDDEV(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS standardni_odklon_starosti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE ( (n.x BETWEEN 715580 AND 382724 AND n.y BETWEEN 469014 AND 133239) OR (n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0') ) AND n.cas_nesreca IS NOT NULL AND ( (n.vzrok_nesreca IN ('A', 'A', 'A') AND n.tip_nesreca = 'A') OR (n.vreme_nesreca = 'A' AND n.stanje_promet = 'A') OR (n.stanje_vozisce = 'A' AND n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce = 'A' AND n.opis_prizorisce = 'A') ) AND NOT (n.klas_nesreca = 'A' AND n.naselje_ali_izven = 'D') AND n.kategorija_cesta NOT IN ('A', 'A') AND o.starost >= 24 AND ( (o.alkotest > 0.79 AND o.strokovni_pregled = 0.32) OR (o.vozniski_staz_ll < 22 AND o.vozniski_staz_mm < 1) OR (o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' AND o.spol = 'M') ) AND o.drzavljanstvo = 'A' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca != 'A' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 876369 AND ue.povrsina BETWEEN 8628 AND 4998 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 751 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 2679 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 39 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC LIMIT 114;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS enota1, ue2.ime_upravna_enota AS enota2, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n1.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) AS leto, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o1.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o1.starost) FILTER (WHERE o1.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o1.starost) FILTER (WHERE o1.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o1.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta, SUM(u1.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(u2.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina FROM nesreca n1 JOIN nesreca n2 ON n1.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n1.id_nesreca <> n2.id_nesreca JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca AND o1.spol = o2.spol JOIN upravna_enota ue1 ON n1.upravna_enota = ue1.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON n2.upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u1 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = u1.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON ue2.id_upravna_enota = u2.id_upravna_enota WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n1.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) BETWEEN 2014 AND 2015 AND n1.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n2.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o1.alkotest >= 2.14 AND o2.starost >= 47 GROUP BY ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue2.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n1.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 81 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o1.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 14 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupno_prebivalstvo ASC;

WITH accident_stats AS ( SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS unique_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_causers FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota ), enriched_stats AS ( SELECT a.upravna_enota, a.total_accidents, a.unique_accidents, a.avg_age_involved, a.num_causers, u.st_prebivalcev, u.povrsina, (a.total_accidents * 100000.0 / u.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_100k, (a.num_causers * 100.0 / a.total_accidents) AS causer_percentage FROM accident_stats a JOIN upravna_enota u ON a.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE u.st_prebivalcev > 84881 ), window_stats AS ( SELECT e.*, AVG(e.accidents_per_100k) OVER (ORDER BY e.upravna_enota ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_accidents, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY e.causer_percentage DESC) AS causer_rank, LAG(e.total_accidents, 1) OVER (ORDER BY e.upravna_enota) AS prev_total_accidents FROM enriched_stats e WHERE e.accidents_per_100k > 875.6 ) SELECT w.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, w.total_accidents, w.unique_accidents, w.avg_age_involved, w.num_causers, w.st_prebivalcev, w.povrsina, w.accidents_per_100k, w.causer_percentage, w.moving_avg_accidents, w.causer_rank, w.prev_total_accidents, (w.total_accidents - COALESCE(w.prev_total_accidents, 0)) AS accident_change, CASE WHEN w.causer_percentage > 49.89 THEN 'HIGH_RISK' WHEN w.causer_percentage > 18.66 THEN 'MEDIUM_RISK' ELSE 'LOW_RISK' END AS risk_category FROM window_stats w JOIN upravna_enota u ON w.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE w.moving_avg_accidents > 181.82 AND w.total_accidents > 158 ORDER BY w.accidents_per_100k DESC, w.causer_percentage DESC LIMIT 29;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 187282) AND o.starost > 39 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 525 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, (SELECT AVG(u.st_prebivalcev) FROM upravna_enota u WHERE u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota) AS avg_population FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 625 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, (SELECT AVG(u.st_prebivalcev) FROM upravna_enota u WHERE u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota) AS avg_population FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 705 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS nesreca_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 809523 AND n.y < 460979 AND o.starost >= 79 AND o.alkotest <= 0.25 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 636 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 3.77 EXCEPT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS nesreca_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x <= 250692 AND n.y >= 506695 AND o.starost < 74 AND o.alkotest > 4.45 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) <= 360 OR AVG(o.alkotest) >= 3.18 ORDER BY nesreca_rank;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 8 AND o.starost BETWEEN 90 AND 68 AND n.vzrok_nesreca = 'A' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 197 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota) AS population_in_unit, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca) AS accidents_by_cause_per_unit FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.alkotest >= 2.93 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, u.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 741 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 92 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_male;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezke_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahke_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm/12.0) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_leta, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s_pasom_ali_celado, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS brez_pasa_ali_celade, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS povzrocitelji, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS udelezenci, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS moski, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zenske, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vozniki_motornega_vozila, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS potniki_motornega_vozila, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kolesarji, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pešci, u.st_prebivalcev, u.povrsina, u.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(u.povrsina, 0) AS gostota_prebivalstva, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) / NULLIF(u.st_prebivalcev, 0) * 100000 AS nesrece_na_100k_prebivalcev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost > 73 AND o.alkotest > 0.61 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 235716 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, u.st_prebivalcev, u.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 540 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 2114 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 241 AND AVG(o.starost) > 111 AND u.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(u.povrsina, 0) > '0' ORDER BY nesrece_na_100k_prebivalcev DESC, stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zascitenih, (u.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(u.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS percent_rank_nesrece FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 42 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) BETWEEN 2010 AND 2011 AND o.starost BETWEEN 11 AND 44 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND u.st_prebivalcev > 166421 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, leto_nesreca, gostota_prebivalstva), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, leto_nesreca), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, leto_nesreca), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, leto_nesreca), (n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, leto_nesreca), (leto_nesreca), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 943 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 1483 ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, leto_nesreca DESC, stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.poskodba, o.vrsta_udelezenca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo_enote, SUM(u.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina_enote FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 >= '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 <= '45.0' AND n.x >= 491470 AND n.y <= 170363 AND o.starost >= 57 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 78 AND o.alkotest >= 0.2 AND u.st_prebivalcev >= 452615 AND u.povrsina <= 2990 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.poskodba, o.vrsta_udelezenca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 78 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 478 AND AVG(o.starost) < 33 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_equipment_used, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) DESC) AS prev_accident_count_by_density FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 6 AND o.alkotest >= 2.66 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 841 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 33 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age_involved, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS high_alc_percentile, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS avg_driving_experience_years, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS accidents_with_culprit FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 65 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 215 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) < 15 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 1.22) AS accidents_with_high_alcohol, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience_years, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / ue.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_100k_inhabitants FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 35) AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vreme_nesreca IN ('1', '1') AND n.stanje_promet = '1' AND o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' AND o.starost BETWEEN 73 AND 36 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 0.76 AND o2.poskodba IN ('1', '2')) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 80 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 26 AND (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / ue.st_prebivalcev) > '10.0' ORDER BY accidents_per_100k_inhabitants DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_causers, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_test, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(u.st_prebivalcev), 0)) AS accidents_per_100k FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 15 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 246 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) > 0.34 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s_pasom_ali_celado, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec_po_vzroku FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0.0' AND o.starost >= 3 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 28 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 17.27 ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n1.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_starost_povzrocitelj, SUM(CASE WHEN n2.klas_nesreca = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS klas_1_count FROM nesreca n1 JOIN nesreca n2 ON n1.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n1.id_nesreca != n2.id_nesreca JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca AND o1.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n1.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n1.tip_nesreca = '1' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 538456 GROUP BY n1.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 80 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n1.upravna_enota, n1.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_starost_povzrocitelj, SUM(CASE WHEN n2.klas_nesreca = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_nesrece_count FROM nesreca n1 JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca AND o1.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' JOIN nesreca n2 ON n1.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n1.tip_nesreca = n2.tip_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n1.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n1.x > 309142 AND n1.y > 405218 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 5144883 GROUP BY n1.upravna_enota, n1.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 43 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o WHERE o.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o.starost >= 35 AND o.alkotest >= 1.02 ) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 25 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 155043 AND o.starost > 6 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 835 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 517333 AND o.starost > 10 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 486 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 596074 AND o.starost >= 11 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 995 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 997898 AND o.starost >= 42 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 147 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IS NULL AND u.st_prebivalcev > 22420 AND u.povrsina < 946660 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 83 AND o.starost >= 58 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 7 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;
