SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY') >= '2010-01-01' AND o.starost >= 58 AND o.alkotest >= 1.41 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 43 ORDER BY ue.id_upravna_enota, year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(o.alkotest) AS total_alcohol FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '100000' AND n.y_wgs84 < '100000' AND o.starost >= 76 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 5 AND AVG(o.starost) < 31 INTERSECT SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(o.alkotest) AS total_alcohol FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 261677 AND n.y < 103566 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 47 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 6 AND SUM(o.alkotest) > 0.5 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responsible_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 64 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 6 AND AVG(o.starost) < 55 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 205377 AND o.starost > 26 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > (SELECT AVG(st_prebivalcev) / 1000 FROM upravna_enota) ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 628618 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 3.87) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 355 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '14000000' AND n.y_wgs84 < '4500000' AND o.starost >= 68 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 5 AND AVG(o.starost) < 49 INTERSECT SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 < '14000000' AND n.y_wgs84 > '4500000' AND o.starost <= 39 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) < 29 AND AVG(o.starost) > 41 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND n.cas_nesreca <= '2015-01-01' AND o.poskodba = 'H' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 4 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_zrtvi, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS mediana_gostote_prebivalstva, SUM(CASE WHEN n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.63) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nesrece_z_alkotestom FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 83761 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 232 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 17 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o2.id_nesreca) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.poskodba = 'S' ) AS count_severe_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON o.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' AND o.starost >= 18 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 214 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost > 28 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 20 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS accidents_with_culprits, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatalities, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS median_x_coordinate, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y) AS median_y_coordinate, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS population, MAX(u.povrsina) AS area, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS fatality_rank FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca LEFT JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND (n.x BETWEEN 522401 AND 51808 OR n.x IS NULL) AND (n.y BETWEEN 14869 AND 413626 OR n.y IS NULL) AND (o.starost >= 31 OR o.starost IS NULL) AND (u.st_prebivalcev >= 975382 OR u.st_prebivalcev IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 1224 AND (SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 796 OR SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) IS NULL) ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_male DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND o.starost >= 27 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 837 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS p75_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost >= 61 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 276 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS high_alcohol_percentile FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND o.starost >= 98 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 88 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '1') AS avg_age_male, (SELECT AVG(o2.alkotest) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 0) AS avg_positive_alcohol FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost >= 81 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 695 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '2020-01-01' OR n.cas_nesreca IS NULL GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 21 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS accident_month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS drunk_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' AND o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS responsible_drivers, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))) AS prev_month_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '262 days') AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 82 AND 65 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 167746 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 15 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 37 ORDER BY accident_month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_v_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 > '0' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 993) AND o.starost > 17 AND (o.alkotest > 0.49 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 702 AND AVG(o.starost) < 49 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, leto_nesreca;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_in_unit FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 99 AND 23 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 72) AND (n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' OR n.tip_nesreca = '1') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 436 AND AVG(o.starost) < 28 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year, month;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS month, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_causers, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_equipment_used, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS accidents_per_100k, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_in_unit_year FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2011 AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 241127) AND o.starost >= 89 AND (o.alkotest > 1.69 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year, month, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 27 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 43 ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, total_accidents DESC, accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS skupno_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lazje_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zensk, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nad_limitom_alkohola, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V') AS nesrece_z_voznikom, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 51 AND 62 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 963) AND (n.x BETWEEN 707689 AND 805314 OR n.y BETWEEN 755048 AND 960759) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 9 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 15 ORDER BY skupno_nesrec DESC, leto_nesreca ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_poskodba, (COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS nesrece_na_100k_prebivalcev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.kategorija_cesta = n2.kategorija_cesta JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca AND o.spol = o2.spol WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 98 AND n.vzrok_nesreca = 'A' AND n.tip_nesreca = 'A' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'A' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 143 AND AVG(o.alkotest) > 2.46 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 49 ORDER BY nesrece_na_100k_prebivalcev DESC, stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol || '|' || o.drzavljanstvo) AS distinct_gender_citizenship_combos, COUNT(DISTINCT o.vrsta_udelezenca) AS distinct_participant_types, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_test, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev) AS median_population, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_road_category FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 20 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 64 AND 51 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 222605 AND ue.povrsina > 283 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 38 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) > 1.97 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC, avg_alcohol_test DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, '; ' ORDER BY n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje) AS seznam_cest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0) AS mediana_alkotesta FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost BETWEEN 25 AND 43 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 543047 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 8 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 431 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_cesti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > (SELECT AVG(st_prebivalcev) / 1000.0 FROM upravna_enota WHERE povrsina > 73384) ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS persons_per_100k, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_in_unit FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2022 AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND y_wgs84 > '45.0' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 612) AND o.starost >= 96 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')), ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 93 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 10 AND (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 > 841.44 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, persons_per_100k DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(*) AS person_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_test, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT ue.id_upravna_enota) AS avg_population_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_cause FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 83 AND o.alkotest >= 1.23 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 24707 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, year, month), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, year, month), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, year, month), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, year, month), (n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, year, month), (n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, year, month), (n.kategorija_cesta, year, month), (year, month), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 68 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4 ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zenskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti, STDDEV(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS standardni_odklon_starosti, (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS udelezenci_na_100k_prebivalcev, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_nesrec_na_km2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_stevilu_nesrec, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_stevilu_udelezencev, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS rang_po_smrtnih_zrtvah FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%' AND n.tekst_odsek_ali_ulica LIKE '%' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 55 AND 35 AND o.alkotest BETWEEN 0.16 AND 1.67 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll BETWEEN 4 AND 37 AND o.vozniski_staz_mm BETWEEN 8 AND 4 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 637398 AND ue.povrsina > 1898 AND (o.vrsta_udelezenca LIKE '%' OR o.drzavljanstvo LIKE '%') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tip_nesreca, SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'S' AND o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'N') AS nesrece_brez_varnostnega_pasa_smrtne, MAX(sub.max_staz) AS najdaljsi_vozniski_staz_v_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN ( SELECT upravna_enota, MAX(vozniski_staz_ll) AS max_staz FROM oseba WHERE vozniski_staz_ll > 9 AND starost BETWEEN 100 AND 64 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 122 ) sub ON ue.id_upravna_enota = sub.upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca IS NOT NULL AND o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 4 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 0.68 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupna_starost_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahzje_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s_pasom_ali_celado, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 960202 AND povrsina < 37675) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 24 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 451 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lazje_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_vrednost_alkotesta, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_vzroku, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota) AS skupno_nesrec_v_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 34 AND o.starost BETWEEN 8 AND 60 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 240694 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 21 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 10 ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, rang_nesrec_po_vzroku;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS udelezenci_na_100k_prebivalcev, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah_v_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 42 AND o.starost BETWEEN 50 AND 99 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND ue.povrsina > 6211 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 14 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 60 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_mesci, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_udelezcih_po_vzroku FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 462684 AND ue.povrsina <= 1241 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 74 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 26 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_mesci, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(u.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS globalni_rang_udelezencev FROM nesreca n INNER JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca LEFT JOIN upravna_enota u ON o.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 138346 AND ue.povrsina BETWEEN 2554921 AND 9156151 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 40 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 92 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_mesec, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zenskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.drzavljanstvo = 'SLO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_slovencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_staza_let FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 485928 AND ue.povrsina > 7474 AND (o.alkotest IS NULL OR o.alkotest <= 0.4) AND (o.strokovni_pregled IS NULL OR o.strokovni_pregled <= 0.01) AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 69 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 226 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti_udelezencev, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS percentil_90_vozniskega_staza, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS percentil_75_alkotesta, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.drzavljanstvo != 'SLO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_tujcev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, (ue.st_prebivalcev::numeric / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 74 AND o.alkotest >= 1.48 AND o.strokovni_pregled >= 3.42 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 80 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 289 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS parent_region, ue2.ime_upravna_enota AS child_region, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue1.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_in_parent, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue1.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY ue2.st_prebivalcev) AS prev_accident_count_by_population FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota AND ue1.povrsina > 6770 JOIN nesreca n ON ue2.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost BETWEEN 85 AND 18 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY ue1.id_upravna_enota, ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue2.id_upravna_enota, ue2.ime_upravna_enota, ue2.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 94 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 16 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, parent_region, child_region;

WITH accident_stats AS ( SELECT n.id_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, n.x_wgs84, n.y_wgs84, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_causers FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' GROUP BY n.id_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, n.x_wgs84, n.y_wgs84 ), unit_stats AS ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(a.persons_involved) AS total_persons, AVG(a.avg_age) AS avg_accident_age, SUM(a.num_causers) AS total_causers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(a.persons_involved)) AS persons_percentile FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN accident_stats a ON ue.id_upravna_enota = a.upravna_enota WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 13527 AND ue.povrsina BETWEEN 696 AND 1378 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.id_nesreca) >= 25 ) SELECT us.id_upravna_enota, us.ime_upravna_enota, us.st_prebivalcev, us.povrsina, us.total_accidents, us.total_persons, us.avg_accident_age, us.total_causers, us.accident_rank, us.persons_percentile, ROUND(us.total_accidents * 100000.0 / us.st_prebivalcev, 2) AS accidents_per_100k, ROUND(us.total_persons * 100.0 / us.total_accidents, 2) AS avg_persons_per_accident, LAG(us.total_accidents) OVER (PARTITION BY us.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY us.total_accidents) AS prev_accidents FROM unit_stats us ORDER BY us.accident_rank, us.persons_percentile DESC;

WITH accident_stats AS ( SELECT n.upravna_enota, n.id_nesreca, COUNT(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'SMRT') AS fatal_count, COUNT(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'TEZKA') AS severe_count, COUNT(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'LAHKA') AS minor_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alcohol_related FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '14.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '46.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 80 AND 30 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, n.id_nesreca ), enota_density AS ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, CAST(ue.st_prebivalcev AS numeric) / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) AS population_density, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(as1.fatal_count) AS total_fatalities, SUM(as1.severe_count) AS total_severe_injuries, SUM(as1.minor_count) AS total_minor_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN accident_stats as1 ON n.id_nesreca = as1.id_nesreca WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 40596 AND ue.povrsina > 629 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina ), ranked_enotas AS ( SELECT ed.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ed.population_density ORDER BY ed.total_accidents DESC) AS density_accident_rank, LAG(ed.total_accidents, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ed.population_density) AS prev_density_accidents, LEAD(ed.total_fatalities, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ed.population_density DESC) AS next_fatalities, AVG(ed.total_accidents) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN ed.population_density < 100 THEN 'LOW' WHEN ed.population_density < 500 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'HIGH' END) AS density_category_avg, SUM(ed.total_severe_injuries) OVER (ORDER BY ed.population_density ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_severe_injuries FROM enota_density ed WHERE ed.total_accidents > 79 ) SELECT re.ime_upravna_enota, re.st_prebivalcev, re.povrsina, re.population_density, re.total_accidents, re.total_fatalities, re.total_severe_injuries, re.total_minor_injuries, re.density_accident_rank, re.prev_density_accidents, re.next_fatalities, re.density_category_avg, re.cumulative_severe_injuries, (re.total_fatalities * 10 + re.total_severe_injuries * 3 + re.total_minor_injuries) / NULLIF(re.total_accidents, 0) AS severity_index, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY re.total_accidents DESC) AS accident_percentile, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY re.population_density DESC) AS density_rank FROM ranked_enotas re WHERE re.density_accident_rank <= 9 AND re.cumulative_severe_injuries > 377 ORDER BY re.population_density DESC, re.total_accidents DESC;

n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 27 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 76 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 79 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC LIMIT 289;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 1 AND o.starost BETWEEN 12 AND 97 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 15 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_driver_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 49 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 126537 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 26 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') > 32 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accident_rank;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnimi_pasovi, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zenskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.drzavljanstvo != 'SLO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_tujcev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS udelezenci_na_100k_preb, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_nesrec_na_km2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_udelezcih, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS rang_po_smrtnih_zrtvah FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 458957 AND ue2.povrsina < 8489) AND o.starost BETWEEN 56 AND 27 AND o.alkotest >= 1.94 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND o2.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 19 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 301 AND AVG(o.starost) < 69 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT n.id_nesreca, COUNT(o.starost) AS participant_count FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota = 22 AND o.starost >= 78 GROUP BY n.id_nesreca HAVING COUNT(o.starost) > 5 INTERSECT SELECT n.id_nesreca, COUNT(o.starost) AS participant_count FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota = 80 AND o.starost <= 61 GROUP BY n.id_nesreca HAVING COUNT(o.starost) < 19 ORDER BY participant_count DESC;

SELECT n.id_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.alkotest) AS distinct_alkotest_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_age, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS avg_license_years, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS max_population, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.poskodba = 'S' AND o2.starost > (SELECT AVG(o3.starost) FROM oseba o3 WHERE o3.upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota AND o3.spol = 'M')) AS severe_injury_count_above_avg_male_age FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.alkotest >= 3.71 AND o.starost BETWEEN 47 AND 58 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 488956 GROUP BY n.id_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.alkotest) > 6 AND SUM(o.starost) < 3182 ORDER BY severe_injury_count_above_avg_male_age DESC, total_age ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 49 AND o.starost BETWEEN 18 AND 58 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 35 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(u2.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON o.upravna_enota = u2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) = 2017 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 53 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 3.95 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(u2.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON o.upravna_enota = u2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 15812 AND n.y < 28744 AND o.starost BETWEEN 96 AND 56 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 22 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 40 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 77 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 258 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 31 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x BETWEEN 498524 AND 409389 AND n.y BETWEEN 181923 AND 110114 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 7 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 753 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 26 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 2.67) AS accidents_with_alcohol, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS population, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(MAX(u.st_prebivalcev), 0)) AS accidents_per_100k FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IS NOT NULL AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost >= 82 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 306 AND (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(MAX(u.st_prebivalcev), 0)) > '50.0' ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_exp FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '14.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.alkotest > 1.9 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 3 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 EXCEPT SELECT n2.upravna_enota, u2.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca), SUM(CASE WHEN o2.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), AVG(o2.starost) FILTER (WHERE o2.spol = 'M'), PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o2.vozniski_staz_ll) FROM nesreca n2 JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON n2.upravna_enota = u2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n2.kategorija_cesta = '1' AND o2.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' GROUP BY n2.upravna_enota, u2.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o2.alkotest) > 2.36 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injury_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injury_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_test, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience_years FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 19 AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND o.starost BETWEEN 70 AND 68 AND o.alkotest >= 0.68 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, year), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, year), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, year), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, year), (n.upravna_enota, year), (year), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 678 ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, year, accident_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezko_poškodovani, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udeležencev, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('1','2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS globalni_rang_hujsih_poskodb FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.alkotest >= 3.07 AND o.starost BETWEEN 70 AND 59 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 752 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('1','2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 719 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, globalni_rang_hujsih_poskodb;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_equipment_used, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) DESC) AS prev_accident_count_by_density FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 89 AND o.alkotest >= 3.27 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 754 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 12 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, SUM(o.starost) AS total_age_involved FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 557142 AND o.starost > 86 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 571 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o WHERE o.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o.starost >= 28 AND o.alkotest >= 0.82 ) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 69 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 806583) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 34.38 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT u2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota u2 WHERE u2.st_prebivalcev > 467785) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 19 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 738024 AND o.starost >= 59 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 277 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 780547 AND o.starost > 62 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 391 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 645134 AND o.starost > 64 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota UNION ALL SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 246458 AND o.alkotest IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_povzrocitelj FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 277800) AND o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 893 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '14.0' AND o.starost >= 37 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 17 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 100 AND o.starost >= 60 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 5 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_povzrocitelj_age, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 9 AND o.starost BETWEEN 24 AND 53 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 37 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) as nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) as avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 35 AND o.starost BETWEEN 28 AND 61 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 17 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 953 AND o.starost > 92 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 975 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN o.id_nesreca END) AS distinct_accidents_caused, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN o.id_nesreca END) AS distinct_accidents_with_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN o.id_nesreca END) AS distinct_accidents_with_fatal_injury, COUNT(DISTINCT n.x || ',' || n.y) AS distinct_locations, COUNT(DISTINCT n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje) AS distinct_road_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT n.tip_nesreca) AS distinct_accident_types, COUNT(DISTINCT n.vzrok_nesreca) AS distinct_accident_causes, COUNT(DISTINCT n.vreme_nesreca) AS distinct_weather_conditions, COUNT(DISTINCT n.stanje_promet) AS distinct_traffic_conditions, COUNT(DISTINCT n.stanje_vozisce) AS distinct_road_surface_conditions, COUNT(DISTINCT n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce) AS distinct_pavement_conditions, COUNT(DISTINCT n.opis_prizorisce) AS distinct_scene_descriptions, COUNT(DISTINCT n.klas_nesreca) AS distinct_accident_classes, COUNT(DISTINCT n.naselje_ali_izven) AS distinct_settlement_types, COUNT(DISTINCT n.kategorija_cesta) AS distinct_road_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS distinct_genders_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT o.drzavljanstvo) AS distinct_nationalities_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada) AS distinct_safety_equipment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.alkotest_d) AS distinct_breathalyzer_results, COUNT(DISTINCT o.strokovni_pregled_d) AS distinct_professional_exam_results, COUNT(DISTINCT o.starost_d) AS distinct_age_groups, COUNT(DISTINCT o.vozniski_staz_d) AS distinct_driving_experience_groups, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_breathalyzer, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) AS avg_professional_exam, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS avg_driving_experience_years, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS avg_driving_experience_months, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_causers, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_drivers, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 807053 AND n.y > 907893 AND o.starost > 101 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 438073 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 337 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 660 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC, distinct_accidents_with_persons DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS distinct_genders_involved, SUM(o.starost) AS total_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 31 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 593 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS perpetrator_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost > 42 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 753 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS osebe_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 470194 ) OR n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue3.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue3 WHERE ue3.povrsina < 32056 ) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 56 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '14.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > (SELECT AVG(st_prebivalcev) / 1000 FROM upravna_enota) ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_zrtvi, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS mediana_gostote_prebivalstva, SUM(CASE WHEN n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.51) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nesrece_z_alkotestom FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 396989 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 931 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 40 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 17269 AND o.starost >= 79 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota UNION ALL SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 725033 AND o.starost <= 15 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o2.id_nesreca) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.poskodba = 'S' ) AS count_severe_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON o.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' AND o.starost >= 67 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 669 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 > '14.0' AND id_nesreca IN ( SELECT id_nesreca FROM oseba WHERE starost > 31 AND alkotest > 0.15 ) ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 16 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_oseba, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS povzrocitelj_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)::numeric / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0) * 100000, 2) AS accidents_per_100k, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 0.13 AND o2.starost BETWEEN 71 AND 57 ) AND n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 84647 ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 5334 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 119 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN o.id_nesreca END) AS accidents_with_causers, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatalities, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS median_x_coordinate, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y) AS median_y_coordinate, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / ue.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_million_inhabitants FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota AND n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca AND o.starost BETWEEN 20 AND 96 AND o.alkotest > 1.25 WHERE ue.povrsina > 5349 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 296786 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 92 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 36 ORDER BY accidents_per_million_inhabitants DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN o.id_nesreca END) AS accidents_with_causers, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS median_alkotest, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / ue.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_million_inhabitants FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '2020-01-01' AND (n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' OR n.x_wgs84 IS NULL) AND ue.povrsina > 8999 AND (o.alkotest > 1.91 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 385 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 21 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accidents_per_million_inhabitants DESC;
