SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota) AS population_in_unit, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca) AS accidents_by_cause_per_unit FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.alkotest >= 2.72 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, u.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 851 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 73 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_male;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota) AS population_in_unit, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY MIN(CAST(SUBSTRING(n.cas_nesreca FROM 1 FOR 2) AS INTEGER))) AS prev_accident_count FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.alkotest >= 1.1 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, u.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 586 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 47 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, MAX(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS max_starost_m, MIN(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS min_starost_z, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_staz_ll, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesreca FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 74 AND 7 AND o.alkotest >= 3.21 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 418 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 1.67 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, MAX(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS max_starost_m, MIN(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS min_starost_z, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_staz_ll, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesreca FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 < '0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 9 AND o.strokovni_pregled >= 4.18 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 264 AND AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) < 1.71 ORDER BY rank_nesreca;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezke_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahke_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm/12.0) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_leta, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s_pasom_ali_celado, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS brez_pasa_ali_celade, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS povzrocitelji, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS udelezenci, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS moski, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zenske, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vozniki_motornega_vozila, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS potniki_motornega_vozila, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kolesarji, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pešci, u.st_prebivalcev, u.povrsina, u.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(u.povrsina, 0) AS gostota_prebivalstva, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) / NULLIF(u.st_prebivalcev, 0) * 100000 AS nesrece_na_100k_prebivalcev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost > 101 AND o.alkotest > 4.0 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 759048 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, u.st_prebivalcev, u.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 972 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 2324 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 290 AND AVG(o.starost) > 96 AND u.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(u.povrsina, 0) > '0' ORDER BY nesrece_na_100k_prebivalcev DESC, stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS prebivalci_na_enoto, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_vzroku, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca) AS skupne_nesrece_po_tipu FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.vzrok_nesreca = n2.vzrok_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.alkotest > 2.52 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 981862 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 67 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, rang_nesrec_po_vzroku ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_causers, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population, SUM(u.povrsina) AS total_area FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (134, 385, 177) AND o.starost >= 26 AND o.alkotest >= 2.27 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, year, month), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, year, month), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, year, month), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, year, month), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, year, month), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota), (n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, year, month), (n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, year, month), (n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, year, month), (n.vzrok_nesreca, year, month), (year, month), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 16 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 9 ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, year, month, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE (n.x_wgs84 > '-180' OR n.y_wgs84 < '-90') AND NOT (o.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 86) AND (u.st_prebivalcev >= 18325 OR u.povrsina <= 746) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 36 AND AVG(o.starost) < 23 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '{{p3}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_injury_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota BETWEEN 84 AND 107 AND (o.starost > 52 OR o.alkotest > 0.77) AND NOT (n.tip_nesreca = '{{p6}}' AND n.vzrok_nesreca = '{{p7}}') GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 6 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 571473 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 3.92) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 492 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND o.starost >= 35 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > (SELECT AVG(st_prebivalcev) / 1000 FROM upravna_enota WHERE povrsina > 3772) ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS povzrocitelj_count FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE u.st_prebivalcev > 40217 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 690 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 245654 AND o.starost > 71 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota UNION ALL SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 132633 AND o.alkotest > 3.79 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost >= 77 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota UNION SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost <= 71 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost > 31 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 221 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 822955) AND n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 90 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 16 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota = 84 AND DATE_PART('year', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY')) = 2016 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 27 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 67 AND o.starost >= 71 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 14 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 54 AND o.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 33 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 29 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 834 AND o.starost >= 61 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, o.spol, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE o.starost > 21 AND n.upravna_enota > 68 GROUP BY CUBE (u.ime_upravna_enota, o.spol, n.vzrok_nesreca) HAVING COUNT(*) > 871 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS accident_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 24 AND 35 AND id_nesreca IN ( SELECT id_nesreca FROM nesreca WHERE x BETWEEN 328979 AND 489797 ) ) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 33 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS distinct_genders_involved, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost >= 74 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 875 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota EXCEPT SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE o.alkotest > 1.05 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%cesta%' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 16 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 938113 AND o.starost >= 72 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 389 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 3.08 AND o2.starost BETWEEN 28 AND 62 ORDER BY o2.alkotest DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 72 ) AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 9931 AND AVG(o.starost) BETWEEN 102 AND 38 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_involved;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN o.id_nesreca END) AS accidents_with_causers, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS median_alkotest, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / ue.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_million_inhabitants FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '2020-01-01' AND (n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' OR n.x_wgs84 IS NULL) AND ue.povrsina > 8994 AND (o.alkotest > 0.71 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 874 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 20 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accidents_per_million_inhabitants DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS percentile_75_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost > 8 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 668 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS p75_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND o.starost > 72 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 193 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 405406 AND o.starost > 54 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 2.46 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 13 ORDER BY month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS month, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatalities, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience, CORR(o.alkotest, o.starost) AS correlation_alcohol_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost > 93 AND alkotest > 1.4 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 898) AND (n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' OR n.tip_nesreca = '1') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o2.vrsta_udelezenca = '1') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year, month, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 15 AND AVG(o.starost) < 90 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year, month;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS mesec_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_vrednost_alkotesta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(ue.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev), 0), 2) AS nesrece_na_milijon_prebivalcev, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_tip_nesrece_po_letu_in_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 287246 AND povrsina > 7386) AND o.starost BETWEEN 41 AND 82 AND (o.alkotest > 0.34 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND o2.starost > 70) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 27 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 80 ORDER BY leto_nesreca DESC, mesec_nesreca, stevilo_nesrec DESC, nesrece_na_milijon_prebivalcev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) IN (5, 0) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 1 ORDER BY year DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0) AS avg_positive_alkotest, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_accidents_12m FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 367249 AND o.starost >= 90 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 71 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year, month;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injury_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_count, AVG(ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS population_density, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_accident_count_12m FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 809941) AND o.starost BETWEEN 46 AND 49 AND (n.tip_nesreca = '1' OR n.vzrok_nesreca = '1') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 7 AND AVG(o.starost) > 47.34 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year, month;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_in_unit FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost > 29 AND alkotest > 0.01 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 654) AND n.tip_nesreca IN (SELECT tip_nesreca FROM nesreca WHERE upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota GROUP BY tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 891) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 960 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('1', '2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 723 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year DESC, month DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodb, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza_let, MAX(n.x_wgs84) - MIN(n.x_wgs84) AS razpon_koordinat_x, MAX(n.y_wgs84) - MIN(n.y_wgs84) AS razpon_koordinat_y FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 94 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 36 AND 4 AND o.alkotest >= 0.3 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 302 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) < 0.97 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uporaba_varnostne_opreme, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2022 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 97 AND 90 AND o.alkotest BETWEEN 0.91 AND 2.16 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 92 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 395 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_test, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_in_unit, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) AS population_density FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND n.vreme_nesreca IN (SELECT UNNEST(STRING_TO_ARRAY('1', ','))) AND o.starost BETWEEN 52 AND 88 AND (o.alkotest > 2.83 OR o.strokovni_pregled > 2.35) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o2.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')), ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 52 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 78 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 12 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year, ue.ime_upravna_enota;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_tipu FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost >= 6 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 10 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_vozniski_staz FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 64 AND 55 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 206021 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 30 AND AVG(o.starost) > 26 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(o.id_nesreca)) OVER ( PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota = 99 AND o.starost >= 71 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2017 AND 2018 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 37 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD'));

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_povzrocitelj_age, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_3year_accidents, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0) AS avg_positive_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 4 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2017 AND o.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 61 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, ue.id_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 31 AND AVG(o.starost) > 43 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, moving_3year_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.poskodba = '1' AND n.upravna_enota >= 642 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 4 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_vzroku FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 85 AND o.starost >= 94 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 40 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 5 AND o.starost BETWEEN 19 AND 55 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 266461 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 42 AND AVG(o.starost) < 53 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC, avg_starost ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 68 AND o.starost > 29 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota), () ) ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, COUNT(*) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.alkotest) AS skupni_alkotest, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(ue.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.alkotest >= 3.35 AND o.starost BETWEEN 59 AND 81 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 995940 GROUP BY CUBE (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba) HAVING COUNT(*) > 153 AND SUM(o.alkotest) > 8.19 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_mesecih, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) FROM nesreca n2 WHERE n2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND n2.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n2.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0') AS stevilo_nesrec_v_koordinatnem_obmocju, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_stevilu_nesrec, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY AVG(o.starost) DESC) AS rang_po_povprecni_starosti_znotraj_vzroka FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND (n.x BETWEEN 40972 AND 705215 OR n.x IS NULL) AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 856062 AND ue.povrsina > 8137 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 31 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 27 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_mesecih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS udelezenci_na_100k_prebivalcev, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_udelezencev_po_vzroku FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND ue.povrsina > 9469 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 678303 AND (o.alkotest IS NULL OR o.alkotest >= 0.37) AND (o.starost IS NULL OR o.starost BETWEEN 25 AND 58) AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 7 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 133 AND AVG(o.starost) < 63 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zenskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti, STDDEV(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS standardni_odklon_starosti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE ( (n.x BETWEEN 721604 AND 905985 AND n.y BETWEEN 795604 AND 247658) OR (n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0') ) AND n.cas_nesreca IS NOT NULL AND ( (n.vzrok_nesreca IN ('A', 'A', 'A') AND n.tip_nesreca = 'A') OR (n.vreme_nesreca = 'A' AND n.stanje_promet = 'A') OR (n.stanje_vozisce = 'A' AND n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce = 'A' AND n.opis_prizorisce = 'A') ) AND NOT (n.klas_nesreca = 'A' AND n.naselje_ali_izven = 'D') AND n.kategorija_cesta NOT IN ('A', 'A') AND o.starost >= 68 AND ( (o.alkotest > 1.53 AND o.strokovni_pregled = 0.28) OR (o.vozniski_staz_ll < 6 AND o.vozniski_staz_mm < 2) OR (o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' AND o.spol = 'M') ) AND o.drzavljanstvo = 'A' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca != 'A' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 475828 AND ue.povrsina BETWEEN 1328 AND 7209 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 225 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 1774 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 48 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC LIMIT 136;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_alkotesta FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND n.x > 748096 AND n.y > 272325 AND o.starost >= 119 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 67 AND o.alkotest >= 2.73 AND o.strokovni_pregled >= 4.12 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 343 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 2407 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 33 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC LIMIT 98;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_meseci, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_pozitivnih_alkotestov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.strokovni_pregled > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_strokovnih_pregledov, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS stevilo_razlicnih_spolov, COUNT(DISTINCT o.drzavljanstvo) AS stevilo_razlicnih_drzavljanstev, COUNT(DISTINCT o.poskodba) AS stevilo_razlicnih_poskodb, COUNT(DISTINCT o.vrsta_udelezenca) AS stevilo_razlicnih_vrst_udelezencev, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza_leta, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza_meseci, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_stevila_nesrec, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(o.starost) DESC) AS rang_povprecne_starosti, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS zaporedna_stevilka_po_vzroku_in_tipu FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 214515 AND n.y > 712074 AND n.x_wgs84 > '0.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0.0' AND o.starost > 19 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll > 74 AND o.vozniski_staz_mm > 1 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 221490 AND ue.povrsina > 669925 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 72 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 231 AND AVG(o.starost) > 24 AND AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) > 80 AND AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) > 6 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 304 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.strokovni_pregled > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 127 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev DESC, povprecni_vozniski_staz_leta DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zenskih_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_vrednost_alkotesta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca || '-' || o.vrsta_udelezenca) AS stevilo_razlicnih_vrst_udelezencev_na_nesreco, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS prebivalci_na_nesreco, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_stevilu_nesrec, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec_v_enoti_po_vzroku_in_tipu FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 387499 AND ue.povrsina BETWEEN 2888 AND 5736 AND o.starost >= 32 AND o.alkotest >= 0.73 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 25 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 56 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS enota1_name, ue2.ime_upravna_enota AS enota2_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS accidents_enota1, COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) AS accidents_enota2, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_age_enota1, AVG(o2.starost) AS avg_age_enota2, SUM(CASE WHEN o1.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries_enota1, SUM(CASE WHEN o2.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries_enota2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) DESC) AS enota1_accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN nesreca n1 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n1.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota < ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON ue2.id_upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n1.upravna_enota = 11 AND n2.upravna_enota = 125 AND o1.starost >= 88 AND o2.starost >= 62 AND n1.tip_nesreca = 'A' AND n2.tip_nesreca = 'A' GROUP BY ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue2.ime_upravna_enota, ue1.id_upravna_enota, ue2.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 193 AND COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) > 618 ORDER BY enota1_accident_rank;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_people, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS median_x_coordinate, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y) AS median_y_coordinate, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (ORDER BY ue1.id_upravna_enota) AS prev_region_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 752386 AND n.y > 981342 AND o.starost BETWEEN 0 AND 55 AND n.vzrok_nesreca = 'A' GROUP BY ue1.id_upravna_enota, ue1.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 381 AND AVG(o.starost) < 100 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS accident_count FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN nesreca n1 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n1.upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n1.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND ue1.st_prebivalcev > 610858 GROUP BY ue1.id_upravna_enota, ue1.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 46 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT n.id_nesreca, COUNT(o.starost) AS participant_count FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota = 55 AND o.starost >= 55 GROUP BY n.id_nesreca HAVING COUNT(o.starost) > 6 INTERSECT SELECT n.id_nesreca, COUNT(o.starost) AS participant_count FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota = 37 AND o.starost <= 68 GROUP BY n.id_nesreca HAVING COUNT(o.starost) < 2 ORDER BY participant_count DESC;

SELECT n.id_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, n.x, n.y, n.x_wgs84, n.y_wgs84, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.oznaka_odsek_ali_ulica, n.tekst_odsek_ali_ulica, n.stacionazna_ali_hisna_st, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.cas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, u.ime_upravna_enota, u.st_prebivalcev, u.povrsina, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS participant_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS causer_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.poskodba = 'S' AND o2.starost > 81) AS severe_injury_count FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (85, 98, 24) AND n.x > 500047 AND n.y > 850022 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY n.id_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, n.x, n.y, n.x_wgs84, n.y_wgs84, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.oznaka_odsek_ali_ulica, n.tekst_odsek_ali_ulica, n.stacionazna_ali_hisna_st, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.cas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, u.ime_upravna_enota, u.st_prebivalcev, u.povrsina HAVING COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 16 AND AVG(o.starost) < 89 ORDER BY participant_count DESC, avg_age ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 92338) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 424 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezenca FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 532286) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 912 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 466441 AND o.starost > 79 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > (SELECT AVG(st_prebivalcev) / 1000 FROM upravna_enota) ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 510855 AND o.starost > 59 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 603 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 584363 AND o.alkotest >= 0.83 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) <= 983 ORDER BY upravna_enota;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, MAX(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS max_vozniski_staz, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS nesreca_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(o.alkotest) DESC NULLS LAST) AS alkotest_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 690968 AND n.y > 232075 AND o.starost BETWEEN 41 AND 61 AND o.alkotest > 2.54 AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN (SELECT vzrok_nesreca FROM nesreca WHERE upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota GROUP BY vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 672) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 6413 AND SUM(o.starost) < 11366 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, MAX(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS max_vozniski_staz, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS nesreca_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(o.alkotest) DESC NULLS LAST) AS alkotest_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 49 AND 65 AND o.alkotest > 2.39 AND n.tip_nesreca IN (SELECT tip_nesreca FROM nesreca WHERE upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota GROUP BY tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 857) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 1595 AND SUM(o.starost) < 99397 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC, total_starost ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, MAX(o.alkotest) AS max_alkotest FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 420635 AND ue.povrsina < 6007) AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 507 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') < 65 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 939160) AND o.starost > 88 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 638 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, MAX(o.starost) AS najvecja_starost, MIN(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS najmanjsi_staz_leta, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 191328 AND ue.povrsina < 15249) AND n.x > 860515 AND o.starost BETWEEN 23 AND 41 AND o.alkotest >= 1.14 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 187 AND AVG(o.starost) < 76 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1') AS avg_age_causer, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.upravna_enota) AS cumulative_accidents_by_unit FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 343307 AND n.y > 836913 AND o.starost >= 25 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 490 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;
