SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_poskodbe_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.52 ) AND n.upravna_enota >= 59 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 16 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost >= 90 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 481 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 > '14.0' AND y_wgs84 > '45.0' AND id_nesreca IN ( SELECT id_nesreca FROM oseba WHERE starost > 68 AND alkotest > 1.09 ) ) AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 64 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(sub.avg_age) AS avg_participant_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN ( SELECT upravna_enota, AVG(starost) AS avg_age FROM oseba WHERE starost > 66 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING AVG(starost) < 57.36 ) sub ON ue.id_upravna_enota = sub.upravna_enota WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 312 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) >= 59 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_level, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age_involved, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND n.klas_nesreca = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' AND o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.95 AND o2.starost BETWEEN 36 AND 62 AND o2.spol = 'M' ) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 62 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) < 0.44 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, fatal_injuries DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost >= 34 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 232 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, MAX(sub.max_alcohol) AS max_alcohol_found, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > (SELECT AVG(alkotest) FROM oseba WHERE alkotest IS NOT NULL)) AS high_alcohol_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca LEFT JOIN ( SELECT upravna_enota, MAX(alkotest) AS max_alcohol FROM oseba WHERE alkotest IS NOT NULL AND alkotest > 2.06 GROUP BY upravna_enota ) sub ON ue.id_upravna_enota = sub.upravna_enota WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.klas_nesreca = 'A' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 86579 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 582 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, fatal_injuries DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(o.starost) AS total_age_involved, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.tip_nesreca, ', ') AS accident_types_list FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '14.0' AND o.starost >= 52 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 21 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 89 AND o.starost BETWEEN 28 AND 60 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 13 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS accident_month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '304 days') AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 22351) AND o.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 100 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 40 ORDER BY accident_month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS accident_month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3month_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota > 906 AND o.starost BETWEEN 27 AND 57 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 29 ORDER BY accident_month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS accident_month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_equipment_used, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS persons_involved, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS prev_month_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost >= 54 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 28 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, accident_month DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3year FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI') >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost >= 35 AND o.alkotest >= 0.43 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 35 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS mesec_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahkotne_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_alkotest_vrednost, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s_pasom_ali_celado, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS brez_pasu_ali_celade, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_tip_nesrece_po_enoti, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS prejsnji_mesec_iste_vrste FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 20 AND 76 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 4395) AND (n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' OR n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0') AND n.tip_nesreca IN (SELECT tip_nesreca FROM nesreca WHERE upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota GROUP BY tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 579) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 399 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) > 91 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, leto_nesreca DESC, mesec_nesreca DESC, stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS cetrtletje_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS stevilo_razlicnih_spolov, COUNT(DISTINCT o.drzavljanstvo) AS stevilo_razlicnih_drzavljanstev, COUNT(DISTINCT o.poskodba) AS stevilo_razlicnih_poskodb, COUNT(DISTINCT o.vrsta_udelezenca) AS stevilo_razlicnih_vrst_udelezencev, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(u.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND n.x BETWEEN 114408 AND 292960 AND n.y BETWEEN 914234 AND 394456 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '-180.0' AND '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '-90.0' AND '-90.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 18 AND 88 AND o.alkotest BETWEEN 0.48 AND 0.51 AND o.strokovni_pregled BETWEEN 3.96 AND 2.27 AND u.st_prebivalcev >= 562917 AND u.povrsina >= 9718 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 664 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 129 ORDER BY leto_nesreca DESC, cetrtletje_nesreca DESC, stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT o.vrsta_udelezenca, ', ' ORDER BY o.vrsta_udelezenca) AS vrste_udelezencev, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 77 AND o.alkotest >= 0.79 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 70 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 3.46 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hujse_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS povprecno_prebivalstvo_na_enoto, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta) AS skupno_nesrece_po_kategoriji_ceste FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '45.0' AND o.starost >= 53 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 451 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecno_prebivalstvo_na_enoto ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_in_unit FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost >= 51 AND (n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' OR n.vzrok_nesreca = '2' OR n.vzrok_nesreca = '3') AND n.naselje_ali_izven = '1' AND o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca IN ('1', '2', '3') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 92 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 28 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.upravna_enota ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_accidents FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 85 AND o.starost BETWEEN 25 AND 38 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 33544 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 9 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_tipu FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost >= 26 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 34 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 279894 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 89 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_perpetrator_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca)) AS person_percentile FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 62 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 224708 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 5 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') < 47 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accident_rank;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost, SUM(o.alkotest) AS total_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 79 AND o.starost BETWEEN 24 AND 36 AND o.alkotest >= 1.2 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 32 AND AVG(o.starost) < 52 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC, total_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_tipu FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 62 AND o.starost > 51 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 20 ORDER BY n.tip_nesreca, rang_po_tipu;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(COUNT(o.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_3yr_person_sum FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 11 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injury_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 18 AND o.starost >= 59 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota), () ) ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rang_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost >= 24 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 103 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 85 AND o.starost >= 83 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 46 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.spol = 'M' AND n.klas_nesreca = 'A' AND o.starost >= 92 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 76 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 456 AND o.starost > 96 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota), () ) ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, stevilo_slovencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_tezkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 52688 AND n.y > 975643 AND o.starost > 58 AND o.alkotest > 3.59 AND o.strokovni_pregled > 3.67 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_mesecih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti, STDDEV(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS standardni_odklon_starosti FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 509984 AND (o.alkotest IS NULL OR o.alkotest <= 0.6) AND (o.starost IS NULL OR o.starost >= 86) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 72 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 177 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_mesecih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zenskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_telesnih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_telesnih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.drzavljanstvo != 'SLO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_tujih_drzavljanov, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca || '-' || o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec || '-' || o.spol || '-' || o.vrsta_udelezenca) AS stevilo_razlicnih_udelezencev_po_nesreci, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_alkotesta FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '45.0' AND o.starost > 26 AND o.alkotest > 2.3 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 769953 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 8 AND AVG(o.starost) > 71 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN o.id_nesreca || '_' || o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec END) AS moski_povzrocitelji_ali_udelezenci, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN o.id_nesreca || '_' || o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec END) AS zenske_povzrocitelji_ali_udelezenci, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.drzavljanstvo != 'SLO' THEN o.id_nesreca || '_' || o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec END) AS tujci_povzrocitelji_ali_udelezenci, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN o.id_nesreca || '_' || o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec END) AS smrtne_zrtve, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN o.id_nesreca || '_' || o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec END) AS hude_poskodbe, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN o.id_nesreca || '_' || o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec END) AS lahke_poskodbe, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN o.id_nesreca || '_' || o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec END) AS vozniki, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'P' THEN o.id_nesreca || '_' || o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec END) AS potniki, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'K' THEN o.id_nesreca || '_' || o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec END) AS kolesarji, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'M' THEN o.id_nesreca || '_' || o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec END) AS motoristi, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'O' THEN o.id_nesreca || '_' || o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec END) AS ostali, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo_v_obmocju, SUM(ue.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina_v_obmocju, (SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ue.povrsina), 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev), 0)) AS nesrece_na_milijon_prebivalcev, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ue.povrsina), 0)) AS nesrece_na_100_km2 FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '45.0' AND o.starost > 85 AND o.alkotest > 3.19 AND o.strokovni_pregled > 0.0 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 74 AND AVG(o.starost) < 38 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 0.54 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezenca, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca || o.spol || o.drzavljanstvo || o.vrsta_udelezenca) AS stevilo_razlicnih_udelezenih_profilov, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.poskodba = 'S' GROUP BY o2.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv_na_nesreco, (SELECT AVG(ue2.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue2.povrsina, 0)) FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota) AS gostota_prebivalstva_enote FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue3.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue3 WHERE ue3.st_prebivalcev > 296258) AND o.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 76 AND (o.alkotest > 2.86 OR o.strokovni_pregled > 1.45) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, n.upravna_enota, n.id_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 3 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 32 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezenca ASC;

WITH accident_stats AS ( SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS unique_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 2.64 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_experience FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '14.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '46.0' AND o.starost >= 51 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota ), unit_density AS ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, ue.st_prebivalcev::numeric / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) AS population_density, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accidents_per_area, AVG(n.x) AS avg_x_coord, AVG(n.y) AS avg_y_coord FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 482777 AND ue.povrsina > 4730 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina ), combined_analysis AS ( SELECT 'high_density' AS analysis_type, ud.id_upravna_enota, ud.population_density, ud.accidents_per_area, ud.avg_x_coord, ud.avg_y_coord, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ud.population_density DESC) AS density_rank FROM unit_density ud WHERE ud.population_density > 1305.18 UNION ALL SELECT 'high_accidents' AS analysis_type, as1.upravna_enota AS id_upravna_enota, ud.population_density, as1.total_accidents AS accidents_per_area, ud.avg_x_coord, ud.avg_y_coord, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY as1.total_accidents DESC) AS density_rank FROM accident_stats as1 JOIN unit_density ud ON as1.upravna_enota = ud.id_upravna_enota WHERE as1.total_accidents > 1328 AND as1.high_alcohol_cases > 336 ) SELECT ca.analysis_type, ca.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ca.population_density, ca.accidents_per_area, ca.avg_x_coord, ca.avg_y_coord, ca.density_rank, as2.avg_age, as2.serious_injuries, as2.high_alcohol_cases, as2.median_experience, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.analysis_type ORDER BY ca.accidents_per_area DESC) AS accident_rank FROM combined_analysis ca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON ca.id_upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota LEFT JOIN accident_stats as2 ON ca.id_upravna_enota = as2.upravna_enota WHERE ca.density_rank <= 19 ORDER BY ca.analysis_type, ca.density_rank, accident_rank;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 729825) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 23.91 EXCEPT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.povrsina < 6713) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) < 11 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 629636 AND o.starost > 17 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota UNION SELECT u.id_upravna_enota, 0 AS nesrece_count, u.st_prebivalcev AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u WHERE u.st_prebivalcev > 644011 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (96, 40, 60) AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' AND o.spol IN ('M', 'M') AND o.starost BETWEEN 20 AND 78 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 522 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 2832 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 2.37) AS accidents_with_alcohol, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS population, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / MAX(u.st_prebivalcev)) AS accidents_per_100k FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 313144) AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca IS NOT NULL AND o.starost BETWEEN 68 AND 83 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 133 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 24 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 406148 AND ue.povrsina < 380) AND o.starost > 53 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 33 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 748625 AND o.starost > 0 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota UNION ALL SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 766628 AND o.alkotest IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 16411 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.76) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 904 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS osebe_count, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) - COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca)) AS nesrece_brez_oseb FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 446 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) < 282 ORDER BY nesrece_brez_oseb DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost > 23 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 874 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.vzrok_nesreca, ', ' ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS vzroki_nesrec FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost >= 19 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 576 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 557178 AND o.starost >= 59 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 77 UNION ALL SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 906698 AND o.starost <= 43 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) < 125;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.tip_nesreca, ', ' ORDER BY n.tip_nesreca) AS tipi_nesrec, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 267023 AND o.starost BETWEEN 19 AND 1 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 259 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 797989 AND o.starost > 90 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 63 AND o.starost >= 66 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 36 UNION SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota < 195 AND o.starost <= 6 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) < 71 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE ue.id_upravna_enota IN ( SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE upravna_enota IN ( SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 223903 ) AND x > 130880 ) AND o.starost BETWEEN 25 AND 84 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 941 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost, SUM(o.alkotest) AS total_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '100000' AND n.y_wgs84 < '100000' AND o.starost >= 84 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 71 AND AVG(o.starost) < 70 INTERSECT SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost, SUM(o.alkotest) AS total_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 591900 AND n.y < 786472 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 21 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 75 AND SUM(o.alkotest) > 4.74 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 326482 ORDER BY ue2.povrsina DESC LIMIT 57 OFFSET 36) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.62 LIMIT 1) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 47 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_poskodbe FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 0.79 LIMIT 1 ) AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 18 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 652 AND o.starost >= 25 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 498 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS high_alc_percentile, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_equipment_used, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev) AS population_percentile, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / ue.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_million FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 99 AND o.alkotest >= 1.01 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 673960 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 707 AND AVG(o.starost) < 30 ORDER BY accidents_per_million DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 2.54 AND o2.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS high_alcohol_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS median_x_coordinate FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2020-01-01' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 538102 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 262 AND AVG(o.starost) < 56 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS accident_month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '2 months' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3month_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost >= 64 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 23 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, accident_month;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injury_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota > 910 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year, quarter HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 3 ORDER BY year DESC, quarter DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injury_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_count, AVG(ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS population_density, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_annual_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 78 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 722754 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 94 AND AVG(o.starost) < 31 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year, month;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_female_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, ROUND(ue.st_prebivalcev::numeric / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0), 2) AS population_density, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_year FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 320570) AND o.starost >= 80 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 31 ORDER BY year DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_test, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_in_unit, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) AS population_density FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND n.vreme_nesreca IN (SELECT UNNEST(STRING_TO_ARRAY('1', ','))) AND o.starost BETWEEN 70 AND 34 AND (o.alkotest > 2.1 OR o.strokovni_pregled > 2.88) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o2.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')), ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 55 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 51 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 26 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year, ue.ime_upravna_enota;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zenskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.drzavljanstvo = 'SLO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_slovencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, (ue.st_prebivalcev::FLOAT / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS percent_rank_nesrece, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_udelezenci_po_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%' AND n.tekst_odsek_ali_ulica LIKE '%' AND n.stacionazna_ali_hisna_st LIKE '%' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND n.x BETWEEN 867047 AND 519948 AND n.y BETWEEN 839777 AND 383719 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '-180.0' AND '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '-90.0' AND '-90.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 63 AND 74 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll BETWEEN 35 AND 71 AND o.vozniski_staz_mm BETWEEN 6 AND 8 AND o.alkotest BETWEEN 1.86 AND 4.87 AND o.strokovni_pregled BETWEEN 4.09 AND 4.74 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 176 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 1385 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) > 61 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_udelezencev_ne_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_leta, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom_ali_celado, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_brez_poskodb, (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS udelezenci_na_100k_prebivalcev, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_nesrec_na_enoto_povrsine, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti_udelezencev, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_alkotesta FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost >= 71 AND o.alkotest >= 0.03 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 108753 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 100 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 452 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 56 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

WITH accident_stats AS ( SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '{{p1}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_injury_count FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota BETWEEN 72 AND 91 AND o.starost >= 34 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota ) SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, a.total_accidents, a.avg_age_involved, a.specific_injury_count, u.st_prebivalcev, (a.total_accidents * 100000.0 / u.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_100k FROM accident_stats a JOIN upravna_enota u ON a.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE a.total_accidents > 98 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC;

WITH accident_stats AS ( SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS unique_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_causers FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota ), enriched_stats AS ( SELECT a.upravna_enota, a.total_accidents, a.unique_accidents, a.avg_age_involved, a.num_causers, u.st_prebivalcev, u.povrsina, (a.total_accidents * 100000.0 / u.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_100k, (a.num_causers * 100.0 / a.total_accidents) AS causer_percentage FROM accident_stats a JOIN upravna_enota u ON a.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE u.st_prebivalcev > 96120 ), window_stats AS ( SELECT e.*, AVG(e.accidents_per_100k) OVER (ORDER BY e.upravna_enota ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_accidents, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY e.causer_percentage DESC) AS causer_rank, LAG(e.total_accidents, 1) OVER (ORDER BY e.upravna_enota) AS prev_total_accidents FROM enriched_stats e WHERE e.accidents_per_100k > 148.5 ) SELECT w.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, w.total_accidents, w.unique_accidents, w.avg_age_involved, w.num_causers, w.st_prebivalcev, w.povrsina, w.accidents_per_100k, w.causer_percentage, w.moving_avg_accidents, w.causer_rank, w.prev_total_accidents, (w.total_accidents - COALESCE(w.prev_total_accidents, 0)) AS accident_change, CASE WHEN w.causer_percentage > 31.46 THEN 'HIGH_RISK' WHEN w.causer_percentage > 17.83 THEN 'MEDIUM_RISK' ELSE 'LOW_RISK' END AS risk_category FROM window_stats w JOIN upravna_enota u ON w.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE w.moving_avg_accidents > 188.64 AND w.total_accidents > 852 ORDER BY w.accidents_per_100k DESC, w.causer_percentage DESC LIMIT 92;

WITH accident_stats AS ( SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) as total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) as avg_age_involved FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND o.starost > 51 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota ) SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, u.st_prebivalcev, a.total_accidents, a.avg_age_involved, (a.total_accidents * 100000.0 / u.st_prebivalcev) as accidents_per_100k FROM accident_stats a JOIN upravna_enota u ON a.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE a.total_accidents > 15 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 910448) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 0.54) AND n.x > 780848 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 44 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 97448 LIMIT 66 OFFSET 57 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 0.54 LIMIT 1 ) AND n.x > 415810 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 89 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(o.starost) AS total_age_involved, (SELECT AVG(o2.starost) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota AND o2.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 19 AND o.starost > 51 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 204 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 831111 ORDER BY ue.povrsina DESC LIMIT 67 OFFSET 79 ) AND o.starost > 52 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 0.65 LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 6 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 742291 AND o.starost > 119 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 981 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.y < 431001 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 3809082 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING SUM(o.starost) < 58875;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '1') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, SUM(u2.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS prebivalci_na_nesreco FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON u.id_upravna_enota = u2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 649616 AND n.y < 12807 AND o.alkotest > 0.83 AND u.st_prebivalcev >= 639841 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 547 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '1') < 35 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec FROM nesreca n INNER JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND (o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' OR o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec IS NULL) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 47 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') < 84 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 68 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 922 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 31 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x BETWEEN 450380 AND 409991 AND n.y BETWEEN 176432 AND 192199 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 29 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 543 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 8 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, MAX(o.alkotest) AS maksimalni_alkotest FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 473426) OR n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.povrsina < 9874 AND ue2.id_upravna_enota IN (SELECT n2.upravna_enota FROM nesreca n2 WHERE n2.x > 487883 AND n2.y < 938546)) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 401 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') < 58 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 769112 AND n.y < 859709 AND o.starost >= 69 AND o.alkotest > 4.2 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 290 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_people, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, MIN(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS min_alcohol_level, MAX(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS max_alcohol_level, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience_years, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_population_per_unit, SUM(u.povrsina) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_area_per_unit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost > 114 AND alkotest > 1.57 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 251) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 318 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 248 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS caused_by_drivers, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, MAX(o.alkotest) AS max_alcohol_level, SUM(u2.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population_in_accident_areas, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'S' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V') AS severe_injury_drivers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON n.upravna_enota = u2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 113 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 648 AND AVG(o.starost) < 100 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, MAX(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS max_starost_m, MIN(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS min_starost_z, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_staz_ll, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesreca FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 100 AND 120 AND o.alkotest >= 3.38 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 950 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 4.32 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, MAX(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS max_starost_m, MIN(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS min_starost_z, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_staz_ll, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesreca FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 < '0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 35 AND 25 AND o.strokovni_pregled >= 4.42 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 981 AND AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) < 3.4 ORDER BY rank_nesreca;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 56 AND o.alkotest >= 0.25 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 135 AND AVG(o.starost) < 30 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 10 AND o.starost > 65 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota), (n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca), () ) ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, stevilo_nesrec DESC;
