SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_causers, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS avg_driving_experience_years, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatalities, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_equipment_used, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_cause, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota) AS total_accidents_in_unit, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS avg_accidents_per_cause_nationally FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost BETWEEN 78 AND 47 AND o.alkotest >= 0.49 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 515 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 2361 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_involved ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, MAX(o.alkotest) AS max_alcohol_level, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 331332) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o2.alkotest > 3.0) AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND n.stanje_promet = '1' AND n.klas_nesreca = '1' AND n.naselje_ali_izven = '1' AND n.kategorija_cesta = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 476 AND AVG(o.starost) < 19 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_male_age ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, MAX(o.alkotest) AS max_alcohol_level, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 388885) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o2.alkotest > 1.32) AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND n.stanje_promet = '1' AND n.klas_nesreca = '1' AND n.naselje_ali_izven = '1' AND n.kategorija_cesta = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 661 AND AVG(o.starost) < 87 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_male_age ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.tip_nesreca) AS kumulativne_nesrece_po_tipu, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec, ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.alkotest >= 2.12 AND o.starost BETWEEN 29 AND 17 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 353 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 22 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, rang_nesrec;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s_pasom_ali_celado, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec_po_vzroku FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0.0' AND o.starost >= 51 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 2 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 11.82 ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n1.upravna_enota AS ue1, n2.upravna_enota AS ue2, ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS ime_ue1, ue2.ime_upravna_enota AS ime_ue2, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_ue1, COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_ue2, SUM(CASE WHEN o1.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrti_ue1, SUM(CASE WHEN o2.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrti_ue2, AVG(o1.starost) FILTER (WHERE o1.spol = 'M') AS avg_starost_moski_ue1, AVG(o2.starost) FILTER (WHERE o2.spol = 'M') AS avg_starost_moski_ue2, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o1.alkotest) AS median_alkotest_ue1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o2.alkotest) AS median_alkotest_ue2, SUM(ue1.st_prebivalcev) AS prebivalci_ue1, SUM(ue2.st_prebivalcev) AS prebivalci_ue2, (COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ue1.st_prebivalcev), 0)) AS nesrece_na_100k_ue1, (COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ue2.st_prebivalcev), 0)) AS nesrece_na_100k_ue2 FROM nesreca n1 JOIN nesreca n2 ON n1.upravna_enota < n2.upravna_enota AND n1.tip_nesreca = n2.tip_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue1 ON n1.upravna_enota = ue1.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON n2.upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n1.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n2.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n1.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' AND n2.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' AND ue1.povrsina > 7480 AND ue2.povrsina > 4981 AND o1.starost >= 41 AND o2.starost >= 87 GROUP BY n1.upravna_enota, n2.upravna_enota, ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue2.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) > 46 AND AVG(o1.alkotest) < 0.13 AND AVG(o2.alkotest) < 0.55 ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) + COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca)) DESC;

SELECT n1.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_starost_povzrocitelj, SUM(CASE WHEN o2.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve FROM nesreca n1 JOIN nesreca n2 ON n1.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n1.id_nesreca < n2.id_nesreca JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca AND o1.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n1.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n1.tip_nesreca = '1' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 783201 GROUP BY n1.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 75 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT DISTINCT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 18 AND 61 ) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 13 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responsible_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 84 AND o.starost >= 35 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 63152 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 3 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_people, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS distinct_genders_involved FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 2 AND o.starost >= 60 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 42 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o WHERE o.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o.starost >= 78 AND o.alkotest >= 1.99 ) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 8 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND o2.alkotest > 0.76 ) AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND u.st_prebivalcev > 745708 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 25 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 578733) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 44.61 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS oseba_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.spol = 'M' GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 981 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.vzrok_nesreca, ', ' ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS vzroki_nesrec FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 24 AND 32 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 31 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IS NULL AND u.st_prebivalcev > 85668 AND u.povrsina < 1453 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 68 AND o.starost BETWEEN 26 AND 44 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 32 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS cetrtletje, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost >= 71 AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 115560) GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, leto, cetrtletje HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 24 ORDER BY leto DESC, cetrtletje DESC, stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS cetrtletje_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < '2016-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (318) GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, leto_nesreca, cetrtletje_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 38 ORDER BY leto_nesreca DESC, cetrtletje_nesreca DESC, stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 93 AND o.starost >= 27 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 30 ORDER BY u.ime_upravna_enota, accident_rank;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS accident_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 50 AND 47 AND id_nesreca IN ( SELECT id_nesreca FROM nesreca WHERE upravna_enota > 37 ) ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 26 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(o.alkotest) AS total_alcohol FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '100000' AND n.y_wgs84 < '100000' AND o.starost >= 43 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 35 AND AVG(o.starost) < 32 INTERSECT SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(o.alkotest) AS total_alcohol FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 237710 AND n.y < 494310 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 48 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 27 AND SUM(o.alkotest) > 1.56 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS distinct_genders_involved, SUM(o.starost) AS total_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost >= 20 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 762 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 185326 AND o.starost > 73 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > (SELECT AVG(st_prebivalcev) FROM upravna_enota WHERE povrsina > 26125) ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 432237 AND o.starost > 115 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 436 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 513018 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 0.27 AND o2.vozniski_staz_ll > 50) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 52 AND AVG(o.starost) < 20 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC, avg_starost ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 780002 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 0.45 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 112 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 90401 ) OR n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue3.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue3 WHERE ue3.povrsina < 2815 ) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 38 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 964949 ) OR n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue3.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue3 WHERE ue3.povrsina < 5773 ) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 2 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 2.58 AND o2.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 79) AS high_alcohol_cases FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x BETWEEN 471557 AND 461570 AND n.y BETWEEN 51683 AND 128415 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 387748 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 10 AND AVG(o.starost) < 30 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_involved ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.poskodba = 'S' AND o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca) AS fatal_in_accident FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 483831 AND n.y < 887135 AND o.starost >= 91 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.id_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 77 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT n2.upravna_enota FROM nesreca n2 WHERE n2.x > 161396 AND n2.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 3942235 ) ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 798 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT n2.upravna_enota FROM nesreca n2 WHERE n2.x > 636908 AND n2.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 779647 ) ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 466 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_age_causer, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 1.25) AS high_alcohol_count, (SELECT AVG(strokovni_pregled) FROM oseba o3 WHERE o3.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o3.vozniski_staz_ll > 40) AS avg_exam_long_exp FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND y_wgs84 < '45.0') OR n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 19 AND 77 AND spol = 'M') GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 55 AND AVG(o.starost) < 45 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_female_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (98, 48, 22) AND (n.tip_nesreca = '1' OR n.vzrok_nesreca = '1') AND NOT (n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND n.stanje_promet = '1') AND o.starost BETWEEN 61 AND 98 AND (o.alkotest > 0.2 OR o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 14 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_female_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (51, 21, 58) AND (n.tip_nesreca = '1' OR n.tip_nesreca = '2') AND n.vreme_nesreca NOT IN ('1', '2') AND o.starost BETWEEN 66 AND 85 AND (o.alkotest > 0.6 OR o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 298 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 4584 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, total_persons_involved DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1') AS avg_age_causer, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o2.id_nesreca) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 0.75 AND o2.spol = 'M') AS male_high_alcohol_accidents, SUM(u.povrsina) AS total_area, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS max_population FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON o.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 44 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 370 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1') < 22 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_causer ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, MAX(u2.st_prebivalcev) AS max_pop_in_region, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS count_culprits_per_accident FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON u2.id_upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE (n.x > 833187 OR n.y < 975710) AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT u3.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota u3 WHERE u3.st_prebivalcev > 572614 AND u3.povrsina < 496572) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.id_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 221 AND AVG(o.starost) < 12 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, severe_injuries ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, (SELECT AVG(o2.alkotest) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 0) AS avg_positive_alcohol, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.klas_nesreca = 'A' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 59511 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 829 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 84 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, severe_injuries DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(o.starost) AS total_age_involved, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.tip_nesreca, ', ') AS accident_types_list FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '14.0' AND o.starost >= 97 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 3 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 819729 AND o.starost > 3 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY') >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost >= 22 AND o.starost <= 83 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 735906 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 46 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_accidents FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 50 AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 5 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2015-01-01' AND n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' AND o.alkotest > 2.09 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 55 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injury_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_count, AVG(ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS population_density, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_accident_count_12m FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 336865) AND o.starost BETWEEN 49 AND 64 AND (n.tip_nesreca = '1' OR n.vzrok_nesreca = '1') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 51 AND AVG(o.starost) > 47.28 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year, month;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_in_unit FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 37 AND 55 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 695) AND (n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' OR n.tip_nesreca = '1') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 329 AND AVG(o.starost) < 48 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year, month;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.61 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vozniski_staz_ll > 26 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS experienced_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS accidents_with_culprit, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident, SUM(ue.povrsina) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS area_per_accident, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_year, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS prev_month_accidents, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_year_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca IN (SELECT UNNEST(STRING_TO_ARRAY('1', ','))) AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 399658 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 95 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 47 ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_population_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_year FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca IN ('1', '1', '1') AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' AND o.alkotest >= 0.99 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 237040 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 997 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 95 ORDER BY year DESC, quarter DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS safety_equipment_usage_percent FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 16 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) BETWEEN 2006 AND 2001 AND o.starost BETWEEN 26 AND 24 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 136 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 96 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year ASC, ue.ime_upravna_enota;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS p75_driving_exp, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injury_count, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0) AS avg_positive_alkotest, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 7 AND o.starost <= 10 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 406153 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 392 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0) > 0.58 ORDER BY accident_count DESC, median_age;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS udelezenci_na_100k_prebivalcev, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) BETWEEN 2017 AND 2016 AND n.kategorija_cesta IN ('A', 'A') AND o.starost >= 63 AND ue.povrsina > 1150 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')), ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 80 AND AVG(o.starost) < 42.13 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, udelezenci_na_100k_prebivalcev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodb, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza_let, MAX(n.x_wgs84) - MIN(n.x_wgs84) AS razpon_koordinat_x, MAX(n.y_wgs84) - MIN(n.y_wgs84) AS razpon_koordinat_y FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 85 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 50 AND 57 AND o.alkotest >= 4.79 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 185 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) < 0.4 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_cesti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > (SELECT AVG(st_prebivalcev) / 1000.0 FROM upravna_enota WHERE povrsina > 70555) ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lazje_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_vrednost_alkotesta, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza_ll, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / ue.st_prebivalcev) AS nesrece_na_milijon_prebivalcev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023 AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND y_wgs84 > '45.0' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 668) AND o.starost BETWEEN 91 AND 70 AND (o.alkotest > 2.74 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')), ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 27 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, nesrece_na_milijon_prebivalcev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS udelezenci_na_100k_preb, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.starost >= 43 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 69 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 310 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) > 0.23 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, udelezenci_na_100k_preb DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_zrtvi, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2', '3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hujse_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec, (ue.st_prebivalcev * 1.0 / ue.povrsina) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE ( (n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0')) AND (n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' OR n.tip_nesreca = '1') AND NOT (n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND n.stanje_promet = '1') AND n.kategorija_cesta NOT IN ('1', '1') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o2.alkotest > 0.49) ) AND o.starost BETWEEN 70 AND 62 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll > 42 AND (o.alkotest > 0.01 OR o.strokovni_pregled > 0.37) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 966 AND AVG(o.starost) < 87 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, gostota_prebivalstva;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.klas_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hude_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahzje_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s_pasom_ali_celado, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS brez_pasa_ali_celade, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza_let, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS rang_po_smrtnih_zrtvah FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%' AND n.tekst_odsek_ali_ulica LIKE '%' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND n.cas_nesreca <= '00:00' AND o.starost >= 39 AND o.starost <= 23 AND o.alkotest >= 2.43 AND o.alkotest <= 0.12 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 795474 AND ue.povrsina >= 2854 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.klas_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 47 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 19 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 53 AND 38 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 285844 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 51 AND AVG(o.starost) < 37 ORDER BY serious_injuries DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 60 AND 63 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 75406 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 66 AND AVG(o.starost) < 42 ORDER BY serious_injuries DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS prebivalci_na_nesreco, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_vzroku, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota) AS skupne_nesrece_v_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 490541 AND o.alkotest > 2.61 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 41 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 41 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, rang_po_vzroku;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodovanih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodovanih, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS prebivalci_enote, MAX(u.povrsina) AS povrsina_enote, (MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) * 1.0 / NULLIF(MAX(u.povrsina), 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_tipu, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 48 AND o.alkotest >= 2.66 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 482007 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 261 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 1510 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_mesecih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodovanih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodovanih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_brez_poskodbe, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0)) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 < '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '44.0' AND o.starost < 52 AND ue.st_prebivalcev < 3430 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 15 AND AVG(o.starost) > 22 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D') AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS stevilo_moskih, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS stevilo_zenskih, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.drzavljanstvo != 'SLO') AS stevilo_tujcev, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'S' OR o.poskodba = 'H') AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodb, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V') AS stevilo_voznikov, (ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS mediana_x, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y) AS mediana_y, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x_wgs84) AS mediana_x_wgs84, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y_wgs84) AS mediana_y_wgs84 FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 118766 AND n.y > 536295 AND n.x_wgs84 > '0.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0.0' AND o.alkotest > 0.4 AND o.starost > 28 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll > 50 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 989450 AND ue.povrsina > 1469 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 282 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 446 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezenca, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca || o.spol || o.drzavljanstvo || o.vrsta_udelezenca) AS stevilo_razlicnih_udelezenih_profilov, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.poskodba = 'S' GROUP BY o2.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv_na_nesreco, (SELECT AVG(ue2.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue2.povrsina, 0)) FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota) AS gostota_prebivalstva_enote FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue3.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue3 WHERE ue3.st_prebivalcev > 311211) AND o.starost BETWEEN 21 AND 98 AND (o.alkotest > 0.64 OR o.strokovni_pregled > 0.8) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, n.upravna_enota, n.id_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 5 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 31 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezenca ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(*) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezke_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahke_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS z_varnostnim_pasom_ali_celado, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS moski, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zenske, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_stevilu_nesrec, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS zaporedna_stevilka_po_stevilu_udelezencev_v_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '45.0' AND o.starost >= 64 AND o.alkotest >= 0.94 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 508608 AND ue.povrsina >= 3637 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 57 AND COUNT(*) > 320 AND AVG(o.starost) < 59 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.poskodba, o.vrsta_udelezenca, COUNT(*) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS skupni_staz_ll, SUM(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS skupni_staz_mm, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zascitenih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY AVG(o.alkotest) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rang_alkotest_v_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 985319 AND n.y > 55919 AND o.starost >= 62 AND o.alkotest >= 1.72 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 660770 AND ue.povrsina > 10618 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.poskodba, o.vrsta_udelezenca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 479 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 1.12 AND SUM(o.starost) > 99387 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupna_starost DESC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_people, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS median_x_coordinate, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y) AS median_y_coordinate, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (ORDER BY ue1.id_upravna_enota) AS prev_region_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 239285 AND n.y > 99753 AND o.starost BETWEEN 87 AND 28 AND n.vzrok_nesreca = 'A' GROUP BY ue1.id_upravna_enota, ue1.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 612 AND AVG(o.starost) < 64 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

WITH accident_stats AS ( SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) as total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) as avg_age_involved FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND o.starost > 79 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota ) SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, u.st_prebivalcev, a.total_accidents, a.avg_age_involved, (a.total_accidents * 100000.0 / u.st_prebivalcev) as accidents_per_100k FROM accident_stats a JOIN upravna_enota u ON a.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE a.total_accidents > 48 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah_v_enoti, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS globalni_rang_smrti FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota LEFT JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n2.x_wgs84 IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.8 WHERE n.x > 652309 AND n.y < 313306 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2018 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 50 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 27 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, SUM(o.starost) AS total_age_involved FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 628963 AND o.starost > 30 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 911 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_people, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca || o.id_nesreca) AS total_distinct_incidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 53 AND o.starost >= 53 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 45 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 > '14.0' AND id_nesreca IN ( SELECT id_nesreca FROM oseba WHERE starost > 25 AND povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' ) ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 200 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_female_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost BETWEEN 18 AND 94 AND n.vreme_nesreca = '1' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 41 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS mesec_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_vrednost_alkotesta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(ue.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev), 0), 2) AS nesrece_na_milijon_prebivalcev, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_tip_nesrece_po_letu_in_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 136672 AND povrsina > 7280) AND o.starost BETWEEN 47 AND 56 AND (o.alkotest > 1.19 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND o2.starost > 53) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 47 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 78 ORDER BY leto_nesreca DESC, mesec_nesreca, stevilo_nesrec DESC, nesrece_na_milijon_prebivalcev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, (SELECT MAX(ue2.st_prebivalcev) FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.povrsina > ue.povrsina) AS max_prebivalci_vecje_povrsine FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 23 AND 51 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 156 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 1.53 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

WITH accident_stats AS ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responsible_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_equipment_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' AND o.starost >= 69 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 36 ), person_analysis AS ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS analyzed_persons, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm/12.0) AS avg_driving_experience_years, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 1.67 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injury_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x BETWEEN 277761 AND 477766) AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 42 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm/12.0) > '2.0' ) SELECT 'accident_stats' AS analysis_type, id_upravna_enota, ime_upravna_enota, total_accidents, total_persons, avg_age, responsible_count, safety_equipment_count, NULL AS analyzed_persons, NULL AS avg_driving_experience_years, NULL AS high_alcohol_count, NULL AS severe_injury_count, NULL AS median_age FROM accident_stats UNION ALL SELECT 'person_analysis' AS analysis_type, id_upravna_enota, ime_upravna_enota, NULL AS total_accidents, NULL AS total_persons, NULL AS avg_age, NULL AS responsible_count, NULL AS safety_equipment_count, analyzed_persons, avg_driving_experience_years, high_alcohol_count, severe_injury_count, median_age FROM person_analysis ORDER BY id_upravna_enota, analysis_type;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 946692 AND o.starost > 21 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > (SELECT AVG(st_prebivalcev) / 1000 FROM upravna_enota) ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, (SELECT AVG(u.st_prebivalcev) FROM upravna_enota u WHERE u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota) AS avg_residents_in_unit FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '14.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 60 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 543068 AND o.starost > 40 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 627 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 143873 AND o.alkotest >= 1.75 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) <= 486 ORDER BY upravna_enota;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.poskodba = '1' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 563896) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 72 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_zazdevek, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, MAX(o.alkotest) AS maksimalni_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(u.povrsina, 0)) AS mediana_gostote_prebivalstva FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.88 AND o2.vozniski_staz_ll > (SELECT AVG(vozniski_staz_ll) FROM oseba WHERE upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota AND spol = 'M' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0)) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, u.st_prebivalcev, u.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 252 AND AVG(o.starost) < 52 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, MAX(o.alkotest) AS maksimalni_alkotest FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 433312) OR n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.povrsina < 3740 AND ue2.id_upravna_enota IN (SELECT n2.upravna_enota FROM nesreca n2 WHERE n2.x > 328589 AND n2.y < 811788)) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 381 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') < 85 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, MAX(o.starost) AS najvecja_starost, MIN(o.starost) AS najmanjsa_starost, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 930926 AND ue.povrsina < 914) AND o.starost >= 30 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 453 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 2.04 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 11 AND o.starost > 43 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 15 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;
