SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS prebivalci_na_enoto, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_vzroku, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca) AS skupne_nesrece_po_tipu FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.vzrok_nesreca = n2.vzrok_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca AND o.spol = o2.spol WHERE n.x > 951144 AND n.y < 210174 AND o.starost >= 100 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 139 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(SUM(u.povrsina), 0) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 103 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 500 AND AVG(o.starost) < 14 UNION SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(SUM(u.povrsina), 0) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 < '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '-90.0' AND o.starost <= 7 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 649 AND AVG(o.starost) > 28 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota UNION ALL SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS oseba_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN oseba o ON u.id_upravna_enota = o.upravna_enota WHERE o.starost > 89 AND o.alkotest < 1.01 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND o.starost > 104 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 782 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 591677) AND o.starost > 45 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, u.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 53 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 873576 AND o.starost >= 40 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 956 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.24) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 9 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 482749 AND o.starost > 99 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 833 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE o.starost > 27 AND n.upravna_enota >= 746 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 20 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' AND o.starost >= 94 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 40 AND AVG(o.starost) < 66 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS distinct_genders_involved, SUM(o.alkotest) AS total_alkotest, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 412272 AND n.y > 917209 AND o.alkotest > 3.42 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 61 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost >= 34 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota UNION ALL SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost <= 90 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.01 LIMIT 1 ) AND n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 55 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 40 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2012 AND 2019 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 34 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_injured, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'H') AS avg_age_seriously_injured, SUM(CASE WHEN n.vzrok_nesreca = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_driver_error FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca AND o.poskodba IN ('H', 'S') WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 83 AND n.upravna_enota <= 77 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND n.cas_nesreca <= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 8 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) >= 51 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_age_female FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%Ljubljana%' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.poskodba = '1' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 33 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_female_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 26 AND o.starost BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) >= 25 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS high_alcohol_percentile FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND o.starost >= 84 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 507 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN n.vzrok_nesreca = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accidents_cause_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_age_causer, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'A' AND o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS injuries_no_safety_gear FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 703 AND n.upravna_enota <= 896 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 11 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' AND o.starost >= 26 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 239 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_age_causer, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost >= 34 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 9047 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 639 EXCEPT SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_age_causer, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'P' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) < 107 ORDER BY accident_rank;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS accident_month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_equipment_used, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS persons_involved, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS prev_month_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost >= 64 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 22 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, accident_month DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS cetrtletje_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hude_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2015-01-01' AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN ('1', '1', '1') AND o.starost >= 23 AND o.alkotest >= 1.48 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 299784 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 6 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 ORDER BY leto_nesreca DESC, cetrtletje_nesreca DESC, stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota = 928 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 88 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND o.starost >= 27 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 63228 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 25 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_3yr_accidents, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 731 AND AVG(o.starost) < 31.86 ORDER BY year DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 1.67 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vozniski_staz_ll > 44 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS experienced_drivers, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS population_per_accident, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS accidents_last_12_months FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca IN ('1', '1') AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 731 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 26 ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, accidents_last_12_months DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(o.alkotest) / NULLIF(COUNT(o.alkotest), 0) AS avg_alcohol_level, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS accidents_with_culprit, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ue.id_upravna_enota), 0) AS avg_population_per_unit, SUM(ue.povrsina) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ue.id_upravna_enota), 0) AS avg_area_per_unit, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_12_month_accidents, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 49 AND 38 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 303186 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 369 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 12 ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE (n.upravna_enota = 7 OR n.kategorija_cesta IN ('A', 'A')) AND NOT (n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1') AND (o.starost >= 57 OR o.alkotest > 2.64) AND n.naselje_ali_izven = '1' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 1 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alcohol_level, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.vzrok_nesreca, ', ' ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS aggregated_causes, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age_involved FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2002 AND 2008 AND o.alkotest >= 1.82 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 677 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 1.12 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_level, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_road_category FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost > 53 AND alkotest > 1.57) AND n.kategorija_cesta = ANY(ARRAY['1','2','3']) AND TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= '2010-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 245 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) < 0.58 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, SUM(u.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina_upravnih_enot, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.02) AS stevilo_visjih_alkotestov FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON o.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY')) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2021 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.id_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 91 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 49 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, smrtne_zrtve DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_starost, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS p75_alkotest, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS p90_vozniski_staz, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS odstotek_zascitenih FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 26 AND o.alkotest >= 1.33 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 47 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) < 40 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, median_starost ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.67 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_nad_limitom_alkotesta, SUM(CASE WHEN o.strokovni_pregled > 2.21 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_nad_limitom_pregleda, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_udelezcih_v_kategoriji FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 261858) AND o.starost >= 69 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.poskodba = 'S' AND o2.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 81 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 467 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 69 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_participants, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_perpetrator_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca)) AS participant_percentile FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota BETWEEN 24 AND 120 AND o.starost >= 49 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = 2019 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 7 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') < 50 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, participant_percentile DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti_udelezencev, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS percentil_75_vozniskega_staza, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0) AS povprecna_alkotest_vrednost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec_z_udelezenci, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id_upravna_enota) AS povprecno_prebivalstvo_na_enoto FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 48 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 57 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0) < 0.71 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, smrtne_zrtve DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s_pasom_ali_celado, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prekoračitve_alkotesta, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_staz_ll, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 98 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 70 AND 47 AND o.alkotest >= 2.7 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 821 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 4658 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 48 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_povzrocitelj_age, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank_by_cause FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 93 AND o.starost <= 83 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE (n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' OR n.tip_nesreca = '1') AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 257413) AND o.starost BETWEEN 74 AND 68 AND NOT (n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND n.stanje_vozisce = '1') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 5 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 20 AND o.starost BETWEEN 21 AND 53 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 178991 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 32 AND AVG(o.starost) < 55 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC, avg_starost ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_equipment_used FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2011 AND o.starost >= 25 AND o.alkotest >= 4.9 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, year), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, year), (ue.ime_upravna_enota), (n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca), (n.vzrok_nesreca), (year), ()) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 651 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 2.75 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id_upravna_enota) AS povprecno_prebivalstvo_na_enoto, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE klas_nesreca = 'A' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 105) AND o.starost BETWEEN 24 AND 54 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 222865 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 39 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) > 4.78 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_meseci, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_visokih_alkotestov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.strokovni_pregled > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_strokovnih_pregledov, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT o.vrsta_udelezenca, ', ' ORDER BY o.vrsta_udelezenca) AS vrste_udelezencev, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT o.poskodba, ', ' ORDER BY o.poskodba) AS vrste_poskodb, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT o.spol, ', ' ORDER BY o.spol) AS spoli, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT o.drzavljanstvo, ', ' ORDER BY o.drzavljanstvo) AS drzavljanstva, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza_leta, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza_meseci, SUM(u.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina_upravnih_enot, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_st_prebivalcev, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / SUM(u.st_prebivalcev), 2) AS nesrece_na_milijon_prebivalcev, ROUND(COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / SUM(u.st_prebivalcev), 2) AS udelezenci_na_milijon_prebivalcev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost >= 23 AND o.alkotest >= 0.79 AND u.st_prebivalcev >= 330010 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 30 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 398 AND AVG(o.starost) < 48 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS stevilo_razlicnih_spolov, COUNT(DISTINCT o.drzavljanstvo) AS stevilo_razlicnih_drzavljanstev, COUNT(DISTINCT o.poskodba) AS stevilo_razlicnih_poskodb, COUNT(DISTINCT o.vrsta_udelezenca) AS stevilo_razlicnih_vrst_udelezencev, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(ue.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS mediana_x, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y) AS mediana_y, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x_wgs84) AS mediana_x_wgs84, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y_wgs84) AS mediana_y_wgs84, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS rang_po_povzrociteljih FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 432782 AND n.y > 517368 AND n.x_wgs84 > '0.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0.0' AND o.starost > 40 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll > 29 AND o.alkotest > 4.94 AND o.strokovni_pregled > 3.25 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 777382 AND ue.povrsina > 498 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 575 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 90 AND AVG(o.starost) > 116 AND AVG(o.alkotest) > 0.06 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) > 0 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT oseba.id_nesreca || oseba.spol) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN oseba.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatally_injured, SUM(CASE WHEN oseba.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severely_injured, SUM(CASE WHEN oseba.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lightly_injured, SUM(CASE WHEN oseba.poskodba = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uninjured, AVG(oseba.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE oseba.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_level, AVG(oseba.starost) FILTER (WHERE oseba.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age, AVG(oseba.vozniski_staz_ll + oseba.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE oseba.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL OR oseba.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS avg_driving_experience_years, SUM(CASE WHEN oseba.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_equipment_used, SUM(CASE WHEN oseba.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS culprits, SUM(CASE WHEN oseba.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS participants, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY oseba.starost) AS median_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY oseba.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE oseba.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS median_alcohol_level, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / ue.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_million_inhabitants, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / ue.povrsina) AS accidents_per_million_area_units FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba ON n.id_nesreca = oseba.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x BETWEEN 529504 AND 473538 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT id_nesreca) > 611) AND oseba.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 87 AND (oseba.alkotest >= 0.23 OR oseba.alkotest IS NULL) AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 56306 AND ue.povrsina > 7433 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o2.alkotest > 1.51) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT oseba.id_nesreca || oseba.spol) > 61 AND SUM(CASE WHEN oseba.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 10 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accidents_per_million_inhabitants DESC LIMIT 119;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS enota1, ue2.ime_upravna_enota AS enota2, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_v_enoti1, COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_v_enoti2, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezenca_enota1 FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota < ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n1 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n1.upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON ue2.id_upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca WHERE ue1.st_prebivalcev > 825409 AND ue2.povrsina > 8914 AND o1.poskodba = 'H' GROUP BY ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue2.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 42 ORDER BY nesrece_v_enoti1 DESC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS enota1_name, ue2.ime_upravna_enota AS enota2_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS accidents_enota1, COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) AS accidents_enota2, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_age_enota1, AVG(o2.starost) AS avg_age_enota2, SUM(CASE WHEN o1.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries_enota1, SUM(CASE WHEN o2.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries_enota2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) DESC) AS enota1_accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN nesreca n1 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n1.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota < ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON ue2.id_upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n1.upravna_enota = 5 AND n2.upravna_enota = 59 AND o1.starost >= 20 AND o2.starost >= 21 AND n1.tip_nesreca = 'A' AND n2.tip_nesreca = 'A' GROUP BY ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue2.ime_upravna_enota, ue1.id_upravna_enota, ue2.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 280 AND COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) > 202 ORDER BY enota1_accident_rank;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_starost_povzrocitelji FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN nesreca n1 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n1.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca AND o1.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n1.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND o1.starost BETWEEN 24 AND 47 GROUP BY ue1.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 39 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n.id_nesreca, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS participant_count FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota = 90 AND o.starost >= 79 GROUP BY n.id_nesreca HAVING COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 3 INTERSECT SELECT n.id_nesreca, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS participant_count FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE u.st_prebivalcev <= 37035 AND o.alkotest >= 0.95 GROUP BY n.id_nesreca HAVING COUNT(o.id_nesreca) < 7;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezenca FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 445281) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 338 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, (SELECT AVG(o2.starost) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota AND o2.starost > 75) AS avg_starost_above_threshold FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 898 AND ue.st_prebivalcev < 233215 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 51 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 659354) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 58.48 EXCEPT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.povrsina < 9077) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) < 32 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o2.id_nesreca) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 1.81 AND o2.starost > 94) AS high_risk_accidents, (SELECT SUM(u2.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(SUM(u2.povrsina), 0) FROM upravna_enota u2 WHERE u2.id_upravna_enota IN (SELECT n3.upravna_enota FROM nesreca n3 WHERE n3.upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota AND n3.vzrok_nesreca = '1' AND n3.tip_nesreca = '1')) AS avg_pop_density_high_risk FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 34 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2019 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 176 AND AVG(o.starost) < 51 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_involved ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, (u.st_prebivalcev * 1.0 / NULLIF(u.povrsina, 0)) AS population_density, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(u.st_prebivalcev, 0)) AS accidents_per_100k FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 323561) AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 71 AND 46 AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o2.alkotest > 1.08) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, u.st_prebivalcev, u.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 511 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('1', '2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 52 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_v_enoti, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS prejsnje_nesrece_po_vzroku FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.alkotest >= 3.51 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 82 AND AVG(o.starost) < 67 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesrece FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) = 2022 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 852 AND AVG(o.starost) < 28 UNION SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS povprecna_starost_zensk, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesrece FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 475045 AND n.y < 951707 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) = 2016 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 529 AND AVG(o.starost) > 73 ORDER BY rank_nesrece, upravna_enota;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 2.61) AS accidents_with_high_alcohol FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IS NOT NULL AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 39 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS caused_by_drivers, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 120 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 473 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') < 100 EXCEPT SELECT n2.upravna_enota, ue2.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca), SUM(CASE WHEN o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), AVG(o2.starost) FILTER (WHERE o2.spol = 'M'), PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o2.alkotest), RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) DESC) FROM nesreca n2 JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON n2.upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n2.x_wgs84 <= '-180.0' AND n2.y_wgs84 >= '-90.0' AND o2.starost <= 20 GROUP BY n2.upravna_enota, ue2.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) <= 716 OR AVG(o2.starost) FILTER (WHERE o2.spol = 'M') >= 109 ORDER BY accident_rank;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.tip_nesreca) AS kumulativne_nesrece_po_tipu, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec, ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.alkotest >= 0.83 AND o.starost BETWEEN 32 AND 29 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 535 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 40 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, rang_nesrec;

SELECT n1.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_starost_povzrocitelj, SUM(CASE WHEN n2.klas_nesreca = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_nesrece_count FROM nesreca n1 JOIN nesreca n2 ON n1.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n1.id_nesreca != n2.id_nesreca JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca AND o1.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n1.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n1.tip_nesreca = '1' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 370503 GROUP BY n1.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 81 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezenca FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '14000000' AND o.starost >= 19 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 30 UNION SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezenca FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y_wgs84 < '4500000' AND o.alkotest > 2.39 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) < 64 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 285994 AND o.starost >= 109 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 104 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS oseba_count FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IS NULL AND o.id_nesreca IS NULL AND u.st_prebivalcev > 44578 AND u.povrsina < 120114 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) = 0 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) = 0 ORDER BY u.st_prebivalcev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT n.x || ',' || n.y) AS distinct_locations, COUNT(DISTINCT n.vzrok_nesreca) AS distinct_causes, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS distinct_genders_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_causers, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 145563 AND n.y > 537021 AND o.starost BETWEEN 77 AND 117 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 237 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 4.7 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC, avg_age ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost, SUM(o.alkotest) AS total_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 210107 AND ue2.povrsina < 5362) AND o.starost BETWEEN 68 AND 26 AND n.x BETWEEN 868658 AND 865971 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 65 AND AVG(o.starost) < 60 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.69 LIMIT 1 ) AND n.upravna_enota > 53 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 42 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.14 LIMIT 1 ) AND n.upravna_enota > 18 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 25 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER() AS avg_accidents_per_unit, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS responsible_persons FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 74 AND o.starost >= 72 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 24 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.poskodba = 'S' AND o2.id_nesreca IN (SELECT n2.id_nesreca FROM nesreca n2 WHERE n2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND n2.tip_nesreca = '1') ) AS severe_injuries_in_accident_type FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 880 AND o.starost BETWEEN 38 AND 60 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 389 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_female_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca LIKE '%' AND n.vzrok_nesreca LIKE '%' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 49 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, (SELECT AVG(o2.starost) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.klas_nesreca = '1' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 236 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, (SELECT AVG(o2.starost) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' AND n.x_wgs84 >= '13.0' AND n.x_wgs84 <= '13.0' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 3 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_causers, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, MAX(u2.st_prebivalcev) AS max_population_in_region, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upravna_enota u3 WHERE u3.povrsina > ue.povrsina) AS areas_larger_than_current FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.93) AND ue.st_prebivalcev BETWEEN 936669 AND 687882 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 843 AND AVG(o.starost) < 32 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_male ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) - COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_participant_diff FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (93, 13, 56) AND o.starost >= 69 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 34 ORDER BY month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, ', ' ORDER BY n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje) AS ceste_naselja_list, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(SUM(ue.povrsina), 0) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 82 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 253 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) < 4.54 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, gostota_prebivalstva ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_meseci, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.drzavljanstvo = 'SLO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_slovencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%' AND n.tekst_odsek_ali_ulica LIKE '%' AND n.stacionazna_ali_hisna_st LIKE '%' AND n.cas_nesreca LIKE '%' AND o.starost >= 94 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 23 AND o.alkotest >= 2.95 AND o.strokovni_pregled >= 0.63 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 18764 AND ue.povrsina >= 430 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 98 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 357 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 58 AND AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) > 15 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS udelezenci_na_100k_prebivalcev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 69 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 51 AND AVG(o.alkotest) > 0.77 AND (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 > 59.11 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, udelezenci_na_100k_prebivalcev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza_let, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_stevila_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE ( (n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0')) AND (n.tip_nesreca = '1' OR n.vzrok_nesreca = '1') AND NOT (n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND n.stanje_promet = '1') AND (n.kategorija_cesta = '1' OR n.naselje_ali_izven = '1') AND (o.starost >= 46 OR o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 30) AND (o.alkotest >= 2.64 OR o.strokovni_pregled = 0.71) AND (o.spol = 'M' OR o.drzavljanstvo = 'S') AND (o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' OR o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, leto_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 758 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 59 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 73 AND o.starost BETWEEN 18 AND 66 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 21306 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(*) > 8 ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 53905 AND o.starost BETWEEN 19 AND 51 AND n.x BETWEEN 59882 AND 400151 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_povzrocitelj_age, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND o.starost >= 28 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 99189 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_tipa_nesrece FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 49 AND o.alkotest >= 1.8 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 266707 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 690 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 0.25 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.spol = 'M' AND n.klas_nesreca = 'A' AND o.starost >= 55 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 9 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 8 AND o.starost BETWEEN 24 AND 78 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 45 UNION ALL SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota < 105 AND o.starost NOT BETWEEN 21 AND 48 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) <= 2 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_v_enoti, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec_po_vzroku FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost >= 94 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 4493277 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 844 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 1.32 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS udelezenci_na_100k_prebivalcev, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah_v_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 88 AND o.starost BETWEEN 83 AND 54 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND ue.povrsina > 8132 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 25 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 49 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;
