COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 187 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o2.id_nesreca) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND o2.alkotest > 1.98) AS accidents_with_drunk_driver FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 30831 AND ue2.povrsina < 736) AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND n.stanje_promet = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' AND o.starost BETWEEN 37 AND 42 AND n.x BETWEEN 703140 AND 490704 AND n.y BETWEEN 602653 AND 803338 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 364 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 29 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, fatal_injuries DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota UNION ALL SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS oseba_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN oseba o ON u.id_upravna_enota = o.upravna_enota WHERE o.starost > 80 AND o.alkotest < 2.66 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 330812 AND o.starost > 53 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 595 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.tip_nesreca, ', ' ORDER BY n.tip_nesreca) AS tipi_nesrec FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost >= 96 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 21 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' AND o.alkotest > 0.95) AS nesrece_z_vinjenim_voznikom FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%Ljubljana%' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 44 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS p75_alkotest FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '1400000' AND o.starost >= 100 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 983 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IS NULL AND u.st_prebivalcev > 97382 AND u.povrsina < 747496 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 887038 AND o.starost > 66 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 697 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 48 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 19 AND o.alkotest >= 1.71 AND n.vreme_nesreca IN ('1', '1') GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 12 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 17 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(*) as stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) as povprecna_starost, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as smrtne_zrtve FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 47 AND o.starost >= 52 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca), (u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca), (u.ime_upravna_enota), () ) ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank_vzrok FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.vzrok_nesreca IS NOT NULL AND o.starost > 8 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 506 ORDER BY u.ime_upravna_enota, rank_vzrok;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_starost_m, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_starost_z, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY u.ime_upravna_enota) AS total_nesrece_v_enoti FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 17 AND o.starost > 45 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 17 ORDER BY total_nesrece_v_enoti DESC, nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_female_age, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 84 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 478 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (100, 153, 271) AND (n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' OR n.vzrok_nesreca = '2') AND n.tip_nesreca NOT IN ('1', '2') AND o.starost BETWEEN 24 AND 48 AND (o.alkotest > 0.3 OR o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 20 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '1') AS avg_male_age, (SELECT AVG(o2.alkotest) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 0) AS avg_positive_alkotest_in_unit, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND ue.povrsina >= 23815 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 887 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 22 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_male_age ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS accident_month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.83 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 10 ORDER BY accident_month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS accident_month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 1.54 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 78 ORDER BY accident_month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3year FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 47 AND o.starost > 60 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 13 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND o.starost >= 86 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 660527 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 44 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 914959 AND o.starost BETWEEN 20 AND 40 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year, quarter HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 1 ORDER BY year DESC, quarter DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT o.vrsta_udelezenca, ', ' ORDER BY o.vrsta_udelezenca) AS vrste_udelezencev, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 7 AND o.alkotest >= 3.2 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 770 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 3.88 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_vozniski_staz, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(SUM(ue.povrsina), 0) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI') >= '2010-01-01' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 470754 AND o.starost BETWEEN 89 AND 19 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 62 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) > 1.41 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 1.71 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vozniski_staz_ll > 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS experienced_drivers, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_road_type, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS accidents_per_100k_inhabitants FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2016 AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN ('1', '1', '1') AND ue.povrsina > 2845 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')), ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 724 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accidents_per_100k_inhabitants DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_povzrocitelj_age, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND o.starost >= 65 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 64878 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 35 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti_udelezencev, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS percentil_75_vozniskega_staza, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0) AS povprecna_alkotest_vrednost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec_z_udelezenci, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id_upravna_enota) AS povprecno_prebivalstvo_na_enoto FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 89 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 86 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0) < 0.12 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, smrtne_zrtve DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatalities_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uninjured_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 2.23 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vozniski_staz_ll > 34 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS experienced_drivers_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS accidents_with_culprit_identified, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_unit, ROUND(ue.st_prebivalcev::numeric / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0), 2) AS population_density FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 433) AND n.cas_nesreca IS NOT NULL AND o.starost BETWEEN 23 AND 68 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 9 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, fatalities_count DESC LIMIT 464;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rang_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost >= 37 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 768 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE (n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' OR n.tip_nesreca = '1') AND NOT (n.naselje_ali_izven = '1') AND o.starost > 71 AND o.alkotest < 0.88 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 25 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnimi_pasovi, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_brez_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zenskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.drzavljanstvo = 'SLO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_slovencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_potnikov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'K' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_kolesarjev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_motornih_kolesarjev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_ostalih, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, (ue.st_prebivalcev::float / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS percent_rank_nesrece, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesrece, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS dense_rank_nesrece, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec, LEAD(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca) AS naslednje_stevilo_nesrec, (SELECT AVG(sub_o.starost) FROM oseba sub_o WHERE sub_o.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND sub_o.starost > 2) AS povprecna_starost_nad_pragom, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sub_n.id_nesreca) FROM nesreca sub_n WHERE sub_n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND sub_n.x > 345382 AND sub_n.y > 678695) AS stevilo_nesrec_koordinati_nad_pragom FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0.0' AND o.starost > 75 AND o.alkotest > 1.24 AND o.strokovni_pregled > 3.9 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 420 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 1149 AND AVG(o.starost) > 97 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 47967) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 117 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x > 251526 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) OR n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE y < 470431 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) < 29 ) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 38.05 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezko_poškodovani, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udeležencev, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('1','2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS globalni_rang_hujsih_poskodb FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.alkotest >= 0.05 AND o.starost BETWEEN 106 AND 56 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 333 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('1','2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 828 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, globalni_rang_hujsih_poskodb;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, (SUM(u.povrsina) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0)) AS area_per_accident, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 55 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, u.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 493 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 43 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_male ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS perpetrator_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS participant_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, (SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / SUM(u.povrsina)) AS population_density FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost >= 39 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 325 AND AVG(o.starost) < 77 UNION SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS perpetrator_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS participant_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, (SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / SUM(u.povrsina)) AS population_density FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 < '0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost <= 11 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 134 AND AVG(o.starost) > 61 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT DISTINCT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 24 AND 70 ) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 26 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '100000' AND n.y_wgs84 < '100000' GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota UNION ALL SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS oseba_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN oseba o ON u.id_upravna_enota = o.upravna_enota WHERE o.starost > 32 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll > 18 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 62861 AND o.starost > 76 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 939 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS osebe_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 78 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= 2016 AND o.starost >= 91 AND u.st_prebivalcev >= 496643 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 4 ORDER BY u.ime_upravna_enota, year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responsible_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 12 AND o.starost >= 83 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 19099 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 29 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_people, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN o.id_nesreca END) AS distinct_accidents_with_causers, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alcohol_positive_cases FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 45 AND o.starost BETWEEN 23 AND 60 AND n.x BETWEEN 47176 AND 204840 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 32 AND AVG(o.starost) >= 25 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT (n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca)) AS distinct_cause_type_pairs, SUM(o.alkotest) AS total_alcohol_test_value, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 77 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 48 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT n.x || ',' || n.y) AS distinct_locations, COUNT(DISTINCT n.vzrok_nesreca || n.tip_nesreca) AS distinct_cause_type_pairs, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_causers, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, MAX(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS max_population FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 215681 AND n.y > 466797 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 1082860 AND o.starost BETWEEN 57 AND 96 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 55 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 237 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC, avg_age_involved ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS distinct_genders_involved, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 30 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 991 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 2.5) AS high_alcohol_cases FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (79, 76, 36) AND o.starost BETWEEN 25 AND 70 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = 2016 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 23 AND AVG(o.starost) < 39 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS p75_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost >= 24 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 45 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 2.12 AND o2.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS high_alcohol_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS median_x_coordinate, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND ue.povrsina > 8154 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 648 AND AVG(o.starost) < 24 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, severe_injuries DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, o.spol, o.vrsta_udelezenca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(DISTINCT o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS stevilo_alkotestov, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zascitenih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE ( (n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND y_wgs84 < '45.0' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 30)) OR (n.upravna_enota NOT IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE stanje_promet = 'G' AND stanje_vozisce = 'M')) ) AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vreme_nesreca NOT IN ('J', 'O') AND o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND (o.starost BETWEEN 21 AND 63 OR o.starost IS NULL) AND (o.alkotest > 2.17 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, o.spol, o.vrsta_udelezenca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 15 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 33 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responsible_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_experience FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota BETWEEN 64 AND 164 AND o.starost >= 64 AND n.x BETWEEN 96090 AND 86512 AND n.y BETWEEN 66963 AND 151772 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 72712 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 37 AND AVG(o.starost) < 63 ORDER BY accident_count DESC, avg_age DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE o.starost > 88 AND n.upravna_enota > 387 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 223 ORDER BY stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezenca, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_alkotest_vrednost, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D') AS stevilo_nesrec_z_varnostnim_pasom, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled = 1) AS stevilo_nesrec_s_strokovnim_pregledom, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS povprecno_st_prebivalcev_na_enoto, SUM(ue.povrsina) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS povprecna_povrsina_enote, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_stevilu_nesrec, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec_v_enoti_po_vzroku FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 810661 AND ue.povrsina < 194195 AND (o.starost BETWEEN 24 AND 34 OR o.starost IS NULL) AND (o.alkotest >= 1.03 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 18 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 37 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezenca ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS oseba_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE (n.tip_nesreca = '1' OR n.vzrok_nesreca = '1') AND NOT (n.naselje_ali_izven = '1') AND (o.starost >= 26 OR o.alkotest > 0.23) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 560 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_zazdevek, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, MAX(o.alkotest) AS max_alkotest FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 902476 AND ue.povrsina < 957106) AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.alkotest > 2.03 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 214 AND AVG(o.starost) < 47 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(u2.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON u.id_upravna_enota = u2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 21 AND 21 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 94 AND AVG(o.alkotest) > 1.78 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(u2.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON u.id_upravna_enota = u2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 313371 AND n.y < 570788 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll > 14 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 797 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 83 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(SUM(u.povrsina), 0) AS gostota_prebivalstva, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_vzroku, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.vzrok_nesreca = n2.vzrok_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 84 AND o.alkotest >= 3.17 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 493007 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 91 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 306 ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '4600000' AND n.y_wgs84 < '100000' AND o.starost >= 56 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 27 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 UNION SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 < '4600000' AND n.y_wgs84 > '100000' AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 48 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 87 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezko_poškodovani, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahko_poškodovani, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0) AS median_alkotest_pozitiven, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS nesrece_s_povzrociteljem, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_prebivalci_na_enoto, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 101 AND 102 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 295 AND AVG(o.starost) < 37 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_moskih ASC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 29399 AND ue.povrsina < 2668) AND o.starost > 53 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 98 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost > 71 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 446 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 226806 ) AND o.starost > 40 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 67 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 14525 AND o.starost >= 100 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 578 UNION SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 345165 AND o.starost <= 6 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING SUM(o.starost) < 39146 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 958927 AND o.starost >= 35 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 169 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.tip_nesreca, ', ' ORDER BY n.tip_nesreca) AS tipi_nesrec FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE o.starost >= 84 AND n.x_wgs84 >= '13.0' GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 18 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 617895 AND o.starost >= 10 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 793 UNION ALL SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 53100 AND o.starost <= 14 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) < 565;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 38 AND o.starost <= 99 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 32 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 295498 AND o.starost > 89 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS cetrtletje_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < '2016-01-01' AND o.starost >= 40 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, leto_nesreca, cetrtletje_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 16 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, leto_nesreca, cetrtletje_nesreca;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_female_age FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < '2016-01-01' AND n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' AND o.poskodba = '1' GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, year, quarter HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 45 ORDER BY year DESC, quarter DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS accident_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 63 AND 64 AND id_nesreca IN ( SELECT id_nesreca FROM nesreca WHERE x BETWEEN 465058 AND 831826 ) ) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 69 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.starost) AS unique_ages, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injury_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 79 AND o.starost BETWEEN 21 AND 77 AND o.alkotest >= 0.02 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 18 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_starost_zenske FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost >= 69 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 31 UNION SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_starost_zenske FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost >= 22 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 11 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost > 47 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 26 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS accidents_with_culprits, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatalities, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS median_x_coordinate, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y) AS median_y_coordinate, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS population, MAX(u.povrsina) AS area, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS fatality_rank FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca LEFT JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND (n.x BETWEEN 922124 AND 549325 OR n.x IS NULL) AND (n.y BETWEEN 235390 AND 651274 OR n.y IS NULL) AND (o.starost >= 88 OR o.starost IS NULL) AND (u.st_prebivalcev >= 838434 OR u.st_prebivalcev IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 4192 AND (SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 786 OR SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) IS NULL) ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_male DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_participants, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 11 AND o.starost >= 93 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 50 ORDER BY accident_rank;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, (SELECT AVG(o2.starost) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost >= 98 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 589 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, (SELECT AVG(o2.alkotest) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 0) AS avg_positive_alkotest_in_unit, SUM(u.povrsina) AS total_area FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 15 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 749 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 477 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, (SELECT AVG(o2.alkotest) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 0) AS avg_positive_alkotest_in_unit, SUM(u.povrsina) AS total_area FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 76 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 63 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 7 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, MAX(n.x_wgs84) - MIN(n.x_wgs84) AS longitude_range, MAX(n.y_wgs84) - MIN(n.y_wgs84) AS latitude_range, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.22 LIMIT 1)) AS accidents_with_high_alc, SUM(CASE WHEN n.tip_nesreca = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pedestrian_accidents, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '14.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '46.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2020-01-01' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 150431 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nesreca n2 WHERE n2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND n2.klas_nesreca = 'B' AND n2.vzrok_nesreca IN ('01','02') LIMIT 18 OFFSET 651) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 401 AND AVG(o.starost) < 55 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, severe_injuries DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS cetrtletje_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_alkotesta, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti_in_letu, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS gost_rang_nesrec, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativne_nesrece_enota FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 96 AND o.starost <= 59 AND o.alkotest >= 1.1 AND o.alkotest <= 2.3 AND o.strokovni_pregled >= 8.12 AND o.strokovni_pregled <= 4.1 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 470567 AND ue.st_prebivalcev <= 879248 AND ue.povrsina >= 9407 AND ue.povrsina <= 7099 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 57 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 209 ORDER BY leto_nesreca DESC, cetrtletje_nesreca DESC, stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 1.99 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN n.vreme_nesreca = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clear_weather_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN n.vreme_nesreca = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rain_weather_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN n.stanje_vozisce = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dry_road_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN n.stanje_vozisce = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wet_road_accidents, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS accidents_per_100k, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_12_month_accidents, AVG(ue.povrsina) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota) AS avg_area_per_unit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 487054 AND o.starost BETWEEN 78 AND 38 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 307 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 46 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year, month;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS skupno_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hude_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahke_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 1.03 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nad_limit_alkotesta, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS nesrece_povzrocitelji, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS mediana_gostote_prebivalstva, (SUM(CASE WHEN n.vreme_nesreca = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) AS dele_nesrec_v_dezju FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.kategorija_cesta = n2.kategorija_cesta JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca AND o.spol = o2.spol WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 329932 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 450 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY skupno_nesrec DESC, leto_nesreca;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_minor_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_road_category FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 311) AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost >= 97 AND n.vzrok_nesreca = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT vzrok_nesreca FROM nesreca WHERE klas_nesreca IN ('1','2') AND stanje_promet = '1')) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 438 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 33 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year, ue.ime_upravna_enota;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.poskodba, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec, o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(o.alkotest) AS skupni_alkotest, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(o.strokovni_pregled) AS skupni_strokovni_pregled, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_staz_ll, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_staz_mm, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(ue.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_cesti_vzroku, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(o.alkotest) DESC) AS rang_povprecnega_alkotesta, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota) AS kumulativne_nesrece_v_enoti, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY AVG(o.starost)) AS prejsnje_nesrece_po_starosti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%' AND n.tekst_odsek_ali_ulica LIKE '%' AND o.starost >= 76 AND o.alkotest >= 2.11 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 650224 AND ue.povrsina >= 5832 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.poskodba, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec, o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 68 AND AVG(o.alkotest) > 3.74 AND SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) > 657078 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS drunk_drivers, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_in_unit FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 199366) AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN (SELECT vzrok_nesreca FROM nesreca GROUP BY vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 674) AND o.starost BETWEEN 19 AND 99 AND (o.alkotest > 0.97 OR o.strokovni_pregled > 5.08) AND n.kategorija_cesta = 'A' AND n.naselje_ali_izven = '1' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 2 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 7 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 34 AND o.starost BETWEEN 74 AND 44 AND n.x BETWEEN 48339 AND 59182 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 49 ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, accident_rank;
