SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS parent_unit, ue2.ime_upravna_enota AS child_unit, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alcohol_level, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue1.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n ON ue2.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 51 GROUP BY ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue1.id_upravna_enota, ue2.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 215 AND AVG(o.alkotest) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, parent_unit, child_unit;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_starost_povzrocitelji FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN nesreca n1 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n1.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca AND o1.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n1.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND o1.starost BETWEEN 33 AND 44 GROUP BY ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue1.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 35 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

WITH accident_stats AS ( SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS unique_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN n.klas_nesreca = '{{p1}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_class_accidents, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '{{p2}}') AS avg_age_responsible FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.alkotest >= 0.38 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 61 ), unit_stats AS ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, ue.st_prebivalcev::numeric / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) AS population_density, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY as2.avg_age_responsible) AS median_age_responsible FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN accident_stats as2 ON ue.id_upravna_enota = as2.upravna_enota WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 818455 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina ) SELECT us.id_upravna_enota, us.st_prebivalcev, us.povrsina, us.population_density, COALESCE(as1.total_accidents, 0) AS total_accidents, COALESCE(as1.unique_accidents, 0) AS unique_accidents, COALESCE(as1.specific_class_accidents, 0) AS specific_class_accidents, COALESCE(as1.avg_age_responsible, 0) AS avg_age_responsible, us.median_age_responsible, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(as1.total_accidents, 0) DESC) AS accident_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY us.population_density DESC) AS density_rank FROM unit_stats us LEFT JOIN accident_stats as1 ON us.id_upravna_enota = as1.upravna_enota WHERE us.population_density BETWEEN 7295.37 AND 5249.17 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, population_density DESC LIMIT 232;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND o2.starost > 76 ) AND u.st_prebivalcev > 696402 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 120 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 389526) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 405 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS oseba_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE (n.tip_nesreca = '1' OR n.vzrok_nesreca = '1') AND NOT (n.naselje_ali_izven = '1') AND (o.starost >= 97 OR o.alkotest > 0.65) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 987 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' AND o.starost >= 14 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 552 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 24 AND o.starost > 23 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota), (n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca), (n.vzrok_nesreca), () ) ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 793580 AND o.starost > 94 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota UNION ALL SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 276136 AND o.alkotest > 1.85 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 295506) AND o.starost > 87 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 18 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 677499 AND o.starost > 6 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 376 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 8 AND o.starost BETWEEN 24 AND 35 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 21 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 385217 AND n.y > 159609 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 795943 AND n.y > 674684 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 73 AND o.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 91 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 46 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 82 AND o.starost > 95 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 29 UNION SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota < 179 AND o.starost < 1 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) < 107 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 289 AND o.starost > 53 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca), (u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca), (u.ime_upravna_enota), () ) ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS distinct_genders_involved, SUM(o.starost) AS total_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost >= 28 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 773 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o WHERE o.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o.starost >= 35 AND o.alkotest >= 1.12 ) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 36 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 485936 AND o.starost >= 51 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 804 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 233914 ) AND o.starost >= 38 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 42 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_poskodbe_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.36 ) AND n.upravna_enota >= 71 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 44 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.81 ORDER BY o2.alkotest DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 33 ) AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 296 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND o2.alkotest > 0.68) AS count_high_alc_culprits FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.klas_nesreca = 'A' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 161595 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 20 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.38 ORDER BY o2.alkotest DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 27 ) AND n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 173 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '{{p3}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_injury_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 1.98 AND o2.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 66) AS high_alcohol_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 54532) AND n.x BETWEEN 814348 AND 1068990 AND n.y BETWEEN 655136 AND 1804303 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 11 AND AVG(o.starost) < 45 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_involved ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_injured, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'H') AS avg_age_seriously_injured, SUM(CASE WHEN n.vzrok_nesreca = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_human_error, SUM(CASE WHEN n.vzrok_nesreca = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_technical_failure, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / ue.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_million_inhabitants FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ELSE 0 END) AS count_technical_failure, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / ue.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_million_inhabitants FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE y_wgs84 < '-90.0' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) < 571) AND o.alkotest > 0.46 AND n.cas_nesreca <= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) < 9726 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'H') > 11 ORDER BY accident_rank;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 1.06) AS high_alcohol_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS median_x_coordinate, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2020-01-01' AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 4 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 583 AND AVG(o.starost) < 54 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_accidents FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota = 729 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 8 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 2.43 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS accidents_with_culprit, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_residents_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_year, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS prev_month_accidents, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_12m_accidents FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND y_wgs84 < '45.0' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 949) AND o.starost BETWEEN 31 AND 55 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), u.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 42 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 3 ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 2.72 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS accidents_with_culprit, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_population_per_unit, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_12mo_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca IN ('1', '1') AND u.st_prebivalcev > 186049 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 52 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 1 ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uporaba_varnostne_opreme, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2010 AND 2010 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 84 AND 92 AND o.alkotest BETWEEN 1.17 AND 2.86 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 65 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 123 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT oseba.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_persons, SUM(CASE WHEN oseba.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS causers_count, AVG(oseba.starost) FILTER (WHERE oseba.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(oseba.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE oseba.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_population_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_road_type FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba ON n.id_nesreca = oseba.id_nesreca WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2017 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 799510 AND (oseba.alkotest > 0.95 OR oseba.alkotest IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 52 AND AVG(oseba.starost) FILTER (WHERE oseba.starost IS NOT NULL) < 39 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_population_per_unit ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza_let, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_stevila_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE ( (n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0')) AND (n.tip_nesreca = '1' OR n.vzrok_nesreca = '1') AND NOT (n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND n.stanje_promet = '1') AND (n.kategorija_cesta = '1' OR n.naselje_ali_izven = '1') AND (o.starost >= 30 OR o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 58) AND (o.alkotest >= 0.46 OR o.strokovni_pregled = 0.52) AND (o.spol = 'M' OR o.drzavljanstvo = 'S') AND (o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' OR o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, leto_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 375 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 70 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.klas_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahkotne_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS brez_varnostnega_pasa, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza_let, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_udelezencev_v_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%Ljubljana%' AND n.tekst_odsek_ali_ulica LIKE '%ulica%' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 71 AND (o.alkotest > 2.0 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 154489) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.klas_nesreca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 14 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 89 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 31 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_mesecih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_udelezcih, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS zaporedna_stevilka_v_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%glavna%' AND n.tekst_odsek_ali_ulica LIKE '%ulica%' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '08:00' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 876303 AND ue.povrsina BETWEEN 4056 AND 41871 AND o.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 67 AND o.alkotest >= 0.75 AND (o.vozniski_staz_ll > 3 OR o.vozniski_staz_mm > 5) AND o.spol IN ('M', 'Z') AND o.drzavljanstvo LIKE 'SLO%' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca IN ('V', 'M', 'P') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND o2.alkotest > 2.78 ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 63 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 410 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 44 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <= 1 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC LIMIT 416;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 42436 AND o.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 56 AND n.x BETWEEN 94619 AND 392332 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(*) > 4 ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_prizadetih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 1 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 853 UNION ALL SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, 'VSE' AS tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_prizadetih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 409376 AND n.y < 765796 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 51 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.alkotest) > 2.72 ORDER BY ime_upravna_enota, tip_nesreca;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost, SUM(o.alkotest) AS total_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 23 AND o.starost BETWEEN 19 AND 67 AND o.alkotest >= 0.07 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 35 AND AVG(o.starost) < 60 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC, total_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost, SUM(o.alkotest) AS total_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 69 AND o.starost BETWEEN 24 AND 32 AND o.alkotest >= 1.03 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 5 AND AVG(o.starost) < 51 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC, total_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahzje_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zensk, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0) AS median_alkotest_pozitiven, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(o.id_nesreca), 0) AS odstotek_z_varnostnim_pasom, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) AS nesrece_na_million_prebivalcev, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_stevilu_nesrec, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_udelezencev_po_tipu FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca AND n.upravna_enota = o.upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 24292 AND o.starost BETWEEN 88 AND 88 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 47 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 78 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 13 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, nesrece_na_million_prebivalcev DESC LIMIT 721;

ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 736216 AND n.y > 159653 AND o.starost > 72 AND o.alkotest > 1.45 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 310744 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca,
