AS stevilo_tezkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_potnikov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'K' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_kolesarjev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_motoristov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_ostalih, (ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS percent_rank_nesrece, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY AVG(o.alkotest) DESC) AS row_num_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '45.0' AND o.starost >= 42 AND o.alkotest >= 2.68 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 495108 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 28 AND AVG(o.alkotest) > 1.3 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm/12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_brez_poskodb, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm/12.0)) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 897928 AND povrsina < 1680) AND o.starost BETWEEN 86 AND 26 AND o.alkotest BETWEEN 2.0 AND 4.11 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND o2.alkotest > 0.65) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 18 AND AVG(o.starost) > 29 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 1 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

WITH accident_stats AS ( SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS unique_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 2.88 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_experience FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '14.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '46.0' AND o.starost >= 79 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota ), unit_density AS ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, ue.st_prebivalcev::numeric / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) AS population_density, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accidents_per_area, AVG(n.x) AS avg_x_coord, AVG(n.y) AS avg_y_coord FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 157336 AND ue.povrsina > 4047 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina ), combined_analysis AS ( SELECT 'high_density' AS analysis_type, ud.id_upravna_enota, ud.population_density, ud.accidents_per_area, ud.avg_x_coord, ud.avg_y_coord, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ud.population_density DESC) AS density_rank FROM unit_density ud WHERE ud.population_density > 2634.98 UNION ALL SELECT 'high_accidents' AS analysis_type, as1.upravna_enota AS id_upravna_enota, ud.population_density, as1.total_accidents AS accidents_per_area, ud.avg_x_coord, ud.avg_y_coord, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY as1.total_accidents DESC) AS density_rank FROM accident_stats as1 JOIN unit_density ud ON as1.upravna_enota = ud.id_upravna_enota WHERE as1.total_accidents > 3374 AND as1.high_alcohol_cases > 441 ) SELECT ca.analysis_type, ca.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ca.population_density, ca.accidents_per_area, ca.avg_x_coord, ca.avg_y_coord, ca.density_rank, as2.avg_age, as2.serious_injuries, as2.high_alcohol_cases, as2.median_experience, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.analysis_type ORDER BY ca.accidents_per_area DESC) AS accident_rank FROM combined_analysis ca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON ca.id_upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota LEFT JOIN accident_stats as2 ON ca.id_upravna_enota = as2.upravna_enota WHERE ca.density_rank <= 35 ORDER BY ca.analysis_type, ca.density_rank, accident_rank;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND o2.starost > 94 ) AND u.st_prebivalcev > 565950 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 292 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezenca FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 427046) AND o.starost > 30 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 436498 AND o.starost > 4 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 528 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.y < 888851 AND o.alkotest > 3.44 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) < 405 ORDER BY upravna_enota;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota = 82 AND o.starost >= 19 AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 418 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '1') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, SUM(u2.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS prebivalci_na_nesreco FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON u.id_upravna_enota = u2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 595770 AND n.y < 937077 AND o.alkotest > 2.09 AND u.st_prebivalcev >= 679222 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 350 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '1') < 28 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '1') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '2') AS avg_age_female, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY MIN(CAST(SUBSTRING(n.cas_nesreca FROM 1 FOR 4) AS INTEGER))) AS prev_year_accidents, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS population_per_accident FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.alkotest >= 0.21 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 28 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 23 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '1') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '2') AS avg_age_female, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota) AS population_in_unit, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota), 0)) AS accidents_per_100k FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.alkotest >= 1.2 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, u.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 548 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS caused_by_driver, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(u2.st_prebivalcev) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY u2.povrsina DESC) AS cumulative_population_by_area, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON u.id_upravna_enota = u2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.alkotest >= 0.91 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, u2.povrsina, u2.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 509 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS perpetrator_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS max_population, MIN(u.povrsina) AS min_area, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS perpetrator_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 906636 AND ue.povrsina < 6453 ) OR n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT n2.upravna_enota FROM nesreca n2 JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE o2.starost > 47 AND o2.alkotest > 0.28 GROUP BY n2.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) > 78 ) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 382 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 41 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, perpetrator_count ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.alkotest) AS unique_alkotest_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_age, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS avg_license_years, MAX(n.x) AS max_x_coordinate, MIN(n.y) AS min_y_coordinate, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injury_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.alkotest) DESC) AS alkotest_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 148166 AND n.y < 668834 AND o.starost BETWEEN 18 AND 59 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.alkotest) > 98.1 AND SUM(o.starost) > 1445 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.strokovni_pregled) AS unique_pregled_count, SUM(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS total_months, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, MAX(n.x_wgs84) AS max_wgs84_x, MIN(n.y_wgs84) AS min_wgs84_y, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_gear_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.strokovni_pregled) DESC) AS pregled_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND o.alkotest > 1.26 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 61 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.strokovni_pregled) < 91.96 AND AVG(o.starost) < 87 ORDER BY upravna_enota;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hude_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm/12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_leta, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s_pasom_ali_celado, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS moski, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zenske, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS prebivalci_enote, MAX(u.povrsina) AS povrsina_enote, (MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(MAX(u.povrsina),0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 140462 AND ue.povrsina < 3851) AND o.starost > 80 AND o.alkotest > 2.6 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 9 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 18 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 9 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 61 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, MAX(o.alkotest) AS max_alcohol_level, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 391610) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND o2.alkotest > 2.51) AND n.tip_nesreca = ANY(ARRAY['1','2','3']) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 864 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 45 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_male_age;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezke_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahke_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_alkotest, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS prebivalci_na_enoto, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah_v_enoti, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (ORDER BY n.upravna_enota) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.vzrok_nesreca = n2.vzrok_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost >= 25 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 105025 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 70 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) < 0.83 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, n.upravna_enota;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezke_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahke_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_alkotest, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS prebivalci_na_enoto, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah_v_enoti, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (ORDER BY n.upravna_enota) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.vzrok_nesreca = n2.vzrok_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost >= 90 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 851728 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 23 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) < 3.51 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, n.upravna_enota;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahke_poskodbe, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_z_udelezenci, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenskih, SUM(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 2.99) AS vsota_pozitivnih_alkotestov, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS percent_rank_nesrece, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS rang_v_enoti FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 47 AND n.upravna_enota <= 33 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND o.starost >= 54 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 28 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 31 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 24 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, smrtne_zrtve DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT DISTINCT o.upravna_enota FROM oseba o WHERE o.starost BETWEEN 80 AND 52 ) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 19 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS oseba_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezenca FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 108 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 561 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 764260 AND o.starost > 81 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 374 UNION SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 190819 AND o.alkotest > 2.27 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING SUM(o.starost) < 14146 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.vzrok_nesreca, ', ' ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS vzroki_nesrec FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost >= 27 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 35 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 595834 AND o.starost > 64 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 479 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT DISTINCT o.upravna_enota FROM oseba o WHERE o.starost > 49 AND o.alkotest > 0.51 ) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 39 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.vzrok_nesreca IS NOT NULL AND o.starost > 43 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 580 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT n.x || ',' || n.y) AS distinct_locations, COUNT(DISTINCT n.vzrok_nesreca) AS distinct_causes, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS distinct_genders_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_causers, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 995555 AND n.y > 443017 AND o.starost BETWEEN 80 AND 113 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 859 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 4.16 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC, avg_age ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 385303) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 98 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS oseba_count FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 18 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_povzrocitelj FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 372599 ) AND n.x_wgs84 > '14000000' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) < 27.2 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 149375) AND o.starost > 39 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 10 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS osebe_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_starost_m, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_starost_z FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 626701 AND n.y < 131715 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 96 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')) = 2016 AND o.alkotest > 1.1 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 24 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost >= 80 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota UNION ALL SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.vozniski_staz_ll <= 27 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 2.28 AND o2.starost BETWEEN 24 AND 74) AS high_alcohol_cases FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x BETWEEN 477209 AND 523042 AND n.y BETWEEN 54821 AND 128971 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 321138 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 87 AND AVG(o.starost) < 56 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_involved ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 > '14.0' AND id_nesreca IN ( SELECT id_nesreca FROM oseba WHERE starost > 69 AND alkotest > 0.9 ) ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 24 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_alc) FROM (SELECT upravna_enota, MAX(alkotest) AS max_alc FROM oseba WHERE alkotest > 1.64 GROUP BY upravna_enota) sub WHERE sub.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota) AS max_alcohol_in_unit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) BETWEEN 2018 AND 2020 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 310 AND AVG(o.starost) < 74 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_involved ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND o.starost >= 94 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 333 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, (SELECT AVG(o2.starost) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost >= 60 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 299 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 279538 AND o.starost >= 81 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS cetrtletje, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' AND o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o.alkotest > 1.38 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 828 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 38 ORDER BY leto DESC, cetrtletje DESC, stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS cetrtletje_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota = 18 AND o.starost >= 68 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, leto_nesreca, cetrtletje_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 21 ORDER BY leto_nesreca DESC, cetrtletje_nesreca DESC, stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_population_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_year FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca IN ('1', '1', '1') AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' AND o.alkotest >= 0.91 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 231812 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 787 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 72 ORDER BY year DESC, quarter DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS udelezenci_na_100k_prebivalcev, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2012 AND n.kategorija_cesta IN ('A', 'A') AND o.starost >= 46 AND ue.povrsina > 7192 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')), ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 96 AND AVG(o.starost) < 38.24 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, udelezenci_na_100k_prebivalcev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT o.vrsta_udelezenca, ', ' ORDER BY o.vrsta_udelezenca) AS vrste_udelezencev, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev) AS mediana_prebivalcev, SUM(ue.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina_upravnih_enot FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 84 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 35 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 30.86 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupna_povrsina_upravnih_enot ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.upravna_enota ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_accidents FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 36 AND o.starost BETWEEN 19 AND 78 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 1207 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_povzrocitelj_age, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND o.starost >= 48 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 419070 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 78 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_age_female, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 48 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 204 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_povzrocitelj_age, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank_by_cause FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 29 AND o.starost <= 87 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 23 AND o.starost >= 71 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 1 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' AND o.starost >= 67 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 233077 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 39 AND AVG(o.starost) < 25 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC, avg_starost ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS st_nesrec, COUNT(DISTINCT o.starost) AS st_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povp_starost, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS st_z_varnostnim_pasom, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 75 AND o.alkotest >= 1.32 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 41 AND AVG(o.starost) > 58 ORDER BY st_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS prebivalci_na_nesreco, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_vzroka_v_enoti, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev DESC) AS kumulativne_nesrece_po_tipu FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.alkotest > 3.67 AND ue.povrsina >= 81726 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 768 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 22 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, rang_vzroka_v_enoti;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.starost) AS unique_ages, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0) AS avg_positive_alkotest, SUM(o.starost) AS sum_age, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(o.starost)) AS age_percentile FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 29 AND o.starost BETWEEN 24 AND 81 AND n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 28 AND AVG(o.starost) > 34 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accident_rank;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, MAX((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1')) AS maksimalno_povzrociteljev_na_nesreco FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 38 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 592 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 4.57 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hujse_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS median_alkotesta, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.strokovni_pregled = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s_strokovnim_pregledom, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo_enote, SUM(ue.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina_enote FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.upravna_enota IN (91, 87, 23) AND o.starost BETWEEN 64 AND 22 AND o.alkotest BETWEEN 1.91 AND 0.21 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 184 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 4419 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom_ali_celado, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zenskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_tezkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_potnikov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'K' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_kolesarjev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_motornih_kolesarjev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_ostalih, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, (ue.st_prebivalcev::float / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS percent_rank_nesrece, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesrece_po_vzroku, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec, LEAD(SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta) AS naslednje_stevilo_smrti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost > 10 AND o.alkotest > 4.47 AND o.strokovni_pregled > 3.77 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 688616 AND ue.povrsina > 5346 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 100 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 773 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 10 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_let, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnimi_pasi, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_brez_poskodb, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_vzroku, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS globalni_rang_udelezencev, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY n.tip_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec, LEAD(AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca) AS naslednja_povprecna_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 111 AND o.alkotest >= 0.5 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 542082 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 910 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 24 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS enota1, ue2.ime_upravna_enota AS enota2, n1.vzrok_nesreca, n1.tip_nesreca, n1.vreme_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count_enota1, COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count_enota2, SUM(o1.alkotest) AS total_alkotest_enota1, SUM(o2.alkotest) AS total_alkotest_enota2, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_starost_enota1, AVG(o2.starost) AS avg_starost_enota2, COUNT(DISTINCT o1.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o1.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS povzrocitelji_count_enota1, COUNT(DISTINCT o2.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS povzrocitelji_count_enota2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesrece_enota1, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesrece_enota2 FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN nesreca n1 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n1.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota < ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON ue2.id_upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n1.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n2.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n1.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n2.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND ue1.st_prebivalcev > 664138 AND ue2.st_prebivalcev > 424695 AND n1.tip_nesreca = n2.tip_nesreca AND n1.vzrok_nesreca = n2.vzrok_nesreca AND o1.spol = o2.spol AND o1.vrsta_udelezenca = o2.vrsta_udelezenca GROUP BY ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue2.ime_upravna_enota, n1.vzrok_nesreca, n1.tip_nesreca, n1.vreme_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) > 45 ORDER BY nesrece_count_enota1 DESC, nesrece_count_enota2 DESC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS region_name, ue1.st_prebivalcev AS population, ue1.povrsina AS area, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_injured, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatalities, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_age_causers, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0) AS avg_positive_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / ue1.st_prebivalcev, 2) AS accidents_per_100k FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.vzrok_nesreca = n2.vzrok_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost >= 44 AND ue1.st_prebivalcev > 83673 GROUP BY ue1.id_upravna_enota, ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue1.st_prebivalcev, ue1.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 815 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 38 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS region_name, ue1.st_prebivalcev AS population, ue1.povrsina AS area, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_injured, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatalities, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_age_causers, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0) AS avg_positive_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / ue1.st_prebivalcev, 2) AS accidents_per_100k FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.vzrok_nesreca = n2.vzrok_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost >= 78 AND ue1.st_prebivalcev > 836012 GROUP BY ue1.id_upravna_enota, ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue1.st_prebivalcev, ue1.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 944 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 34 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC, total_accidents DESC;

WITH accident_stats AS ( SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS unique_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN n.klas_nesreca = '{{p1}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_class_accidents, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '{{p2}}') AS avg_age_responsible FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.alkotest >= 1.91 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 69 ), unit_stats AS ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, ue.st_prebivalcev::numeric / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) AS population_density, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY as2.avg_age_responsible) AS median_age_responsible FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN accident_stats as2 ON ue.id_upravna_enota = as2.upravna_enota WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 606280 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina ) SELECT us.id_upravna_enota, us.st_prebivalcev, us.povrsina, us.population_density, COALESCE(as1.total_accidents, 0) AS total_accidents, COALESCE(as1.unique_accidents, 0) AS unique_accidents, COALESCE(as1.specific_class_accidents, 0) AS specific_class_accidents, COALESCE(as1.avg_age_responsible, 0) AS avg_age_responsible, us.median_age_responsible, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(as1.total_accidents, 0) DESC) AS accident_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY us.population_density DESC) AS density_rank FROM unit_stats us LEFT JOIN accident_stats as1 ON us.id_upravna_enota = as1.upravna_enota WHERE us.population_density BETWEEN 7989.88 AND 4630.61 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, population_density DESC LIMIT 418;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 102760) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 43 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 357163) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 26 EXCEPT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE o.spol = 'M' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 946918) AND o.starost > 88 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 685 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, MAX(o.starost) AS najvecja_starost, MIN(o.starost) AS najmanjsa_starost, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 362905 AND ue.povrsina < 665) AND o.starost BETWEEN 20 AND 64 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 223 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 0.21 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, (u.st_prebivalcev * 1.0 / NULLIF(u.povrsina, 0)) AS population_density, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(u.st_prebivalcev, 0)) AS accidents_per_100k FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 325536) AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 56 AND 69 AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o2.alkotest > 0.22) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, u.st_prebivalcev, u.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 179 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('1', '2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 11 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrti_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS nesreca_rank, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(SUM(u.povrsina), 0) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost >= 71 AND o.alkotest >= 4.16 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 761 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 3.02 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrti_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS nesreca_rank, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(SUM(u.povrsina), 0) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 456697 AND n.y < 822795 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 6 AND o.strokovni_pregled >= 9.97 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 486 AND AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) < 2.3 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.71 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_pozitivnih_alkotestov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.strokovni_pregled > 4.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_pozitivnih_pregledov, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS
