SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hude_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 46 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 49 AND 32 AND o.alkotest >= 0.97 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 888766 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 76 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, smrtne_zrtve DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_meseci, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnimi_pasi, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zenskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.drzavljanstvo = 'SLO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_slovencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost > 31 AND o.alkotest > 2.82 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 482 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 2376 AND AVG(o.starost) < 48 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_let, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnimi_pasi, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_brez_poskodb, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_vzroku, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS globalni_rang_udelezencev, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY n.tip_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec, LEAD(AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca) AS naslednja_povprecna_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 41 AND o.alkotest >= 0.9 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 719532 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 566 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 3410 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_mesci, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(u.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS globalni_rang_udelezencev FROM nesreca n INNER JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca LEFT JOIN upravna_enota u ON o.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 881386 AND ue.povrsina BETWEEN 3717336 AND 2965316 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 611 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 4692 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT o.drzavljanstvo, ', ' ORDER BY o.drzavljanstvo) FILTER (WHERE o.drzavljanstvo IS NOT NULL) AS drzavljanstva_udelezencev, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT o.vrsta_udelezenca, ', ' ORDER BY o.vrsta_udelezenca) FILTER (WHERE o.vrsta_udelezenca IS NOT NULL) AS vrste_udelezencev, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS mediana_x_koordinate, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y) AS mediana_y_koordinate, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS prebivalci_na_nesreco, SUM(ue.povrsina) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS povrsina_na_nesreco FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 860167 AND n.y > 735683 AND o.starost >= 91 AND o.alkotest >= 1.33 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 444070 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 251 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 1998 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS enota1, ue2.ime_upravna_enota AS enota2, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n1.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) AS leto, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o1.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o1.starost) FILTER (WHERE o1.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o1.starost) FILTER (WHERE o1.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o1.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta, SUM(u1.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(u2.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina FROM nesreca n1 JOIN nesreca n2 ON n1.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n1.id_nesreca <> n2.id_nesreca JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca AND o1.spol = o2.spol JOIN upravna_enota ue1 ON n1.upravna_enota = ue1.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON n2.upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u1 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = u1.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON ue2.id_upravna_enota = u2.id_upravna_enota WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n1.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) BETWEEN 2014 AND 2020 AND n1.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n2.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o1.alkotest >= 1.17 AND o2.starost >= 60 GROUP BY ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue2.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n1.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 89 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o1.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 2 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupno_prebivalstvo ASC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS enota_naziv, ue1.st_prebivalcev AS prebivalci, ue1.povrsina AS povrsina_km2, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lazje_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS mediana_x_koordinate, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y) AS mediana_y_koordinate, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (ORDER BY ue1.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue1.povrsina, 0) DESC) AS nesrece_v_gostejsi_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota AND ue2.povrsina > 1377 JOIN nesreca n ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND (n.tip_nesreca = '1' OR n.vzrok_nesreca = '1') AND o.spol IN ('M', 'M') AND o.vozniski_staz_ll BETWEEN 3 AND 56 GROUP BY ue1.id_upravna_enota, ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue1.st_prebivalcev, ue1.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 708 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 42 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_starost_povzrocitelji FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN nesreca n1 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n1.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca AND o1.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n1.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND o1.starost BETWEEN 55 AND 39 GROUP BY ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue1.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 11 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

WITH accident_stats AS ( SELECT n.id_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, n.x_wgs84, n.y_wgs84, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_causers FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' GROUP BY n.id_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, n.x_wgs84, n.y_wgs84 ), unit_stats AS ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(a.persons_involved) AS total_persons, AVG(a.avg_age) AS avg_accident_age, SUM(a.num_causers) AS total_causers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(a.persons_involved)) AS persons_percentile FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN accident_stats a ON ue.id_upravna_enota = a.upravna_enota WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 38083 AND ue.povrsina BETWEEN 607 AND 1589 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.id_nesreca) >= 3 ) SELECT us.id_upravna_enota, us.ime_upravna_enota, us.st_prebivalcev, us.povrsina, us.total_accidents, us.total_persons, us.avg_accident_age, us.total_causers, us.accident_rank, us.persons_percentile, ROUND(us.total_accidents * 100000.0 / us.st_prebivalcev, 2) AS accidents_per_100k, ROUND(us.total_persons * 100.0 / us.total_accidents, 2) AS avg_persons_per_accident, LAG(us.total_accidents) OVER (PARTITION BY us.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY us.total_accidents) AS prev_accidents FROM unit_stats us ORDER BY us.accident_rank, us.persons_percentile DESC;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS quarter, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injury_count FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (41, 51, 32) AND o.starost >= 68 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 39 ORDER BY year, quarter, accident_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.starost) AS unique_ages, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 964448 AND o.starost >= 63 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.starost) > 18 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.starost) AS unique_ages, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.y < 577507 AND u.st_prebivalcev <= 116981 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.alkotest) < 0.28 ORDER BY upravna_enota;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, o.spol, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(u.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND n.upravna_enota IN (60, 42, 58) AND o.starost >= 89 AND o.alkotest >= 3.19 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 452185 GROUP BY CUBE (n.upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, o.spol, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 683 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 45 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, MAX(o.starost) AS najvecja_starost, MIN(o.starost) AS najmanjsa_starost, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 832604 AND ue.povrsina < 1908) AND o.starost BETWEEN 74 AND 90 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 383 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 0.59 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_test, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience_years, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_population_per_unit, SUM(u.povrsina) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_area_per_unit FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI') <= '2015-01-01' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 73 AND o.alkotest >= 1.45 AND u.st_prebivalcev >= 30800 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, year, month), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, year), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota), (n.upravna_enota), (n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven), (n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca), (n.tip_nesreca), (year, month), (year), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 46 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 84 ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, year, month, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah_v_enoti, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS globalni_rang_smrti FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota LEFT JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n2.x_wgs84 IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 0.08 WHERE n.x > 910017 AND n.y < 839812 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2016 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 49 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 31 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_zazdevek, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS prebivalci_na_enoto, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_tip_nesrece, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca) AS skupno_po_vzroku FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 24 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 776633 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 180 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 85 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, n.upravna_enota;

SELECT n1.upravna_enota, n1.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_starost_povzrocitelj, SUM(CASE WHEN n2.tip_nesreca = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tip1_count_in_area FROM nesreca n1 JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca AND o1.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' JOIN nesreca n2 ON n1.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n1.id_nesreca <> n2.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n1.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n1.x > 149004 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 7806759 GROUP BY n1.upravna_enota, n1.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 82 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT u2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota u2 WHERE u2.st_prebivalcev > 380730) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 56.45 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS oseba_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%' AND o.spol = 'M' GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 70 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS osebe_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.poskodba = '1' AND n.x_wgs84 > '0' GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 395 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 660606 AND o.starost >= 26 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 452 UNION SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 146109 AND o.starost <= 93 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING SUM(o.starost) < 90419 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.tip_nesreca, ', ' ORDER BY n.tip_nesreca) AS tipi_nesrec, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 491666 AND o.starost BETWEEN 7 AND 56 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 801 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_causers FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota BETWEEN 83 AND 70 AND o.starost >= 36 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 11442 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 48 AND AVG(o.starost) < 53 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND n.cas_nesreca <= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost > 67 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 1 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 746727 AND o.starost > 8 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > (SELECT AVG(starost) FROM oseba WHERE starost IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 690929 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.92 AND o2.vozniski_staz_ll > 2) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 43 AND AVG(o.starost) < 20 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC, avg_starost ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_poskodbe_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT n2.upravna_enota FROM nesreca n2 WHERE n2.x > 813767 AND n2.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 8255588 ) ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 303 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.09 LIMIT 1 ) AND n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 5 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 98 AND o.starost >= 38 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 939 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_people, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 55 AND o.starost >= 74 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 44 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_people, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_female_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS light_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uninjured, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS median_x_coordinate, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y) AS median_y_coordinate, (ue.st_prebivalcev * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS population_density FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 489710 ORDER BY ue2.st_prebivalcev DESC LIMIT 73 OFFSET 35) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.91 AND o2.starost BETWEEN 93 AND 78 LIMIT 6 OFFSET 4) AND n.x BETWEEN 176046 AND 679702 AND n.y BETWEEN 944495 AND 737609 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 416 AND AVG(o.starost) < 61 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, population_density ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN o.id_nesreca END) AS accidents_with_causers, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS median_alkotest, MAX(n.x_wgs84) - MIN(n.x_wgs84) AS longitude_range, MAX(n.y_wgs84) - MIN(n.y_wgs84) AS latitude_range FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND (n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' OR n.x_wgs84 IS NULL) AND (n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' OR n.y_wgs84 IS NULL) AND (o.starost >= 77 OR o.starost IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 435 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 64 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_involved ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN o.id_nesreca END) AS accidents_with_causers, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS median_alkotest, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(u.st_prebivalcev), 0), 2) AS accidents_per_100k FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca LEFT JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND (o.alkotest >= 0.21 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 46 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 27 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_persons, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS causer_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, MAX(o.alkotest) AS max_alcohol_level, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injury_count, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / ue.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_million_inhabitants, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (ORDER BY ue.id_upravna_enota) AS prev_unit_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.klas_nesreca = 'A' LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca AND o.starost >= 84 AND o.alkotest >= 2.15 WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 20400 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 579 AND AVG(o.starost) < 47 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_male_age ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 238072 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) - COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_participant_diff FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (62, 6, 61) AND o.starost >= 21 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 41 ORDER BY month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS accident_month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS drunk_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' AND o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS responsible_drivers, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))) AS prev_month_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '133 days') AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 86 AND 56 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 701519 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 99 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 39 ORDER BY accident_month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS mesec_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.poskodba, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec, o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(*) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_alkotesta, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(u.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti_in_letu, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(SUM(u.povrsina), 0) DESC) AS rang_gostote_prebivalstva FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND n.x BETWEEN 564557 AND 763400 AND n.y BETWEEN 616369 AND 192543 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 97 AND 12 AND o.alkotest BETWEEN 2.79 AND 2.39 AND o.strokovni_pregled BETWEEN 6.05 AND 3.5 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll BETWEEN 46 AND 17 AND o.vozniski_staz_mm BETWEEN 10 AND 9 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 346398 AND u.povrsina > 8733 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.poskodba, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec, o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 409 AND COUNT(*) > 4388 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupno_prebivalstvo DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS cetrtletje_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND y_wgs84 < '45.0' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 302) AND o.starost BETWEEN 51 AND 47 AND o.alkotest >= 2.01 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 106 AND AVG(o.starost) < 62 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, leto_nesreca, cetrtletje_nesreca;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN n.tip_nesreca = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS type_1_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN n.vzrok_nesreca IN ('1','2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS human_factor_accidents, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1') AS avg_age_causer, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 1.64) AS accidents_with_high_alcohol, SUM(CASE WHEN n.naselje_ali_izven = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS percent_urban, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 874) AND o.starost BETWEEN 19 AND 97 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 14 AND SUM(CASE WHEN n.tip_nesreca = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 13 ORDER BY year DESC, accident_rank;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN n.tip_nesreca = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS type_1_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN n.vzrok_nesreca IN ('1','2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS human_factor_accidents, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1') AS avg_age_causer, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 1.82) AS accidents_with_high_alcohol, SUM(CASE WHEN n.naselje_ali_izven = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS percent_urban, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 474) AND o.starost BETWEEN 25 AND 87 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 37 AND SUM(CASE WHEN n.tip_nesreca = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 10 ORDER BY year DESC, accident_rank;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS skupno_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lazje_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zensk, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nad_limitom_alkohola, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V') AS nesrece_z_voznikom, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 64 AND 96 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 631) AND (n.x BETWEEN 261643 AND 976879 OR n.y BETWEEN 121446 AND 791307) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 2 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 16 ORDER BY skupno_nesrec DESC, leto_nesreca ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS odstotek_zascitenih, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS globalni_rang_smrti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%glavna%' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN ('1', '1') AND o.starost BETWEEN 54 AND 20 AND o.alkotest > 0.16 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 423077 AND (n.vreme_nesreca = '1' OR n.stanje_promet = '1') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 80 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 483 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 13 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_povzrocitelj_age, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 88 AND o.starost BETWEEN 20 AND 37 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 9 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev) AS mediana_prebivalcev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND ( n.vzrok_nesreca IN (SELECT vzrok_nesreca FROM nesreca WHERE klas_nesreca = 'B' AND upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 4.77 AND o2.vozniski_staz_ll > 22) ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 89 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < (SELECT AVG(sub.smrti) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS smrti FROM oseba WHERE poskodba = 'S' GROUP BY id_nesreca) sub) ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(DISTINCT oseba.id_nesreca || oseba.spol) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN oseba.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN oseba.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN oseba.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahzje_poskodbe, AVG(oseba.starost) FILTER (WHERE oseba.poskodba IN ('1', '2', '3')) AS povprecna_starost_poskodovanih, AVG(oseba.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE oseba.alkotest > 0) AS povprecna_alkotest_vrednost, SUM(CASE WHEN oseba.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s_pasom_ali_celado, SUM(CASE WHEN oseba.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS brez_pasa_ali_celade, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY oseba.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_vozniskega_staza_leta, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_stevilu_nesrec, ROUND(ue.st_prebivalcev::numeric / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0), 2) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba ON n.id_nesreca = oseba.id_nesreca LEFT JOIN ( SELECT upravna_enota, AVG(x_wgs84) AS avg_x, AVG(y_wgs84) AS avg_y, COUNT(*) AS cnt_loc FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 IS NOT NULL AND y_wgs84 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY upravna_enota ) geo ON n.upravna_enota = geo.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 73 AND n.x > 246283 AND n.y > 930287 AND oseba.starost BETWEEN 12 AND 52 AND (oseba.alkotest > 4.93 OR oseba.alkotest IS NULL) AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, geo.avg_x, geo.avg_y, geo.cnt_loc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT oseba.id_nesreca || oseba.spol) > 3648 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_poskodovanih ASC LIMIT 288;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 76 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 45 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 432 AND o.starost BETWEEN 73 AND 79 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 98 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_vzroku FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 83 AND o.starost >= 41 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 45 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE o.starost > 62 AND n.upravna_enota >= 67 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 35 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 69 AND o.starost > 99 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota), () ) ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_vzroku_v_enoti FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 63 AND o.starost >= 33 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 31 ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS accident_count FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN nesreca n1 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n1.upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n1.x_wgs84 > '0' AND ue1.st_prebivalcev > 45605 GROUP BY ue1.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 30 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_starost_povzrocitelji FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN nesreca n1 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n1.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca AND o1.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n1.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND o1.starost BETWEEN 23 AND 51 GROUP BY ue1.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 26 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 90 AND o.starost > 34 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 50 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE u.st_prebivalcev < 67991 AND o.alkotest > 1.45 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING SUM(o.starost) < 55836 ORDER BY upravna_enota;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 474278 AND o.starost > 10 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 234 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.y < 203083 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 7431894 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING SUM(o.starost) < 60784;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_vozniski_staz FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 91 AND 76 AND o.alkotest > 4.7 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 777 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 3.33 EXCEPT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_vozniski_staz FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 36 AND 56 AND o.alkotest > 3.73 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 744 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 2.37 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 67 AND o.starost > 70 GROUP BY CUBE(n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 18 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 6 AND o.starost < 39 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 35 AND AVG(o.starost) < 36 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_oseba, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS povzrocitelj_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)::numeric / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0) * 100000, 2) AS accidents_per_100k, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 4.2 AND o2.starost BETWEEN 12 AND 93 ) AND n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 335974 ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 8452 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 83 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS monthly_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, AVG(ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS population_density, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_accidents_4months FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') <= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 818) AND o.starost >= 26 AND o.starost <= 26 AND (o.alkotest > 1.03 OR o.strokovni_pregled > 2.51) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 17 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 4 ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, monthly_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS mesec_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahkotne_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_alkotest_vrednost, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s_pasom_ali_celado, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS brez_pasu_ali_celade, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_tip_nesrece_po_enoti, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS prejsnji_mesec_iste_vrste FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 70 AND 35 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 9177) AND (n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' OR n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0') AND n.tip_nesreca IN (SELECT tip_nesreca FROM nesreca WHERE upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota GROUP BY tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 541) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 921 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) > 19 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, leto_nesreca DESC, mesec_nesreca DESC, stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnimi_pasi, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zenskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.drzavljanstvo != 'SLO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_tujcev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_tezkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_potnikov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'K' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_kolesarjev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_motornih_kolesarjev, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti, STDDEV(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE nesreca sub_n WHERE sub_n.vzrok_nesreca = n.vzrok_nesreca AND sub_n.tip_nesreca = n.tip_nesreca)) AS povprecna_gostota_prebivalstva_po_vzroku_in_tipu FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' AND o.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 70 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 258941 AND ue.povrsina > 1099 AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT sub_ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota sub_ue WHERE sub_ue.st_prebivalcev > (SELECT AVG(st_prebivalcev) FROM upravna_enota)) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_zazdevek, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u.st_prebivalcev) AS mediana_prebivalcev FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 802063 AND ue.povrsina < 1416) OR n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT n2.upravna_enota FROM nesreca n2 WHERE n2.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n2.klas_nesreca = '1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n2.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.06)) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 858 AND AVG(o.starost) < 37 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, MAX(o.alkotest) AS max_alcohol_level, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) DESC) AS prev_accident_count FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 627032 AND ue2.povrsina < 31743 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.14 AND o2.starost BETWEEN 28 AND 56 ) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 96 AND AVG(o.starost) < 57 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_male_age ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 1.21) AS accidents_with_high_alcohol, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience_years, (ue.st_prebivalcev::numeric / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS population_density FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca::date >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost >= 24 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 526 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, population_density;
