SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_causers, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_road_category FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND o.starost >= 85 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 290 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) > 2.56 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 132427 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 38 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 40 AND o.starost > 55 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 14 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injury_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 35 AND o.starost >= 19 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota), () ) ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrt FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 40 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 70 AND 40 AND n.tip_nesreca IN ('1', '1') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) >= 32 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 56 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_vzroku FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost >= 84 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 102 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_pijanih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_staz_ll, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesrece FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 40 AND 53 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 984 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 1523 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s_pasom_ali_celado, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_vzroku, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY n.tip_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 52 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca HAVING COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 3 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) < 0.27 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, MAX(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS maksimalni_vozniski_staz_leta, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec_z_udelezenci, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 2.29 AND o2.starost > 61) AS stevilo_oseb_z_visokim_alkotestom_in_starostjo FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 954145 AND ue2.povrsina < 35239) AND n.x_wgs84 IS NOT NULL AND n.y_wgs84 IS NOT NULL AND o.alkotest IS NOT NULL AND o.starost IS NOT NULL AND n.cas_nesreca IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 78 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 1.11 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti_udelezencev, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS percentil_75_vozniskega_staza, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecna_vrednost_alkotesta, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS percentil_90_alkotesta, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, (ue.st_prebivalcev::numeric / ue.povrsina) AS gostota_prebivalstva, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)::numeric / ue.st_prebivalcev) * 100000 AS nesrece_na_100k_prebivalcev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost >= 55 AND o.alkotest >= 2.73 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 996 AND AVG(o.starost) < 33 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, nesrece_na_100k_prebivalcev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_mesecih, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(ue.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_udelezcih_po_vzroku FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE ( (n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0') OR (n.x BETWEEN 417687 AND 437510 AND n.y BETWEEN 159414 AND 182961) ) AND n.cas_nesreca IS NOT NULL AND ( (o.starost >= 20 AND o.starost <= 24) OR (o.alkotest >= 0.5 AND o.alkotest <= 0.27) OR (o.strokovni_pregled >= 0.68 AND o.strokovni_pregled <= 0.9) ) AND NOT (o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'N' AND o.poskodba = 'S') AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 64163 AND ue.povrsina > 622 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 85 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 149 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_vzroku, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) DESC) AS rang_povprecne_starosti, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS percentil_stevila_udelezencev, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY n.tip_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec, LEAD(AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS naslednji_povprecni_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 560846 AND ue.povrsina <= 613 AND o.starost >= 85 AND o.alkotest >= 0.05 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 34 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 194 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) <= 62 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

WITH accident_stats AS ( SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '{{p1}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_injury_count FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota BETWEEN 82 AND 17 AND o.starost >= 56 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota ) SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, a.total_accidents, a.avg_age_involved, a.specific_injury_count, u.st_prebivalcev, (a.total_accidents * 100000.0 / u.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_100k FROM accident_stats a JOIN upravna_enota u ON a.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE a.total_accidents > 119 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT n.id_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, n.x, n.y, n.x_wgs84, n.y_wgs84, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.oznaka_odsek_ali_ulica, n.tekst_odsek_ali_ulica, n.stacionazna_ali_hisna_st, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.cas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, u.ime_upravna_enota, u.st_prebivalcev, u.povrsina, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS participant_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS causer_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.poskodba = 'S' AND o2.starost > 96) AS severe_injury_count FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (4, 15, 58) AND n.x > 725146 AND n.y > 910728 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY n.id_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, n.x, n.y, n.x_wgs84, n.y_wgs84, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.oznaka_odsek_ali_ulica, n.tekst_odsek_ali_ulica, n.stacionazna_ali_hisna_st, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.cas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, u.ime_upravna_enota, u.st_prebivalcev, u.povrsina HAVING COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 7 AND AVG(o.starost) < 59 ORDER BY participant_count DESC, avg_age ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 151424) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 993 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x > 555013) OR n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE y < 795441) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 266 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 84 AND o.starost >= 22 AND n.vzrok_nesreca IS NOT NULL AND n.tip_nesreca IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CUBE (n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 22 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '1') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '2') AS avg_female_age, MAX(o.alkotest) AS max_alcohol_level, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_participants, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota) AS population_in_unit, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.naselje_ali_izven) AS avg_accidents_by_settlement_type FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 80 AND o.alkotest >= 3.65 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, u.st_prebivalcev, n.naselje_ali_izven HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 264 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 8 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_male_age;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.alkotest) AS unique_alkotest_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_age, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS avg_license_years, MAX(n.x) AS max_x_coordinate, MIN(n.y) AS min_y_coordinate, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injury_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.alkotest) DESC) AS alkotest_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 663035 AND n.y < 88752 AND o.starost BETWEEN 65 AND 34 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.alkotest) > 38.62 AND SUM(o.starost) > 2579 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.strokovni_pregled) AS unique_pregled_count, SUM(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS total_months, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, MAX(n.x_wgs84) AS max_wgs84_x, MIN(n.y_wgs84) AS min_wgs84_y, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_gear_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.strokovni_pregled) DESC) AS pregled_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND o.alkotest > 2.04 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 28 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.strokovni_pregled) < 93.25 AND AVG(o.starost) < 47 ORDER BY upravna_enota;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_test, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_population_per_unit, SUM(u.povrsina) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_area_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_year FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.vzrok_nesreca = n2.vzrok_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca AND o.spol = o2.spol WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND o.starost BETWEEN 7 AND 63 AND o.alkotest >= 0.25 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 605503 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota), (n.upravna_enota), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 810 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 18 ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) >= 2022 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 826 AND AVG(o.starost) < 23 UNION SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 576901 AND n.y < 491153 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) <= 2005 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) BETWEEN 346 AND 624 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 39 ORDER BY accident_rank, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 1.66) AS accidents_with_alcohol, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS population, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / MAX(u.st_prebivalcev)) AS accidents_per_100k FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 586778) AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca IS NOT NULL AND o.starost BETWEEN 41 AND 92 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 390 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 25 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost > 37 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 891 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 175140 AND o.starost > 86 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 453 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS accident_month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 1.85 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 15 ORDER BY accident_month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 0.65 AND o2.starost BETWEEN 30 AND 51 ) AND n.x BETWEEN 411848 AND 512871 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 23 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT (n.x, n.y)) AS distinct_locations, COUNT(DISTINCT (n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje)) AS distinct_roads, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_perpetrators, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population, (SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(u.povrsina), 0)) AS population_density FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '45.0' AND o.starost > 29 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 886191 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 851 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 267 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC, population_density ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS osebe_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND (n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nesreca n2 WHERE n2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND n2.x > 617048)) AND o.starost >= 12 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 440 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.tip_nesreca, ', ' ORDER BY n.tip_nesreca) AS tipi_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost > 77 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 792 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_female_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' AND o.starost >= 17 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 599 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN o.id_nesreca END) AS accidents_with_causers, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS median_accident_x, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y) AS median_accident_y, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) - COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca)) AS accidents_without_persons_data, MAX(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(MAX(ue.povrsina), 0) AS population_density FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota AND n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca AND o.alkotest > 1.97 AND o.starost BETWEEN 25 AND 82 WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 484506 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 90 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 38 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, population_density ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND o2.alkotest > 2.21 AND o2.starost BETWEEN 83 AND 74 ORDER BY o2.alkotest DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 33 ) AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 973584 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 611 AND AVG(o.starost) < 49 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, fatal_injuries ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS cetrtletje, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hude_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahke_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS mediana_alkotesta, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS nesrece_povzrocitelji, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca IN ('1', '1') AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 462423 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 710 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 50 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, leto, cetrtletje;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol || '|' || o.drzavljanstvo) AS distinct_gender_nationality_combos, COUNT(DISTINCT n.vzrok_nesreca) AS distinct_causes, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, MAX(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS max_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2023 AND 2012 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 762101 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 400 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol || '|' || o.drzavljanstvo) >= 5 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol || '|' || o.drzavljanstvo) AS distinct_gender_citizenship_combos, COUNT(DISTINCT o.vrsta_udelezenca) AS distinct_participant_types, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_population_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_road_type FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.alkotest > 0.35 AND o.starost BETWEEN 86 AND 36 AND n.vreme_nesreca = '1' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 834 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.vrsta_udelezenca) >= 3 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC, avg_age_involved ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.poskodba, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec, o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(o.alkotest) AS skupni_alkotest, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(o.strokovni_pregled) AS skupni_strokovni_pregled, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_staz_ll, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_staz_mm, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(ue.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_cesti_vzroku, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(o.alkotest) DESC) AS rang_povprecnega_alkotesta, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota) AS kumulativne_nesrece_v_enoti, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY AVG(o.starost)) AS prejsnje_nesrece_po_starosti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%' AND n.tekst_odsek_ali_ulica LIKE '%' AND o.starost >= 38 AND o.alkotest >= 2.89 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 926297 AND ue.povrsina >= 7698 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.poskodba, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec, o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 24 AND AVG(o.alkotest) > 2.7 AND SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) > 94721 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, o.spol, o.vrsta_udelezenca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '14.0' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 300) AND o.starost >= 50 AND (o.alkotest > 1.83 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, o.spol, o.vrsta_udelezenca, year), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, year), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, year), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, year), (n.kategorija_cesta, year), (year), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 8 ORDER BY year DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.naselje_ali_izven ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS rang_smrti_v_naselju FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost >= 56 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 389666 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 903 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, o.spol, o.vrsta_udelezenca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id_upravna_enota) AS povprecno_prebivalstvo_na_enoto, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_tipu FROM nesreca n INNER JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca LEFT JOIN upravna_enota u ON o.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND (o.alkotest > 0.98 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 160295 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, o.spol, o.vrsta_udelezenca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 30 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 39 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_vozniski_staz FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 51 AND 76 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 342287 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 9 AND AVG(o.starost) > 57 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 7 AND o.starost > 42 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 45 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'S') AS stevilo_smrti, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) AS gostota_prebivalstva, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_tipu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec_po_vzroku FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.vzrok_nesreca = n2.vzrok_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 29 AND o.alkotest >= 2.65 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 94 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 1.08 AND SUM(o.starost) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 79 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_experience FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE DATE_PART('year', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2023 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND o.starost >= 79 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 41 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.poskodba = 'B' AND n.klas_nesreca = 'A' AND o.starost >= 60 AND o.alkotest > 0.86 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 10 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 4 AND o.starost >= 30 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca), (ue.ime_upravna_enota), () ) ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS prebivalci_na_nesreco, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 51 AND o.starost BETWEEN 19 AND 57 AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN ('1', '1') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 49 AND AVG(o.starost) < 58 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_moski;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_alkotesta, MAX(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS prebivalci_enote, MAX(ue.povrsina) AS povrsina_enote, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_udelezcih, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS zap_st_v_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 514459 ORDER BY ue2.povrsina DESC LIMIT 91 OFFSET 18) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.38 LIMIT 1) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 54 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS accident_month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '2 months' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3month_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost >= 32 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 47 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, accident_month;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, (SELECT MAX(ue2.st_prebivalcev) FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.povrsina > ue.povrsina) AS max_prebivalci_vecje_povrsine FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 79 AND 88 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 162 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 0.57 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_mesecih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnimi_pasi, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zenskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_tezkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_potnikov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'K' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_kolesarjev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_motoristov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_ostalih, (ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS percent_rank_nesrece, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY AVG(o.alkotest) DESC) AS row_num_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '45.0' AND o.starost >= 69 AND o.alkotest >= 1.08 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 538606 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 78 AND AVG(o.alkotest) > 1.19 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezke_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahke_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(ue.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(SUM(ue.povrsina), 0) AS gostota_prebivalstva FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 576466 AND n.y > 773858 AND n.x_wgs84 > '0.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0.0' AND o.starost > 2 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll > 73 AND o.alkotest > 4.48 AND o.strokovni_pregled > 3.37 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 178616 AND ue.povrsina > 8297 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 989 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 4047 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 478 AND AVG(o.starost) > 57 AND AVG(o.alkotest) > 0.54 AND SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(SUM(ue.povrsina), 0) > 362.09 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC, smrtne_zrtve DESC;

SELECT n.id_nesreca, COUNT(o.starost) AS participant_count FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota = 68 AND o.starost >= 45 GROUP BY n.id_nesreca HAVING COUNT(o.starost) > 7 INTERSECT SELECT n.id_nesreca, COUNT(o.starost) AS participant_count FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota = 71 AND o.starost <= 48 GROUP BY n.id_nesreca HAVING COUNT(o.starost) < 7 ORDER BY participant_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost > 75 AND alkotest > 0.86) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 650 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 944819 ORDER BY ue.povrsina DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 44 ) AND o.starost > 92 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 0.53 LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 29 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 936815 AND o.starost > 39 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 913 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.y < 565863 AND o.alkotest > 4.96 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) < 796 ORDER BY upravna_enota;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_s_povzrocitelji FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota EXCEPT SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota, 0 FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev < 683375;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, MAX(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS max_vozniski_staz, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesrece FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 343069 AND ue.povrsina < 214085) AND o.starost BETWEEN 19 AND 68 AND n.x_wgs84 IS NOT NULL AND n.y_wgs84 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 315 AND AVG(o.alkotest) >= 1.5 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC, total_starost ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, MAX(o.alkotest) AS max_alcohol_level, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 95848 AND ue2.povrsina < 37286 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.12 AND o2.starost BETWEEN 19 AND 74 ) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 68 AND AVG(o.starost) < 25 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo_enote, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah_v_enoti, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS skupno_nesrece_po_vzroku FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost >= 108 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 5921781 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 363 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 52 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, n.upravna_enota;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 193160 AND ue.povrsina < 3059) AND o.starost > 48 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 31 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT u2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota u2 WHERE u2.st_prebivalcev > 301257) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 76.63 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS oseba_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE u.st_prebivalcev > 624697 AND (o.alkotest > 0.52 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 325 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 827389 AND o.starost > 73 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) as nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) as avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 63 AND o.starost BETWEEN 23 AND 35 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 31 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 54 AND o.starost >= 87 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.starost > 78 LIMIT 1 ) AND n.x > 144281 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 275 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS oseba_count FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 29 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 131777 AND n.y > 399978 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 540 EXCEPT SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE o.alkotest > 4.61 AND o.starost > 31 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 192 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS osebe_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND (n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nesreca n2 WHERE n2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND n2.x > 763910)) AND o.starost >= 120 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 18 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost >= 49 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota UNION ALL SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost <= 36 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN o.id_nesreca END) AS accidents_with_causers, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatalities, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS median_pop_density, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 2.46) AS high_alcohol_cases FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca AND o.vrsta_udelezenca IN ('V', 'V') WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 27373 AND (n.cas_nesreca IS NULL OR n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00') GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 185 AND AVG(o.starost) < 86 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, median_pop_density ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (60, 182, 242) AND (n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' OR n.vzrok_nesreca = '2') AND n.tip_nesreca NOT IN ('1', '2') AND o.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 81 AND (o.alkotest > 0.25 OR o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 50 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 1.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' AND o.vozniski_staz_ll > 25) AS experienced_drivers_accidents, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_year FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca IN (SELECT UNNEST(STRING_TO_ARRAY('1', ','))) AND ue.povrsina > 4721 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND o2.starost BETWEEN 19 AND 87 ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 334 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, accident_rank_year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, SUM(u.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina_upravnih_enot, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.39) AS stevilo_visjih_alkotestov FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON o.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY')) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2018 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.id_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 6 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 38 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, smrtne_zrtve DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_causers, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_road_category FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND o.starost >= 81 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 447 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) > 2.18 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS accident_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.upravna_enota ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_accidents FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 78 AND o.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 29 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 28609 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 7 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_tipu FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 37 AND o.starost >= 47 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 30 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 52 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND o.starost >= 28 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 3 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_participants, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_perpetrator_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) AS percentile_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 843 AND o.starost >= 87 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 62 AND AVG(o.starost) > 53 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accident_rank;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 96 AND o.starost BETWEEN 25 AND 31 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 451196 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 14 AND AVG(o.starost) < 53 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC, avg_starost ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS accident_year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alkotest FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) >= 2023 AND n.upravna_enota IN (14) AND o.starost >= 18 GROUP BY CUBE (ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, accident_year) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 45 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom_ali_celado, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zenskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_tezkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_potnikov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'K' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_kolesarjev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_motornih_kolesarjev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_ostalih, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, (ue.st_prebivalcev::float / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS percent_rank_nesrece, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesrece_po_vzroku, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec, LEAD(SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta) AS naslednje_stevilo_smrti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost > 70 AND o.alkotest > 1.59 AND o.strokovni_pregled > 4.65 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 215637 AND ue.povrsina > 5169 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 48 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 754 AND SUM(CASE WHEN
