o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 24 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodb, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_alkotest, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_sopotnikov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_pescev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zenskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_alkotesta, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_stevilu_nesrec, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS rang_po_stevilu_smrti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '45.0' AND o.starost >= 22 AND o.alkotest >= 1.32 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 14 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 11 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_smrti DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D') AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS stevilo_moskih, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS stevilo_zenskih, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.drzavljanstvo != 'SLO') AS stevilo_tujcev, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'S' OR o.poskodba = 'H') AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodb, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V') AS stevilo_voznikov, (ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS mediana_x, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y) AS mediana_y, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x_wgs84) AS mediana_x_wgs84, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y_wgs84) AS mediana_y_wgs84 FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 409872 AND n.y > 379815 AND n.x_wgs84 > '0.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0.0' AND o.alkotest > 1.07 AND o.starost > 66 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll > 29 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 601243 AND ue.povrsina > 841 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 554 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 132 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS parent_region, ue2.ime_upravna_enota AS child_region, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue1.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_in_parent FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n ON ue2.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 31 AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' GROUP BY ue1.id_upravna_enota, ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue2.id_upravna_enota, ue2.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 68 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 16 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, parent_region, child_region;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS parent_unit, ue2.ime_upravna_enota AS child_unit, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alcohol_level, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue1.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n ON ue2.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 73 GROUP BY ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue1.id_upravna_enota, ue2.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 343 AND AVG(o.alkotest) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, parent_unit, child_unit;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 987250 ) OR n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue3.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue3 WHERE ue3.povrsina < 836 ) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 57 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 372201) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 75.74 EXCEPT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.povrsina < 3403) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) < 53 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, MAX(o.starost) AS najvisja_starost, MIN(o.starost) AS najnizja_starost, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 991754 AND ue.povrsina < 614757) AND o.starost > 69 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 296 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 0.3 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 2.63) AS accidents_with_alcohol, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS population, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(MAX(u.st_prebivalcev), 0)) AS accidents_per_100k FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IS NOT NULL AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost >= 79 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 905 AND (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(MAX(u.st_prebivalcev), 0)) > '50.0' ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS max_prebivalci, MIN(u.povrsina) AS min_povrsina FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 535509 AND n.y < 906401 AND o.starost >= 50 AND o.alkotest <= 2.37 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 85914 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 637 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 0.88 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS max_prebivalci, MIN(u.povrsina) AS min_povrsina FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 47 AND o.vozniski_staz_mm <= 99 AND u.povrsina < 934663 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING SUM(o.starost) > 26600 AND MIN(u.povrsina) < 359088 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC, total_starost ASC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injury_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injury_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_test, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience_years FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 77 AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND o.starost BETWEEN 34 AND 76 AND o.alkotest >= 0.89 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, year), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, year), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, year), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, year), (n.upravna_enota, year), (year), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 66 ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, year, accident_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS caused_by_driver, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS participant_only, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 1.59) AS accidents_with_high_alcohol, MAX(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS population, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / MAX(ue.st_prebivalcev)) AS accidents_per_100k, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (ORDER BY ue.id_upravna_enota) AS prev_admin_unit_accidents FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 21 AND 82 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 4044) AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN (SELECT vzrok_nesreca FROM nesreca WHERE upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota GROUP BY vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 71) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.poskodba = 'S') AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' AND ue.povrsina > 1215 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 451 AND AVG(o.starost) < 76 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.02 AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' ) AND n.upravna_enota > 12 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 41 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS osebe_count, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) - COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca)) AS nesrece_brez_oseb FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 272 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) < 426 ORDER BY nesrece_brez_oseb DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost > 9 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 192 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IS NULL AND u.st_prebivalcev > 17071 AND u.povrsina < 6749 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo FROM upravna_enota u INNER JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND u.povrsina > 7466 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 31 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, o.spol, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE o.starost > 22 AND n.upravna_enota > 79 GROUP BY CUBE (u.ime_upravna_enota, o.spol, n.vzrok_nesreca) HAVING COUNT(*) > 977 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 663470 ) AND o.starost >= 100 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 47 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS accidents_with_causers, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatalities, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS median_x, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y) AS median_y, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (ORDER BY ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) DESC) AS prev_accident_count FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2020-01-01' AND (o.alkotest >= 0.32 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 21 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age_male DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 32 AND o.starost BETWEEN 26 AND 54 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 42 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, (SELECT MAX(st_prebivalcev) FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.povrsina > 4685) AS max_prebivalci_na_gostem_obmocju, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_cesti FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota ue_pop ON ue_pop.id_upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 92 AND 56 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.tip_nesreca, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 490 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 4.98 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id_upravna_enota) AS avg_population_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_road_type FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota ue ON o.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND o.starost BETWEEN 35 AND 67 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 776 AND AVG(o.alkotest) > 0.06 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS udelezenci_na_100k_preb, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.starost >= 20 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 78 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 210 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) > 0.44 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, udelezenci_na_100k_preb DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, o.spol, o.vrsta_udelezenca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_alkotest, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id_upravna_enota) AS povprecno_prebivalstvo_na_enoto, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%glavna%' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '08:00' AND o.starost BETWEEN 24 AND 60 AND n.x BETWEEN 461152 AND 471859 AND n.y BETWEEN 107765 AND 118972 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 43213 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, o.spol, o.vrsta_udelezenca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 6 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 14 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 3 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE (n.vreme_nesreca = '1' OR n.stanje_vozisce = '1') AND NOT (n.naselje_ali_izven = '1') AND (o.alkotest > 1.64 OR o.vozniski_staz_ll < 1) AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 237098 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 14 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') < 91 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_moski ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_tipu FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND o.starost >= 8 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 848 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 67 AND 52 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 76120 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 36 AND AVG(o.starost) < 25 ORDER BY serious_injuries DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_poskodovanih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_poskodovanih, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS prebivalci_enote, MAX(u.povrsina) AS povrsina_enote, (MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) * 1.0 / NULLIF(MAX(u.povrsina), 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_tipu, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 25 AND o.alkotest >= 3.88 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 488005 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 933 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 489 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_age_female, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 94 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 494 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 49 AND o.starost >= 77 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 14 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND n.cas_nesreca <= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost > 57 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 30 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS osebe_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_starost_m, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_starost_z, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrti_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesrece, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca)) AS percentil_osebe FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 80 AND o.starost BETWEEN 25 AND 72 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 427047 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 34 AND AVG(o.starost) < 42 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC, osebe_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS st_nesrec, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS st_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS st_smrti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota BETWEEN 87 AND 74 AND o.starost >= 69 AND n.x BETWEEN 14468 AND 100993 AND n.y BETWEEN 40026 AND 181125 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2022 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 41 AND AVG(o.starost) > 30 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3 ORDER BY st_nesrec DESC, st_smrti DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_driver_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 65 AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 44212 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 16 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') > 51 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accident_rank;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_perpetrator_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca)) AS person_percentile FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 70 AND n.x BETWEEN 24422 AND 74004 AND o.starost >= 59 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 63831 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 42 AND AVG(o.starost) < 43 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accident_rank;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.starost) AS unique_ages, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_perpetrator_age, SUM(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 2.21) AS high_alcohol_cases, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER ( PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_accidents, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC ) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota BETWEEN 13 AND 139 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= 2015 AND o.starost >= 30 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 2 AND AVG(o.starost) > 28 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, moving_avg_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(u2.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON o.upravna_enota = u2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) = 2018 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 82 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 3.8 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(u2.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u2 ON o.upravna_enota = u2.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 37468 AND n.y < 54860 AND o.starost BETWEEN 84 AND 29 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 83 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 13 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 0 AND o.starost BETWEEN 31 AND 31 AND n.vzrok_nesreca = 'A' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 806 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_test, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience_years, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_population_per_unit, SUM(u.povrsina) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_area_per_unit FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI') <= '2015-01-01' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 39 AND o.alkotest >= 0.77 AND u.st_prebivalcev >= 203991 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, year, month), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, year), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca), (n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota), (n.upravna_enota), (n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven), (n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca), (n.tip_nesreca), (year, month), (year), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 82 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 171 ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, year, month, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS prebivalci_na_enoto, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_v_enoti, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS prejsnje_nesrece_po_vzroku FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.vzrok_nesreca = n2.vzrok_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 362011 AND n.y > 314602 AND o.alkotest > 2.63 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 64559 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 13 AND AVG(o.starost) < 94 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '1') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '2') AS povprecna_starost_zensk FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vreme_nesreca = '1' AND o.starost >= 47 AND o.alkotest > 0.48 AND n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 978858 ) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 44 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0.5) AS accidents_with_high_alcohol, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience_years, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / ue.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_100k_inhabitants FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 535) AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.vreme_nesreca IN ('1', '1') AND n.stanje_promet = '1' AND o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' AND o.starost BETWEEN 28 AND 87 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.26 AND o2.poskodba IN ('1', '2')) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 295 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 7 AND (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / ue.st_prebivalcev) > '10.0' ORDER BY accidents_per_100k_inhabitants DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatalities, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0.69) AS accidents_with_alcohol, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience_years, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(u.st_prebivalcev), 0)) AS accidents_per_100k FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost >= 27 AND starost <= 82 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 1705) AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2016 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 825 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 21 ORDER BY accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT DISTINCT o.upravna_enota FROM oseba o WHERE o.starost BETWEEN 70 AND 55 ) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 11 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '100000' AND n.y_wgs84 < '100000' GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota UNION ALL SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS oseba_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN oseba o ON u.id_upravna_enota = o.upravna_enota WHERE o.starost > 62 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll > 45 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS povzrocitelj_count FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 491 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 643575 AND o.starost > 60 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.17 AND o2.starost BETWEEN 26 AND 44 ) AND n.x BETWEEN 481033 AND 560854 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 11 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.13 ORDER BY o2.alkotest DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 18 ) AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 265 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' AND o2.starost > (SELECT AVG(starost) FROM oseba WHERE upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND starost IS NOT NULL) ) AS count_above_avg_age_causers FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 87 AND o.starost BETWEEN 26 AND 34 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 39 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 582587 ) AND o.starost >= 25 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 5 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT n2.upravna_enota FROM nesreca n2 WHERE n2.x > 741408 AND n2.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 5265267 ) ) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 562 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS accidents_with_culprits, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatalities, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) - COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca)) AS accidents_without_persons, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0) * 100000, 2) AS accidents_per_100k FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota AND n.x_wgs84 IS NOT NULL AND n.y_wgs84 IS NOT NULL AND n.tip_nesreca IN ('1', '2', '3') LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca AND o.starost BETWEEN 48 AND 52 AND o.alkotest >= 1.17 WHERE ue.povrsina > 229 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 21557 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 156 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) < 1.15 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN n.vzrok_nesreca = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accidents_cause_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_age_causer, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'A' AND o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS injuries_no_safety_gear FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 958 AND n.upravna_enota <= 6 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 21 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_in_unit FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost > 28 AND alkotest > 1.05 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 407) AND n.tip_nesreca IN (SELECT tip_nesreca FROM nesreca WHERE upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota GROUP BY tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 324) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 916 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('1', '2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 553 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year DESC, month DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 478492 AND o.starost BETWEEN 24 AND 26 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, year, quarter HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 27 ORDER BY year DESC, quarter DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol || '|' || o.drzavljanstvo) AS distinct_gender_citizenship_combos, COUNT(DISTINCT o.vrsta_udelezenca) AS distinct_participant_types, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS avg_population_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_road_type FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.alkotest > 1.77 AND o.starost BETWEEN 119 AND 97 AND n.vreme_nesreca = '1' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 397 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.vrsta_udelezenca) >= 4 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC, avg_age_involved ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS zap_st_udelezencev_po_kategoriji FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 4 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 505 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) < 4.13 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecni_alkotest ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_causers, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_fatal_injuries, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alcohol_test, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS avg_driving_experience_years, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_count_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS fatal_injury_row_num FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.alkotest >= 0.16 AND o.starost BETWEEN 81 AND 56 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 593897 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 84 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 26 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, fatal_injury_row_num;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS enota1, ue2.ime_upravna_enota AS enota2, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_v_enoti1, COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_v_enoti2, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev_enota1, AVG(o2.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev_enota2 FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota < ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n1 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n1.upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON ue2.id_upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n1.upravna_enota > 86 AND n2.upravna_enota > 2 AND o1.starost >= 95 AND o2.starost >= 74 GROUP BY ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue2.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) > 40 ORDER BY nesrece_v_enoti1 DESC, nesrece_v_enoti2 DESC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS enota1, ue2.ime_upravna_enota AS enota2, n1.vzrok_nesreca, n1.tip_nesreca, n1.vreme_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count_enota1, COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count_enota2, SUM(o1.alkotest) AS total_alkotest_enota1, SUM(o2.alkotest) AS total_alkotest_enota2, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_starost_enota1, AVG(o2.starost) AS avg_starost_enota2, COUNT(DISTINCT o1.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o1.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS povzrocitelji_count_enota1, COUNT(DISTINCT o2.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS povzrocitelji_count_enota2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesrece_enota1, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rank_nesrece_enota2 FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN nesreca n1 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n1.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota < ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON ue2.id_upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n1.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n2.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n1.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n2.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND ue1.st_prebivalcev > 548476 AND ue2.st_prebivalcev > 329492 AND n1.tip_nesreca = n2.tip_nesreca AND n1.vzrok_nesreca = n2.vzrok_nesreca AND o1.spol = o2.spol AND o1.vrsta_udelezenca = o2.vrsta_udelezenca GROUP BY ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue2.ime_upravna_enota, n1.vzrok_nesreca, n1.tip_nesreca, n1.vreme_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) > 14 ORDER BY nesrece_count_enota1 DESC, nesrece_count_enota2 DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezenca FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 818064) AND o.starost > 41 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo_enote, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah_v_enoti, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS skupno_nesrece_po_vzroku FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0' AND o.starost >= 114 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 4381208 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 230 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 70 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, n.upravna_enota;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 263910 AND o.starost > 91 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 178 UNION SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 375633 AND o.starost < 42 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) < 43 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prekoračitve_alkotesta, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(u.povrsina, 0)) AS mediana_gostote_prebivalstva FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 85 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 418 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') < 29 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT (n.id_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca)) AS distinct_accident_type_combinations, COUNT(DISTINCT (o.id_nesreca, o.spol, o.poskodba)) AS distinct_person_injury_combinations, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population, AVG(ue.povrsina) AS avg_area, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_causers, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_high_alcohol, SUM(CASE WHEN o.starost > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_older_than, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS median_age, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 804166 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 698 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) >= 489 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC, total_population ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 246014 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.5) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 375 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 2.75) AS high_alcohol_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS median_x_coordinate, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2020-01-01' AND o.vozniski_staz_ll >= 31 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 599 AND AVG(o.starost) < 76 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS cetrtletje_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.klas_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_alkotest, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS prebivalci_na_nesreco, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_tip_nesrece_po_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2018 AND 2012 AND n.tip_nesreca IN ('A', 'A', 'A') AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 64541 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.klas_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 3 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 31 ORDER BY leto_nesreca DESC, cetrtletje_nesreca DESC, stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, SUM(o.alkotest) / NULLIF(COUNT(o.alkotest), 0) AS avg_blood_alcohol, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_equipment_used, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS total_population, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 251116) AND o.starost BETWEEN 24 AND 71 AND o.alkotest >= 0.69 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 5 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3 ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS person_count, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_female_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, ROUND(ue.st_prebivalcev::numeric / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0), 2) AS population_density, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_year FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 110855) AND o.starost >= 64 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 25 ORDER BY year DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba IN ('2', '3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hujse_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezenca, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS median_alkotest, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_v_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE 'A%' AND n.vzrok_nesreca LIKE '1' AND n.tip_nesreca LIKE '1' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' AND o.starost BETWEEN 96 AND 43 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 206793 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 85 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 48 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezenca ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND o.starost >= 80 AND ue.povrsina < 6792 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 36 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm/12.0) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_z_varnostnim_pasom, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_hujsih_telesnih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_lahkih_telesnih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_brez_telesnih_poskodb, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_zenskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.drzavljanstvo = 'SLO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_slovencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_voznikov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_sopotnikov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_pescev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'K' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_kolesarjev, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, (ue.st_prebivalcev::float / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS percentil_nesrec, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_vzrok_v_enoti, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) - LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca)) AS sprememba_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '45.0' AND o.starost > 46 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 580870 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 61 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 186 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, COUNT(*) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.alkotest) AS skupni_alkotest, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, SUM(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS skupni_staz_leta, SUM(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS skupni_staz_meseci, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'S') AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca) AS skupno_po_vzroku_in_enoti, LAG(COUNT(*), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 6551 AND n.y > 775273 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 286092 AND ue.povrsina > 764656 AND o.starost > 58 AND o.alkotest > 4.34 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca HAVING COUNT(*) > 639 AND AVG(o.starost) < 45 AND SUM(o.alkotest) > 47.71 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupni_alkotest DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 348747) AND o.starost > 65 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 826 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, MAX(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS max_vozniski_staz, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS nesreca_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 588987 AND n.y > 433691 AND o.starost BETWEEN 100 AND 59 AND o.alkotest > 4.29 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 521 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 1.49 INTERSECT SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, MAX(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS max_vozniski_staz, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS nesreca_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 < '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost BETWEEN 44 AND 23 AND o.alkotest <= 4.49 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 3 AND AVG(o.alkotest) > 4.18 ORDER BY nesreca_rank;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS caused_by_driver, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS max_population, SUM(u.povrsina) AS total_area, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'S' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V') AS severe_injury_drivers FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '14.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.alkotest > 2.0 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 12 AND AVG(o.starost) < 51 UNION SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS caused_by_driver, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS max_population, SUM(u.povrsina) AS total_area, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'S' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V') AS severe_injury_drivers FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 < '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '46.0' AND o.alkotest < 0.86 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 63 AND AVG(o.starost) > 57 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_staz_mesci, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_visokih_alkotestov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.strokovni_pregled > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_strokovnih_pregledov, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_staza_let FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 228550 AND n.y > 413468 AND n.x_wgs84 > '0.0' AND n.y_wgs84 > '0.0' AND o.starost > 110 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll > 4 AND o.alkotest > 2.14 AND o.strokovni_pregled > 2.66 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 920625 AND u.povrsina > 1642 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_staz_mesci, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_visokih_alkotestov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.strokovni_pregled > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_strokovnih_pregledov, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS mediana_starosti, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_staza_let FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x < 425173 AND n.y < 360995 AND n.x_wgs84 < '0.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0.0' AND o.starost < 54 AND o.vozniski_staz_ll < 59 AND o.alkotest < 4.8 AND o.strokovni_pregled < 6.35 AND u.st_prebivalcev < 69530 AND u.povrsina < 6074 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota,
