COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 613 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) >= 2551 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 473 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) BETWEEN 28 AND 34 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) <= 2.25 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 415 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN o.spol = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 232 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 1504 AND (MAX(ue.st_prebivalcev) * 1.0 / NULLIF(MIN(ue.povrsina), 0)) > '0.0' ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

WITH accident_stats AS ( SELECT n.id_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, n.x_wgs84, n.y_wgs84, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_causers FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.5' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.5' GROUP BY n.id_nesreca, n.upravna_enota, n.x_wgs84, n.y_wgs84 ), unit_stats AS ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(a.persons_involved) AS total_persons, AVG(a.avg_age) AS avg_accident_age, SUM(a.num_causers) AS total_causers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(a.persons_involved)) AS persons_percentile FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN accident_stats a ON ue.id_upravna_enota = a.upravna_enota WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 4225 AND ue.povrsina BETWEEN 755 AND 458 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.id_nesreca) >= 13 ) SELECT us.id_upravna_enota, us.ime_upravna_enota, us.st_prebivalcev, us.povrsina, us.total_accidents, us.total_persons, us.avg_accident_age, us.total_causers, us.accident_rank, us.persons_percentile, ROUND(us.total_accidents * 100000.0 / us.st_prebivalcev, 2) AS accidents_per_100k, ROUND(us.total_persons * 100.0 / us.total_accidents, 2) AS avg_persons_per_accident, LAG(us.total_accidents) OVER (PARTITION BY us.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY us.total_accidents) AS prev_accidents FROM unit_stats us ORDER BY us.accident_rank, us.persons_percentile DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, MAX(o.starost) AS najvecja_starost, MIN(o.starost) AS najmanjsa_starost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'S' AND o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'N') AS smrti_brez_varnostnega_pasu FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 77 AND o.alkotest >= 2.15 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > (SELECT AVG(st_prebivalcev) / 1000 FROM upravna_enota WHERE povrsina > 39365) AND SUM(o.starost) > 83471 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 520833 AND o.starost > 59 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > (SELECT AVG(st_prebivalcev) FROM upravna_enota WHERE povrsina > 105599) ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtv FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (86, 65, 84) AND (n.tip_nesreca = '1' OR n.tip_nesreca = '2') AND n.vreme_nesreca NOT IN ('1', '2') AND o.starost >= 98 AND (o.alkotest > 1.09 OR o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 53 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS stevilo_nesrec FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '14000000' AND n.y_wgs84 < '4500000' GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota UNION ALL SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS stevilo_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN oseba o ON u.id_upravna_enota = o.upravna_enota WHERE o.starost > 46 AND o.alkotest < 0.68 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 2.0 AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' ) AND n.upravna_enota > 68 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 45 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.58 ) AND n.x > 160712 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 122 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 93356 AND o.starost > 32 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 215 UNION ALL SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 769483 AND o.starost < 96 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) < 679;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 648221 AND o.starost > 48 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 341 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND n.cas_nesreca <= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost > 39 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 7 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 933100 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.5 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 740 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS accidents_with_culprits, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatalities, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) - COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca)) AS accidents_without_persons, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0) * 100000, 2) AS accidents_per_100k FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota AND n.x_wgs84 IS NOT NULL AND n.y_wgs84 IS NOT NULL AND n.tip_nesreca IN ('1', '2', '3') LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca AND o.starost BETWEEN 48 AND 61 AND o.alkotest >= 1.47 WHERE ue.povrsina > 3028 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 343732 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 872 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) < 0.25 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accidents_per_100k DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 1.69 AND o2.vozniski_staz_ll > 26) AS high_alc_experienced_drivers, SUM(CASE WHEN n.vreme_nesreca = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accidents_in_clear_weather, (SELECT AVG(o3.starost) FROM oseba o3 WHERE o3.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o3.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS avg_age_per_accident_for_causers FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 303797 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.id_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 26 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_male_age ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 2.69 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS accidents_with_culprit, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_year, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS prev_month_accidents, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_year_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca IN ('1', '1') AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' AND ue.povrsina > 622 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 818 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 23 ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, accident_rank_year;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hude_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS median_alkotest, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_enoti FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.vzrok_nesreca = n2.vzrok_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje LIKE '%glavna%' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '08:00' AND o.starost BETWEEN 18 AND 77 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 165943 AND (o.alkotest > 2.03 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 19 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 0 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.poskodba = 'S') AS stevilo_smrti, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0) AS gostota_prebivalstva, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_tipu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY n.vzrok_nesreca) AS prejsnje_stevilo_nesrec_po_vzroku FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.vzrok_nesreca = n2.vzrok_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 36 AND o.alkotest >= 0.19 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 86 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 0.68 AND SUM(o.starost) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 75 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.cas_nesreca >= '2015-01-01' AND n.cas_nesreca <= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost > 78 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 29 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezke_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahke_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x > 16019 AND y > 744307 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 607) AND o.starost BETWEEN 110 AND 66 AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN (SELECT vzrok_nesreca FROM nesreca WHERE klas_nesreca = '1' GROUP BY vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 330) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 21 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4 UNION ALL SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezke_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahke_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_vozniskega_staza FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x < 9439 AND y < 95039 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 995) AND o.starost BETWEEN 91 AND 53 AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN (SELECT vzrok_nesreca FROM nesreca WHERE klas_nesreca = '2' GROUP BY vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 34) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 71 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 22 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, smrtne_zrtve DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_mesecih, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(ue.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_nesrecah, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.vzrok_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_udelezcih_po_vzroku FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE ( (n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0') OR (n.x BETWEEN 437683 AND 457412 AND n.y BETWEEN 139878 AND 178131) ) AND n.cas_nesreca IS NOT NULL AND ( (o.starost >= 23 AND o.starost <= 25) OR (o.alkotest >= 0.25 AND o.alkotest <= 0.47) OR (o.strokovni_pregled >= 0.74 AND o.strokovni_pregled <= 0.16) ) AND NOT (o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'N' AND o.poskodba = 'S') AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 22967 AND ue.povrsina > 230 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 13 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 438 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IS NULL AND u.st_prebivalcev > 59559 AND u.povrsina < 2202 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2015-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (53) GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 18 ORDER BY year DESC, quarter DESC, accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '1') AS avg_male_age, (SELECT AVG(o2.alkotest) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 0) AS avg_positive_alkotest_in_unit, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND ue.povrsina >= 41204 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 498 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_male_age ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS accident_month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '166 days') AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 47143) AND o.starost BETWEEN 19 AND 49 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 25 ORDER BY accident_month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_causers, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / ue.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_million_inhabitants, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_in_unit FROM upravna_enota ue INNER JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 679869) AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND (n.tip_nesreca = '1' OR n.tip_nesreca IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 57 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 17 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accidents_per_million_inhabitants DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responsible_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injury_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota BETWEEN 89 AND 108 AND o.starost >= 73 AND o.alkotest >= 1.61 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 423569 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, ue.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 43 AND AVG(o.starost) < 31 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_age DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x > 38586 AND o.starost > 64 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 759 EXCEPT SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.y < 817074 AND o.starost < 73 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) < 815 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 86 AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND o.starost >= 74 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 19 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 46 AND 47 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IS NULL AND u.st_prebivalcev > 67342 AND u.povrsina < 79121 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(*) as nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) as avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 76 AND o.starost BETWEEN 18 AND 40 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 37 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 357382) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 68 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 0.99) AS high_alcohol_cases FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (12, 97, 42) AND o.starost BETWEEN 21 AND 62 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = 2018 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 14 AND AVG(o.starost) < 45 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS povprecni_staz_leta, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS povprecni_staz_meseci, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(u.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_tip_nesrece_po_enoti, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY MIN(SUBSTRING(n.cas_nesreca FROM 1 FOR 4)::integer)) AS prejsnje_nesrece_istega_tipa FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota ue ON u.id_upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND SUBSTRING(n.cas_nesreca FROM 1 FOR 4)::integer BETWEEN 2023 AND 2017 AND o.starost BETWEEN 37 AND 28 AND u.st_prebivalcev >= 972303 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, o.spol, o.drzavljanstvo, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 28 AND AVG(o.starost) < 25.48 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrtnih_zrtav FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) = 2021 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) BETWEEN 4 AND 9 AND o.alkotest > 0.96 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 46 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '{{p3}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_injury_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 931477 AND ue2.povrsina BETWEEN 354 AND 9452) AND o.starost > 70 AND n.x BETWEEN 904875 AND 1989330 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 308 AND AVG(o.starost) < 35 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza_ll, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS prebivalci_na_nesreco, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_cesti, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI'))) AS nesrece_prejšnje_leto FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN 14.45 AND 14.69 AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN 45.41 AND 45.77 AND o.starost BETWEEN 26 AND 30 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 50521 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 278 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) < 1.25 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, leto_nesreca;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS stevilo_spolov, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC, SUM(o.starost) DESC) AS rang_nesreca, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(o.alkotest) DESC) AS globalni_vrstni_red_alkotesta FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 93422 AND n.y > 887142 AND o.starost >= 71 AND o.alkotest >= 4.21 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 521 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 4.48 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupna_starost_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT n1.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_starost_povzrocitelj, AVG(o2.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezenec FROM nesreca n1 JOIN nesreca n2 ON n1.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n1.id_nesreca < n2.id_nesreca JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca AND o1.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n1.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n1.tip_nesreca = '1' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 740496 GROUP BY n1.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 52 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 936791 AND o.starost > 92 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 338 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost > 8 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 919 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT DISTINCT o.upravna_enota FROM oseba o WHERE o.starost BETWEEN 38 AND 44 ) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 100 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 2 AND o.starost < 45 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 15 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 2.91) AS high_alcohol_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x > 461049 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 823) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o3 WHERE o3.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o3.starost > 41 AND o3.vozniski_staz_ll < 44 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 435) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 55.12 AND COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) >= 29 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '0' AND o.starost > 96 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 46 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.starost) AS median_age, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id_upravna_enota) AS avg_population_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.kategorija_cesta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_road_type FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN upravna_enota ue ON o.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND o.starost BETWEEN 106 AND 19 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 690 AND AVG(o.alkotest) > 2.17 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_alkotest DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS persons_per_100k, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_in_unit FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2019 AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND y_wgs84 > '45.0' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 764) AND o.starost >= 48 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.vzrok_nesreca, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')), ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 99 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 48 AND (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 > 353.44 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, persons_per_100k DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca ORDER BY COUNT(o.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_po_tipu FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota > 75 AND o.starost > 45 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 24 ORDER BY n.tip_nesreca, rang_po_tipu;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 581978) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 427 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '1') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = '2') AS avg_female_age, MAX(o.alkotest) AS max_alcohol_level, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_participants, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota) AS population_in_unit, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.naselje_ali_izven) AS avg_accidents_by_settlement_type FROM nesreca n JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 42 AND o.alkotest >= 1.72 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, u.st_prebivalcev, n.naselje_ali_izven HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 583 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, avg_male_age;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, SUM(u.st_prebivalcev) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.upravna_enota) AS prebivalci_na_enoto, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_po_vzroku, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.tip_nesreca) AS skupne_nesrece_po_tipu FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON n.upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota AND n.vzrok_nesreca = n2.vzrok_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.alkotest > 1.66 AND u.st_prebivalcev > 686606 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 24 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, rang_nesrec_po_vzroku ASC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(*) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT DISTINCT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE starost BETWEEN 21 AND 32 ) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 14 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS oseba_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE u.st_prebivalcev > 441374 AND (o.alkotest > 1.42 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 888 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 966180 AND o.starost > 80 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 376 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT o.upravna_enota FROM oseba o WHERE o.starost BETWEEN 19 AND 34 ) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 24 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost, SUM(o.alkotest) AS total_alkotest FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 WHERE ue2.st_prebivalcev > 583767 AND ue2.povrsina < 632) AND o.starost BETWEEN 46 AND 75 AND n.x BETWEEN 669611 AND 1101472 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 9 AND AVG(o.starost) < 67 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest > 0.5) AS accidents_with_high_alcohol, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))) AS prev_year_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2015 AND o.starost >= 23 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 512912 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 421 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 76 ORDER BY year DESC, accident_rank ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost_udelezencev, AVG(o.alkotest) AS povprecni_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_smrti, MAX(u.st_prebivalcev) AS prebivalci_enote FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON ue.id_upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue2.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue2 JOIN nesreca n2 ON ue2.id_upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE o2.alkotest > 0.51 AND ue2.st_prebivalcev > 713796 GROUP BY ue2.id_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) > 38 ) AND n.vzrok_nesreca = 'A' AND o.starost BETWEEN 18 AND 31 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 3 AND AVG(o.alkotest) < 0.42 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, skupna_starost_udelezencev DESC;

GROUP (ORDER BY n.y) AS mediana_y, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x_wgs84) AS mediana_x_wgs84, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y_wgs84) AS mediana_y_wgs84 FROM ue.st_prebivalcev > 147721 AND ue.povrsina > 5143 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 6 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) > 60 UNION ALL SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezenca, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, AVG(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_strokovni_pregled, AVG(o.vozniski_staz_ll + o.vozniski_staz_mm / 12.0) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL AND o.vozniski_staz_mm IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_vozniski_staz_v_letih, COUNT(DISTINCT o.spol) AS stevilo_razlicnih_spolov, COUNT(DISTINCT o.drzavljanstvo) AS stevilo_razlicnih_drzavljanstev, COUNT(DISTINCT o.poskodba) AS stevilo_razlicnih_poskodb, COUNT(DISTINCT o.vrsta_udelezenca) AS stevilo_razlicnih_vrst_udelezencev, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, (ue.st_prebivalcev::float / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS gostota_prebivalstva, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS mediana_x, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y) AS mediana_y, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x_wgs84) AS mediana_x_wgs84, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y_wgs84) AS mediana_y_wgs84 FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x < 228058 AND n.y < 606180 AND n.x_wgs84 < '0.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '0.0' AND ue.st_prebivalcev < 587376 AND ue.povrsina < 9005 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, n.vreme_nesreca, n.stanje_promet, n.stanje_vozisce, n.stanje_povrsina_vozisce, n.opis_prizorisce, n.klas_nesreca, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.kategorija_cesta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) < 661 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 4 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezenca DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota = 86 AND o.starost >= 69 AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 857 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_equipment_used, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS avg_age_involved FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 82 AND o.starost > 61 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 27 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtni_nesreci FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota u ON n.upravna_enota = u.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota > 95 AND o.starost >= 35 GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 33 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90' AND o.starost >= 68 AND u.st_prebivalcev <= 874037 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 4 AND AVG(o.starost) < 55 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 990202 AND o.starost > 5 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 445 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT ue.id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota ue WHERE ue.st_prebivalcev > 162654 ) AND o.starost > 59 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 15 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.alkotest > 1.01 ) AND n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 78 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 1.34) AS high_alcohol_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x > 542191 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 684) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o3 WHERE o3.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o3.starost > 38 AND o3.vozniski_staz_ll < 49 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 31) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 42.3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) >= 16 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Ž') AS avg_female_age, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '45.0' AND o.starost >= 63 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 807 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 1.59 AND o2.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS high_alcohol_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS median_x_coordinate FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND n.cas_nesreca >= '2020-01-01' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 321033 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 477 AND AVG(o.starost) < 66 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue1.ime_upravna_enota AS enota1, ue2.ime_upravna_enota AS enota2, COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_v_enoti1, COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_v_enoti2, AVG(o1.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev_enota1, AVG(o2.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev_enota2 FROM upravna_enota ue1 JOIN upravna_enota ue2 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota < ue2.id_upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n1 ON ue1.id_upravna_enota = n1.upravna_enota JOIN nesreca n2 ON ue2.id_upravna_enota = n2.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o1 ON n1.id_nesreca = o1.id_nesreca JOIN oseba o2 ON n2.id_nesreca = o2.id_nesreca WHERE n1.upravna_enota > 6 AND n2.upravna_enota > 71 AND o1.starost >= 91 AND o2.starost >= 75 GROUP BY ue1.ime_upravna_enota, ue2.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n1.id_nesreca) > 14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT n2.id_nesreca) > 10 ORDER BY nesrece_v_enoti1 DESC, nesrece_v_enoti2 DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 2.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alcohol_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN o.vozniski_staz_ll > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS experienced_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) FILTER (WHERE o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P') AS accidents_with_culprit, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident, SUM(ue.povrsina) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS area_per_accident, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_year, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS prev_month_accidents, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_year_accidents FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND n.tip_nesreca IN (SELECT UNNEST(STRING_TO_ARRAY('1', ','))) AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 969833 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 670 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 27 ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC, total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alcohol_level, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_in_unit FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2015-01-01' AND o.starost >= 59 AND (n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' OR n.vzrok_nesreca = '2' OR n.vzrok_nesreca = '3') AND n.naselje_ali_izven = '1' AND o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca IN ('1', '2', '3') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 72 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS avg_alcohol_level, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_equipment_used, AVG(ue.st_prebivalcev / NULLIF(ue.povrsina, 0)) AS population_density, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca)) OVER (PARTITION BY n.upravna_enota ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_3yr_accidents, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca)) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_injury_accidents FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IS NOT NULL AND n.cas_nesreca IS NOT NULL AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND n.y_wgs84 BETWEEN '45.0' AND '45.0' AND o.starost >= 55 AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 848398 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 252 AND AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) < 0.03 ORDER BY n.upravna_enota, year DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest > 1.27 AND o2.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS high_alcohol_count, MAX(n.x_wgs84) - MIN(n.x_wgs84) AS longitude_range, MAX(n.y_wgs84) - MIN(n.y_wgs84) AS latitude_range FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x > 691154 AND y < 720096 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 522) AND n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = 'V' AND ue.st_prebivalcev >= 533647 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 5669 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 49 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, fatal_injuries ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS month, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS total_persons_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatalities, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS median_driving_experience, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS accident_rank_by_year FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM oseba WHERE alkotest > 2.6 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 518) AND (n.vzrok_nesreca = '1' OR n.tip_nesreca = '1') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.id_nesreca = n.id_nesreca AND o2.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = '1' AND o2.starost BETWEEN 22 AND 20) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 29 AND AVG(o.starost) < 65.5 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, year, month;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moski, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS povprecna_starost_zenske, SUM(CASE WHEN o.varnostni_pas_ali_celada = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s_pasom_ali_celado, SUM(CASE WHEN o.alkotest > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prekoračitve_alkotesta, (COUNT(o.id_nesreca) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ue.st_prebivalcev, 0)) * 100000 AS udelezenci_na_100k_preb, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_v_enoti, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS nesrece_prejšnje_leto FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2017 AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT id_upravna_enota FROM upravna_enota WHERE st_prebivalcev > 902858) AND o.starost >= 37 AND (o.alkotest > 2.94 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), ue.st_prebivalcev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 54 AND COUNT(o.id_nesreca) > 276 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, leto_nesreca ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(*) AS stevilo_nesrec, SUM(o.starost) AS skupna_starost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rang_vzrok FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.vzrok_nesreca IS NOT NULL AND o.starost > 69 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(*) > 595 ORDER BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost_udelezencev FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x > 518783 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 14 ) OR n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE y < 890242 GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) < 75 ) GROUP BY n.upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING AVG(o.starost) > 45.72 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesreca_count, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 656684 AND o.starost > 79 GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 575 ORDER BY nesreca_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 998250 AND o.starost > 3 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota UNION SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 709826 AND o.alkotest > 3.69 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 625063 AND o.starost >= 82 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 742 UNION ALL SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS nesrece_count, SUM(o.starost) AS total_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.y < 557395 AND o.starost <= 15 GROUP BY u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) < 850 ORDER BY nesrece_count DESC;

SELECT u.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count FROM upravna_enota u JOIN nesreca n ON u.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota WHERE n.upravna_enota IN ( SELECT DISTINCT o.upravna_enota FROM oseba o WHERE o.starost BETWEEN 36 AND 78 ) GROUP BY u.id_upravna_enota, u.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(n.id_nesreca) > 55 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS accident_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.starost) AS unique_ages, AVG(o.alkotest) AS avg_alkotest, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injury_count FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 52 AND o.starost BETWEEN 19 AND 63 AND o.alkotest >= 0.78 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 11 ORDER BY accident_count DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS distinct_accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT (n.x, n.y)) AS distinct_locations, COUNT(DISTINCT (n.oznaka_cesta_ali_naselje, n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje)) AS distinct_roads, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_causers, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_age_male, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_age_female, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca), 0) AS population_per_accident FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x > 267864 AND n.y > 170416 AND o.starost >= 78 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 319 AND AVG(o.starost) < 70 ORDER BY distinct_accidents DESC, population_per_accident ASC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) AS accidents_with_persons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN o.id_nesreca END) AS accidents_with_causers, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS avg_male_age, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'Z') AS avg_female_age, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_injuries, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatalities, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.x) AS median_x_coordinate, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.y) AS median_y_coordinate, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / ue.st_prebivalcev) AS accidents_per_million_inhabitants, (COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) * 1000000.0 / ue.povrsina) AS accidents_per_sqkm, MAX(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest_d = 'P') AS max_alcohol_level, MIN(o.strokovni_pregled) FILTER (WHERE o.strokovni_pregled_d = 'P') AS min_professional_exam, SUM(o.vozniski_staz_ll) AS total_driving_experience_years, SUM(o.vozniski_staz_mm) AS total_driving_experience_months, COUNT(DISTINCT n.tekst_cesta_ali_naselje) AS distinct_road_names, COUNT(DISTINCT n.tekst_odsek_ali_ulica) AS distinct_street_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.tip_nesreca, ', ') AS accident_types, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT n.vzrok_nesreca, ', ') AS accident_causes FROM upravna_enota ue LEFT JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota LEFT JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x >= 694442 AND n.y >= 66004 AND n.x_wgs84 <= '0.0' AND n.y_wgs84 <= '0.0' AND (o.starost >= 53 OR o.starost IS NULL) AND (o.alkotest >= 0.52 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) AND (n.cas_nesreca >= '00:00' OR n.cas_nesreca IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.st_prebivalcev, ue.povrsina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 138 AND (COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) > 82 OR COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_nesreca) = 0) AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 61 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC, accidents_per_million_inhabitants DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS total_accidents, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_injuries, AVG(o.starost) AS avg_age_involved, (SELECT AVG(o2.alkotest) FROM oseba o2 WHERE o2.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota AND o2.alkotest IS NOT NULL AND o2.alkotest > 0.36) AS avg_alcohol_above_threshold FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.tip_nesreca = '1' AND n.klas_nesreca = 'A' AND o.vrsta_udelezenca = '1' AND ue.st_prebivalcev > 972136 GROUP BY ue.id_upravna_enota, ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 11 ORDER BY total_accidents DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS leto_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.spol = 'M') AS povprecna_starost_moskih, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.alkotest) AS median_alkotest, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ue.id_upravna_enota ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) DESC) AS rang_nesrec_v_enoti FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND n.upravna_enota IN (SELECT upravna_enota FROM nesreca WHERE x_wgs84 > '0' GROUP BY upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 62) AND o.starost > 13 AND (o.alkotest > 3.32 OR o.alkotest IS NULL) GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, ue.id_upravna_enota, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(n.cas_nesreca, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 285 AND AVG(o.starost) < 57 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, leto_nesreca;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, o.spol, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.povzrocitelj_ali_udelezenec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stevilo_povzrociteljev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost, AVG(o.alkotest) FILTER (WHERE o.alkotest IS NOT NULL) AS povprecni_alkotest, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.vozniski_staz_ll) FILTER (WHERE o.vozniski_staz_ll IS NOT NULL) AS mediana_vozniskega_staza, SUM(ue.st_prebivalcev) AS skupno_prebivalstvo, SUM(ue.povrsina) AS skupna_povrsina FROM nesreca n JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca JOIN upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota WHERE n.x_wgs84 > '-180.0' AND n.y_wgs84 < '-90.0' AND o.starost >= 112 AND o.alkotest >= 2.37 GROUP BY CUBE ( ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.kategorija_cesta, n.naselje_ali_izven, n.vzrok_nesreca, n.tip_nesreca, o.spol, o.vrsta_udelezenca, o.poskodba ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 650 AND AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) < 83 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, stevilo_udelezencev DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.upravna_enota >= 388 AND o.starost >= 55 GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 1 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC;

SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_nesrec, COUNT(o.id_nesreca) AS stevilo_udelezencev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smrtne_zrtve, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tezje_poskodbe, SUM(CASE WHEN o.poskodba = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lahke_poskodbe, AVG(o.starost) FILTER (WHERE o.starost IS NOT NULL) AS povprecna_starost_udelezencev, MIN(n.x_wgs84) AS min_x, MAX(n.x_wgs84) AS max_x FROM upravna_enota ue JOIN nesreca n ON ue.id_upravna_enota = n.upravna_enota JOIN oseba o ON n.id_nesreca = o.id_nesreca WHERE n.x_wgs84 BETWEEN '13.0' AND '13.0' AND o.starost >= 90 AND n.vzrok_nesreca IN ('1', '1') GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota, n.vzrok_nesreca HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.id_nesreca) > 25 ORDER BY stevilo_nesrec DESC, povprecna_starost_udelezencev;
